drawCryoPurgeStation,\n drawModernLobbySet,\n drawModernElevatorPanel,\n draw1978BrassBadge,\n drawFireAxe,\n drawMayaAxeSwing,\n} from './keyframes_ep4.js';\n\nconst eo = (x) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - clamp(x), 3);\nconst eio = (x) => (x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 3) / 2);\nconst eob = (x) => {\n const t = clamp(x), c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1;\n return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(t - 1, 2);\n};\nconst seg = (t, a, b) => clamp((t - a) / ((b - a) || 1e-6));\nconst popScale = (t, at) => (t < at ? 0 : eob(seg(t, at, at + 0.22)));\n\nexport function buildDirectorEp4() {\n const shots = [];\n const cues = [];\n const shakes = [];\n const flashes = [];\n\n const cue = (t, type, opts = {}) => cues.push({ t: +Math.max(0, t).toFixed(3), type, ...opts });\n const shake = (t, amp = 18, dur = 0.5) => shakes.push({ t, amp, dur });\n const flash = (t, col = 'rgba(255,23,68,0.45)', dur = 0.28) => flashes.push({ t, col, dur });\n const add = (s) => shots.push(s);\n\n // Exact Timestamps for Episode 4 Series Finale (95.00s Master Cut)\n const TIMES = [\n { at: 0.00, d: 4.50, id: 'S01', note: 'KF-01 | Audience Result: [B] BURN Won (84%)' },\n { at: 4.50, d: 4.00, id: 'S02', note: 'KF-02 | Tension Push-In: The Trembling Blade' },\n { at: 8.50, d: 5.00, id: 'S03', note: 'KF-03 | Dr. Ward PA: Harvest The Specimen' },\n { at: 13.50, d: 4.50, id: Battle Plan & Axe Handoff' },\n { at: 26.50, d: 4.00, id: 'S07', note: 'KF-07 | Warrior Maya: Loop Ka Antim Sanskar' },\n { at: 30.50, d: 4.00, id: 'S08', note: 'KF-08 | Dual Split Sprint to Stations' },\n { at: 34.50, d: 4.00, id: 'S09', note: 'KF-09 | Master Breaker Substation 480V' },\n { at: 38.50, d: 5.00, id: 'S10', note: 'KF-10 | DHADAM: Breaker Smashed with Fire Axe' },\n { at: 43.50, d: 4.50, id: 'S11', note: 'KF-11 | Cryo Core Emergency Hydraulic Dump' },\n { at: 48.00, d: 4.50, id: 'S12', note: 'KF-12 | Pod 1308 Detonation & Vapor Vent' },\n { at: 52.50, d: 4.00, id: 'S13', note: 'KF-13 | Dr. Ward PA Glitch & Dissolution' },\n { at: 56.50, d: 5.00, id: 'S14', note: 'KF-14 | 1978 Hospital Dissolving Like Film' },\n { at: 61.50, d: 4.50, id: 'S15', note: 'KF-15 | The Center of the Rift: Face to Face' },\n { at: 66.00, d: 4.50, id: 'S16', note: 'KF-16 | Hands Clasp: \"Hum Aazaad Hain!\"' },\n { at: 70.50, d: 4.50, id: 'S17', note: 'KF-17 | FLASH: Supernova Temporal Whiteout' },\n { at: 75.00, d: 5.00, id: 'S18', note: 'KF-18 | Modern Elevator Doors Open: Ground Floor' },\n { at: 80.00, d: 7.00, id: 'S19', note: 'KF-19 | Broad Daylight: Back in the Real World' },\n { at: 87.00, d: 8.00, id: 'S20', note: 'KF-20 | The 1978 Souvenir & Series Completion' },\n ];\n\n // Shakes and Flashes synchronized with dramatic story beats\n shake(18.2, 18, 0.35); flash(18.2, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)', 0.15); // Scalpel clatters on tile\n shake(39.0, 36, 0.8); flash(39.0, 'rgba(0,229,255,0.85)', 0.4); // Fire axe smashes breaker box!\n shake(44.0, 22, 0.5); // Hydraulic lever slams down\n shake(48.5, 28, 0.7); flash(48.5, 'rgba(255,234,0,0.6)', 0.3); // Pod 1308 vapor purge\n shake(53.0, 16, 0.4); flash(53.0, 'rgba(239,68,68,0.7)', 0.3); // Intercom explodes\n flash(70.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)', 1.2); // Supernova merge whiteout\n shake(70.5, 24, 0.9); // Dimensional collapse bass drop\n\n // ---------------- S01: Audience Result: [B] BURN Won ----------------\n add({\n ...TIMES[0],\n cam(lt, d) { return { x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.5, zoom: 0 }; },\n draw(ctx, lt, d, t) {\n drawHospitalLobbySet(ctx, { time: 'night', redAlert: true });\n ctx.save();\n ctx.translate(W * 0.28, 1000);\n drawDrMaya(ctx, 0, 0, 1.25, { mood: 'shock', holdScalpel: true, bloodStains: true, look: [0.6, 0] });\n ctx.restore();\n ctx.save();\n ctx.translate(W * 0.74, 1000);\n drawMaya(ctx, 0, 0, 1.25, { mood: 'scream', pose: 'reach', look: [-0.7, -0.1], sweat: true });\n ctx.restore();\n // Voting Banner Pops Up\n const pop = popScale(lt, 0.2);\n if (pop > 0) {\n ctx.save();\n ctx.translate(W * 0.5, 380); ctx.scale(pop, pop);\n rrPath(ctx, -380, -45, 760, 90, 18);\n fillStroke(ctx, 'rgba(69, 10, 10, 0.95)', 4, '#ff3d00');\n ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3d00'; ctx.font = '900 32px Inter, sans-serif';\n ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n ctx.fillText('AUDIENCE CHOICE: [B] BURN THE LOOP (84%)', 0, 0);\n ctx.restore();\n }\n drawTopHUD(ctx, { title: 'THE FREE LIFT • EPISODE 4 FINALE' });\n drawStamp(ctx, 70, 140, 'VOTING CLOSED', 'OPTION [B] WON', { color: '#ff3d00' });\n drawStamp(ctx, 420, 140, 'THE FINALE', 'BURN THE LOOP', { color: '#ffea00' });\n drawCaption(ctx, [{ t: 'AUDIENCE NE CHUNA OPTION B:' }, { t: 'BURN THE LOOP!', c: PAL.crimson }], 1620);\n vignette(ctx, 0.4); filmGrainOverlay(ctx, 0.03);\n }\n });\n\n // ---------------- S02: Tension Push-In: The Trembling Blade ----------------\n add({\n ...TIMES[1],\n cam(lt, d) {\n const z = eio(seg(lt, 0, d)) * 0.18;\n return { x: W * 0.5, y: 960 - z * uv.setXY(i, u, v);\n }\n uv.needsUpdate = true;\n return g;\n });\n}\n\n// Procedural Canvas Texture Generator\nexport function canvasTex(key, w, h, drawFn, rep = [1, 1]) {\n let t = texCache.get(key);\n if (!t) {\n const c = document.createElement('canvas');\n c.width = w; c.height = h;\n drawFn(c.getContext('2d'), w, h);\n t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);\n t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;\n t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;\n t.anisotropy = 8;\n texCache.set(key, t);\n }\n const u = t.clone();\n u.repeat.set(rep[0], rep[1]);\n u.needsUpdate = true;\n return u;\n}\n\n// Common High-Tech Materials\nexport const T = {\n // Hexagonal Carbon-Fiber Weave\n carbon: (base = '#111827', line = '#1F2937', rep = [8, 8]) => canvasTex(`carb_${base}_${line}`, 128, 128, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = base; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n g.strokeStyle = line; g.lineWidth = 2;\n const s = 16;\n for (let y = 0; y < h + s; y += s * 1.5) {\n for (let x = 0; x < w + s * 2; x += s * 1.732) {\n const cx = x + ((Math.floor(y / (s * 1.5)) % 2) * (s * 0.866));\n g.beginPath();\n for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n const a = (i * Math.PI) / 3;\n const px = cx + (s * 0.5) * Math.cos(a);\n const py = y + (s * 0.5) * Math.sin(a);\n i === 0 ? g.moveTo(px, py) : g.lineTo(px, py);\n }\n g.closePath();\n g.stroke();\n }\n }\n }, rep),\n\n // Racing Pinstripe Body Decal\n racingStripe: (body = '#0F172A', stripe1 = '#F59E0B', stripe2 = '#00F0FF') => canvasTex(`strip_${body}_${stripe1}_${stripe2}`, 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = body; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n // Center dual gold racing stripes\n g.fillStyle = stripe1;\n g.fillRect(116, 0, 10, h);\n g.fillRect(130, 0, 10, h);\n // Outer cyan accent pinstripes\n g.fillStyle = stripe2;\n g.fillRect(108, 0, 3, h);\n g.fillRect(145, 0, 3, h);\n }, [1, 1]),\n\n // Telemetry Dashboard Screen\n dashboard: () => canvasTex('dash_screen', 256, 128, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#050B14'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n g.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF'; g.lineWidth = 2;\n g.strokeRect(4, 4, w - 8, h - 8);\n // Speedometer arc\n g.beginPath();\n g.arc(80, 70, 38, Math.PI * 0.8, Math.PI * 2.2);\n g.strokeStyle = '#38BDF8'; g.lineWidth = 6; g.stroke();\n // Digital readout\n g.fillStyle = '#00FFAA'; g.font = 'bold 24px monospace';\n g.fillText('540', 60, 78);\n g.font = '12px monospace'; g.fillText('STUDS/S', 52, 94);\n // Power graph bars\n for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n g.fillStyle = i > 5 ? '#FF0055' : '#00F0FF';\n g.fillRect(160 + i * 9, 85 - (i * 6), 6, i * 6 + 10);\n }\n g.fillStyle = '#F59E0B'; g.font = 'bold 13px sans-serif';\n g.fillText('[ SPEC-R // V1 ]', 150, 32);\n }, [1, 1]),\n\n // Badge / Decal on Side Fender\n fenderBadge: () => canvasTex('fender_badge', 256, 64, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'; g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);\n g.fillStyle = '#F59E0B'; g.font = '900 28px sans-serif';\n g.fillText('AETHELGARD', 10, 34);\n g.fillStyle = '#00F0FF'; g.font = 'bold 16px monospace';\n g.fillText('MONARCH 01', 12, 54);\n g.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF'; g.lineWidth = 3;\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(190, 16); g.lineTo(240, 16); g.lineTo(225, 48); g.lineTo(175, 48); g.closePath();\n g.fillStyle = '#00F0FF'; g.fill();\n }, [1, 1])\n};\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini Projects/Nirvana/Automation reel workflow/roblox-glitch-market/src/core/geo.js"}},{"name":"write_file","args":{"Content":"// The Apex Neon Speeder — Luxury Cyber Flying Cruiser (Roblox 3D Asset)\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { chamferBox, canvasTex, T } from './core/geo.js';\n\nconst D = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad;\n\nexport function buildNeonSpeeder(opts = {}) {\n const g = new THREE.Group();\n\n // Colors & Materials\n const primaryCol = opts.primary || '#0B1120'; // Deep obsidian carbon\n const accentCol = opts.accent || '#F59E0B'; // Monarch Gold\n const neonCol = opts.neon || '#00F0FF'; // Electric Cyan\n const brakeCol = '#FF0044'; // Crimson Neon\n\n const matBody = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: primaryCol,\n roughness: 0.28,\n metalness: 0.72,\n envMapIntensity: 1.4,\n });\n\n const matCarbon = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: T.carbon('#0F172A', '#1E293B', [12, 12]),\n roughness: 0.55,\n metalness: 0.25,\n });\n\n const matStripe = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: T.racingStripe(primaryCol, accentCol, neonCol),\n roughness: 0.26,\n metalness: 0.68,\n });\n\n const matGold = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: accentCol,\n roughness: 0.22,\n metalness: 0.88,\n });\n\n const matGlass = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({\n color: '#0369A1',\n roughness: 0.08,\n transmission: 0.75,\n thickness: 0.4,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.70,\n metalness: 0.1,\n });\n\n const matNeon = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: neonCol,\n emissive: neonCol,\n emissiveIntensity: 2.8,\n roughness: 0.2,\n });\n\n const matHeadlight = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#FFFFFF',\n emissive: '#FFFFFF',\n emissiveIntensity: 3.5,\n });\n\n const matTaillight = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: brakeCol,\n emissive: brakeCol,\n emissiveIntensity: 3.0,\n });\n\n const matDarkMetal = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#1E293B',\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.65,\n });\n\n const mkMesh = (geo, mat, pos = [0,0,0], rot = [0,0,0], parent = g) => {\n const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);\n m.position.set(...pos);\n m.rotation.set(...rot);\n m.castShadow = true;\n m.receiveShadow = true;\n parent.add(m);\n return m;\n };\n\n // ==========================================\n // 1. MAIN CHASSIS & LOWER TRAY\n // ==========================================\n // Lower carbon tray (Length 5.2m, Width 2.2m, Height 0.25m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(2.2, 0.22, 5.0, 0.04), matCarbon, [0, 0.25, 0]);\n\n // Main Center Hull with Racing Stripe Decal\n const mainHull = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.9, 0.45, 4.4, 0.06), matStripe, [0, 0.52, -0.1]);\n\n // Sloped Aerodynamic Nose Wedge\n const noseWedge = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.6, 0.26, 1.4, 0.05), matStripe, [0, 0.42, 2.2]);\n noseWedge.rotation.x = D(-8);\n\n // Front Splitter / Ground Effect Wing\n const splitter = mkMesh(chamferBox(2.1, 0.06, 0.6, 0.02), matCarbon, [0, 0.20, 2.65]);\n // Splitter support struts\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.16, 0.04, 0.01), matGold, [-0.55, 0.28, 2.65]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.16, 0.04, 0.01), matGold, [0.55, 0.28, 2.65]);\n\n // Front Lower Intake Mesh\n const intakeMesh = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.1, 0.14, 0.08, 0.02), matDarkMetal, [0, 0.32, 2.76]);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 2. FENDER ARCHES & HOVER POD NACELLES\n // ==========================================\n // 4 Aggressive Flared Wheel-less Arches\n const fenderPositions = [\n [-1.02, 0.48, 1.4], // Front Left\n [1.02, 0.48, 1.4], // Front Right\n [-1.08, 0.55, -1.3], // Rear Left (Wider stance)\n [1.08, 0.55, -1.3], // Rear Right\n ];\n\n fenderPositions.forEach(([x, y, z], idx) => {\n const isRear = idx >= 2;\n const w = isRear ? 0.36 : 0.30;\n const l = isRear ? 1.6 : 1.3;\n const h = isRear ? 0.52 : 0.44;\n const f = mkMesh(chamferBox(w, h, l, 0.04), matBody, [x, y, z]);\n f.rotation.z = (x < 0 ? 1 : -1) * D(4);\n\n // Side intake vent slit on each fender\n const vent = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.06, 0.10, l * 0.45, 0.02), matNeon, [x + (x < 0 ? -0.14 : 0.14), y, z]);\n\n // Underbelly Magnetic Hover-Discs\n const hoverPad = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.36, 0.38, 0.08, 24), matDarkMetal);\n hoverPad.position.set(x, 0.16, z);\n g.add(hoverPad);\n\n // Glowing Concentric Anti-Grav Core\n const hoverCore = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.25, 0.25, 0.09, 20), matNeon);\n hoverCore.position.set(x, 0.15, z);\n g.add(hoverCore);\n });\n\n // Side Rocker Panels with Fender Decal\n const leftDoor = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.38, 1.8, 0.02), matBody, [-0.98, 0.52, 0.05]);\n const rightDoor = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.38, 1.8, 0.02), matBody, [0.98, 0.52, 0.05]);\n\n // Aethelgard Badge Plane on Right Door\n const badgeGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.2, 0.3);\n const badgeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: T.fenderBadge(), transparent: true });\n const badgeL = new THREE.Mesh(badgeGeo, badgeMat);\n badgeL.position.set(-1.03, 0.52, 0.05); badgeL.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2; g.add(badgeL);\n const badgeR = new THREE.Mesh(badgeGeo, badgeMat);\n badgeR.position.set(1.03, 0.52, 0.05); badgeR.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2; g.add(badgeR);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 3. COCKPIT CANOPY & HIGH-TECH INTERIOR\n // ==========================================\n // Translucent Fighter-Jet Canopy Bubble\n const canopy = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.24, 0.48, 1.95, 0.08), matGlass, [0, 0.95, 0.1]);\n canopy.rotation.x = D(-5);\n\n // Structural Roof Spine & Frame\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.12, 0.06, 2.05, 0.02), matGold, [0, 1.20, 0.1]).rotation.x = D(-5);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.26, 0.05, 0.06, 0.02), matGold, [0, 1.15, -0.7]).rotation.x = D(-5);\n\n // Cockpit Interior Tub\n const interior = new THREE.Group(); interior.position.set(0, 0.65, 0.1); g.add(interior);\n // Floor & Console\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.1, 0.12, 1.6, 0.02), matDarkMetal, [0, 0, 0], [0,0,0], interior);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.24, 0.22, 1.1, 0.02), matCarbon, [0, 0.15, 0], [0,0,0], interior);\n\n // 2 Race Bucket Seats\n for (const sx of [-0.32, 0.32]) {\n // Cushion\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.38, 0.12, 0.45, 0.03), matCarbon, [sx, 0.12, -0.15], [0,0,0], interior);\n // Backrest\n const back = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.36, 0.52, 0.12, 0.03), matCarbon, [sx, 0.40, -0.38], [0,0,0], interior);\n back.rotation.x = D(-12);\n // Headrest with Gold Emblem\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.24, 0.16, 0.09, 0.02), matGold, [sx, 0.68, -0.45], [D(-12),0,0], interior);\n }\n\n // Dashboard Telemetry Screen\n const dashScreen = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.55, 0.25, 0.04, 0.02), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: T.dashboard() }), [0, 0.35, 0.58], [D(-25), 0, 0], interior);\n // Flight Yoke\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.30, 0.14, 0.04, 0.01), matGold, [-0.32, 0.32, 0.35], [D(-20), 0, 0], interior);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 4. CANARD WINGLETS & REAR STABILIZER FINS\n // ==========================================\n // Mid Swept Canard Winglets\n const wingL = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.65, 0.05, 0.55, 0.02), matCarbon, [-1.25, 0.50, 0.3]);\n wingL.rotation.set(0, D(-18), D(5));\n const wingR = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.65, 0.05, 0.55, 0.02), matCarbon, [1.25, 0.50, 0.3]);\n wingR.rotation.set(0, D(18), D(-5));\n\n // Dual Angled Vertical Tailfins\n for (const [tx, rotZ] of [[-0.88, D(-15)], [0.88, D(15)]]) {\n const fin = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.72, 1.0, 0.03), matBody, [tx, 1.02, -1.75]);\n fin.rotation.set(D(-14), 0, rotZ);\n // Glowing Cyan Edge on Fin\n const finEdge = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.70, 0.06, 0.01), matNeon, [tx + (tx < 0 ? -0.04 : 0.04), 1.05, -1.3]);\n finEdge.rotation.set(D(-14), 0, rotZ);\n }\n\n // High-Downforce Rear Spoiler\n const spoilerStrutL = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.06, 0.45, 0.16, 0.02), matCarbon, [-0.55, 1.05, -2.1]);\n spoilerStrutL.rotation.x = D(-18);\n const spoilerStrutR = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.06, 0.45, 0.16, 0.02), matCarbon, [0.55, 1.05, -2.1]);\n spoilerStrutR.rotation.x = D(-18);\n\n const spoilerWing = mkMesh(chamferBox(2.25, 0.06, 0.45, 0.02), matCarbon, [0, 1.28, -2.25]);\n spoilerWing.rotation.x = D(-8);\n // Neon Cyan Underside Light Strip on Spoiler\n mkMesh(chamferBox(2.15, 0.02, 0.05, 0.01), matNeon, [0, 1.24, -2.25]);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 5. PROPULSION: DUAL PLASMA THRUSTER ENGINES\n // ==========================================\n const thrusterPos = [-0.55, 0.55];\n thrusterPos.forEach((x) => {\n // Outer Engine Cowling\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.52, 0.46, 1.2, 0.04), matCarbon, [x, 0.58, -1.8]);\n\n // Stepped Titanium Exhaust Nozzle Ring\n const nozzleOuter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.28, 0.28, 24, 1, true), matDarkMetal);\n nozzleOuter.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n nozzleOuter.position.set(x, 0.58, -2.48);\n g.add(nozzleOuter);\n\n // Inner Concentric Gold Ring\n const nozzleInner = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.22, 0.22, 20, 1, true), matGold);\n nozzleInner.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n nozzleInner.position.set(x, 0.58, -2.49);\n g.add(nozzleInner);\n\n // Glowing Cyan Plasma Core Disc\n const plasmaCore = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.17, 24), matNeon);\n plasmaCore.position.set(x, 0.58, -2.50);\n plasmaCore.rotation.y = Math.PI;\n g.add(plasmaCore);\n\n // Concentric Center Needle\n const needle = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, 0.25, 16), matDarkMetal);\n needle.position.set(x, 0.58, -2.38);\n needle.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n g.add(needle);\n });\n\n // Engine Deck Heat Exhaust Slats (Top deck)\n for (let z = -0.9; z >= -1.4; z -= 0.14) {\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.85, 0.02, 0.06, 0.01), matGold, [0, 0.77, z]);\n }\n\n // Classic Roblox Stud Accents (4 studs on rear engine deck)\n for (const sx of [-0.25, 0.25]) {\n for (const sz of [-0.6, -0.78]) {\n const stud = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.03, 16), matGold);\n stud.position.set(sx, 0.78, sz);\n g.add(stud);\n }\n }\n\n // ==========================================\n // 6. LIGHTING SUITE: HEADLIGHTS, TAILLIGHTS, UNDERGLOW\n // ==========================================\n // Razor-Thin Full-Width Front LED Beam\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.50, 0.045, 0.05, 0.01), matHeadlight, [0, 0.44, 2.76]);\n\n // Dual Lower Cyan Fog Slits\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.28, 0.03, 0.04, 0.01), matNeon, [-0.55, 0.26, 2.75]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.28, 0.03, 0.04, 0.01), matNeon, [0.55, 0.26, 2.75]);\n\n // Full-Width Aggressive Rear Crimson Brake Bar\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.85, 0.06, 0.05, 0.01), matTaillight, [0, 0.68, -2.42]);\n // Lower center formula-one style hazard triangle\n const f1Light = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.22, 0.12, 0.04, 0.01), matTaillight, [0, 0.25, -2.48]);\n\n // Underglow Neon Tubes (Left & Right)\n const underglowL = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.04, 3.2, 0.01), matNeon, [-0.85, 0.18, 0]);\n const underglowR = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.04, 3.2, 0.01), matNeon, [0.85, 0.18, 0]);\n\n return g;\n}\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini Projects/Nirvana/Automation reel for The Neon Speeder\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { makeEngine, lightRig } from './core/engine.js';\nimport { buildNeonSpeeder } from './speeder.js';\nimport { chamferBox, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\nconst D = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad;\n\nconst ANGLES = [\n { id: 'angle_1_hero', title: 'VIEW 01: FRONT 3/4 HERO', desc: 'Aggressive low-angle stance, nose splitter, LED bar, cockpit canopy', pos: [-3.8, 1.5, 4.0], target: [0, 0.58, 0.2], fov: 36 },\n { id: 'angle_2_side', title: 'VIEW 02: PURE SIDE PROFILE', desc: 'Sleek aerodynamic wedge, canard winglets, door badges, hover clearance', pos: [-6.2, 1.1, 0.0], target: [0, 0.58, 0.0], fov: 32 },\n { id: 'angle_3_rear', title: 'VIEW 03: REAR 3/4 THRUSTERS', desc: 'Dual plasma rocket engines, titanium nozzles, spoiler, crimson brake bar', pos: [3.8, 1.7, -4.0], target: [0, 0.58, -0.4], fov: 36 },\n { id: 'angle_4_front', title: 'VIEW 04: FRONT HEAD-ON', desc: 'Symmetrical width, razor-thin white LED beam, dual lower cyan fog lights', pos: [0.0, 1.05, 5.6], target: [0, 0.58, 0.8], fov: 32 },\n { id: 'angle_5_top', title: 'VIEW 05: TOP-DOWN 3/4 ELEVATED', desc: 'Dual gold racing stripes, canopy interior, heat slats, wing geometry', pos: [-3.2, 5.2, 2.4], target: [0, 0.45, 0.0], fov: 38 },\n];\n\nasync function init() {\n const masterCanvas = document.getElementById('viewCanvas');\n const masterCtx = masterCanvas.getContext('2d');\n\n // Offscreen WebGL Canvas for rendering each angle\n const glCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n glCanvas.width = 1280;\n glCanvas.height = 760;\n\n const E = makeEngine(glCanvas, { w: 1280, h: 760, samples: 4, shadowSize: 2048 });\n\n // Build the 3D Showroom Scene\n const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n scene.background = new THREE.Color('#070B12');\n\n // Studio Lighting\n const lights = lightRig(scene, {\n key: '#FFFBEB', keyI: 2.5, keyPos: [5, 12, 6],\n rimCol: '#00F0FF', rimI: 1.4,\n sky: '#38BDF8', ground: '#0F172A', hemiI: 0.55,\n shadowBox: 12, target: [0, 0.5, 0]\n });\n\n // Secondary Warm Rim from opposite side\n const warmRim = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#F59E0B', 1.1);\n warmRim.position.set(-6, 5, -6);\n scene.add(warmRim);\n\n // Showroom Floor: Cyber Grid Reflective Hexagon Platform\n const floorTex = canvasTex('showroom_floor', 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#080D18'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n g.strokeStyle = '#1E293B'; g.lineWidth = 2;\n g.strokeRect(0, 0, w, h);\n // Subtle crosshairs\n g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15)'; g.lineWidth = 1;\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(w/2, 0); g.lineTo(w/2, h); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, h/2); g.lineTo(w, h/2); g.stroke();\n }, [14, 14]);\n\n const floorMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: floorTex,\n roughness: 0.35,\n metalness: 0.35,\n });\n\n const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(28, 28), floorMat);\n floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n floor.receiveShadow = true;\n scene.add(floor);\n\n // Circular Neon Trim Ring on Floor\n const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(4.2, 4.3, 64);\n const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#00F0FF', side: THREE.DoubleSide });\n const floorRing = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);\n floorRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n floorRing.position.y = 0.01;\n scene.add(floorRing);\n\n // Build the Hero Speeder Asset\n const speeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n // Elevate speeder to hover height (0.22m off floor)\n speeder.position.set(0, 0.22, 0);\n scene.add(speeder);\n\n // Under-vehicle Blue Hover-glow Discs on the Floor\n const hoverGlowMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: '#00D5FF',\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.45,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n });\n\n const padCoords = [[-1.02, 1.4], [1.02, 1.4], [-1.08, -1.3], [1.08, -1.3]];\n padCoords.forEach(([x, z]) => {\n const disc = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.55, 24), hoverGlowMat);\n disc.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n disc.position.set(x, 0.015, z);\n scene.add(disc);\n });\n\n const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(36, 1280 / 760, 0.1, 100);\n\n // Capture each angle\n const renderedImages = {};\n\n for (const cfg of ANGLES) {\n cam.fov = cfg.fov;\n cam.updateProjectionMatrix();\n cam.position.set(...cfg.pos);\n cam.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(...cfg.target));\n\n E.render(scene, cam, {\n bloom: 0.35,\n bloomThreshold: 1.25,\n bloomRadius: 0.50,\n exposure: 1.02,\n sat: 1.18,\n vignette: 0.18,\n focus: cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3(...cfg.target)),\n aperture: 0.0004\n });\n\n const dataUrl = glCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');\n renderedImages[cfg.id] = dataUrl;\n }\n\n // ==========================================\n // MASTER SHEET COMPOSITION (2400 x 1350)\n // The Apex Neon Speeder — Luxury Cyber Flying Cruiser (Roblox 3D Asset - Refined Supercar Edition)\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { chamferBox, canvasTex, T } from './core/geo.js';\n\nconst D = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad;\n\nexport function buildNeonSpeeder(opts = {}) {\n const g = new THREE.Group();\n\n // Colors & Materials\n const primaryCol = opts.primary || '#0F172A'; // Deep obsidian slate\n const secondaryCol = '#1E293B'; // Charcoal trim\n const accentCol = opts.accent || '#F59E0B'; // Monarch Gold\n const neonCol = opts.neon || '#00F0FF'; // Electric Cyan\n const brakeCol = '#FF0055'; // Neon Crimson\n\n // High-gloss automotive clear-coat material\n const matBody = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: primaryCol,\n roughness: 0.22,\n metalness: 0.65,\n envMapIntensity: 1.8,\n });\n\n const matTrim = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: secondaryCol,\n roughness: 0.38,\n metalness: 0.50,\n });\n\n const matCarbon = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: T.carbon('#0B0F19', '#1E293B', [16, 16]),\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.35,\n });\n\n const matStripe = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: T.racingStripe(primaryCol, accentCol, neonCol),\n roughness: 0.20,\n metalness: 0.70,\n });\n\n const matGold = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: accentCol,\n roughness: 0.18,\n metalness: 0.90,\n });\n\n // Tinted Cyan Cockpit Windshield (High-gloss reflective glass)\n const matGlass = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({\n color: '#0891B2',\n roughness: 0.05,\n transmission: 0.60,\n thickness: 0.5,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.85,\n reflectivity: 0.9,\n metalness: 0.2,\n });\n\n const matNeon = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: neonCol,\n emissive: neonCol,\n emissiveIntensity: 3.2,\n roughness: 0.1,\n });\n\n const matHeadlight = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#E0F2FE',\n emissive: '#38BDF8',\n emissiveIntensity: 4.2,\n });\n\n const matTaillight = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: brakeCol,\n emissive: brakeCol,\n emissiveIntensity: 3.5,\n });\n\n const matDarkMetal = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#0A0E17',\n roughness: 0.5,\n metalness: 0.8,\n });\n\n const mkMesh = (geo, mat, pos = [0,0,0], rot = [0,0,0], parent = g) => {\n const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);\n m.position.set(...pos);\n m.rotation.set(...rot);\n m.castShadow = true;\n m.receiveShadow = true;\n parent.add(m);\n return m;\n };\n\n // ==========================================\n // 1. MAIN MONOCOQUE CHASSIS & HOOD\n // ==========================================\n // Lower carbon undertray (Total length 4.6m, width 2.1m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(2.1, 0.20, 4.4, 0.04), matCarbon, [0, 0.28, -0.1]);\n\n // Main Mid-Body Monocoque\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.75, 0.42, 3.2, 0.05), matStripe, [0, 0.54, -0.2]);\n\n // Sloped Front Hood (Aggressive sports car wedge rake)\n const hood = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.55, 0.24, 1.4, 0.04), matStripe, [0, 0.46, 1.6]);\n hood.rotation.x = D(-11);\n\n // Dual Hood Power Bulge Scoops\n for (const hx of [-0.42, 0.42]) {\n const scoop = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.26, 0.08, 0.9, 0.02), matCarbon, [hx, 0.58, 1.5]);\n scoop.rotation.x = D(-11);\n // Glowing cyan intake slit in front of scoop\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.22, 0.03, 0.04, 0.01), matNeon, [hx, 0.58, 1.95]).rotation.x = D(-11);\n }\n\n // Front Aerodynamic Splitter Wing (Carbon fiber with gold tie-rods)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(2.0, 0.06, 0.55, 0.02), matCarbon, [0, 0.22, 2.35]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.14, 0.04, 0.01), matGold, [-0.6, 0.28, 2.35]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.14, 0.04, 0.01), matGold, [0.6, 0.28, 2.35]);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 2. AGGRESSIVE FENDER ARCHES & HOVER PODS\n // ==========================================\n // 4 Flared Widebody Wheel-less Fenders\n const fenderData = [\n { x: -0.96, z: 1.25, w: 0.34, l: 1.35, h: 0.46, rotZ: D(3) }, // Front Left\n { x: 0.96, z: 1.25, w: 0.34, l: 1.35, h: 0.46, rotZ: D(-3) }, // Front Right\n { x: -1.02, z: -1.15, w: 0.38, l: 1.65, h: 0.52, rotZ: D(4) }, // Rear Left (Muscular stance)\n { x: 1.02, z: -1.15, w: 0.38, l: 1.65, h: 0.52, rotZ: D(-4) }, // Rear Right\n ];\n\n fenderData.forEach((f) => {\n const mesh = mkMesh(chamferBox(f.w, f.h, f.l, 0.04), matBody, [f.x, 0.50, f.z]);\n mesh.rotation.z = f.rotZ;\n\n // Side aerodynamic air-blade with glowing cyan LED trace\n const blade = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.06, 0.12, f.l * 0.5, 0.02), matNeon, [f.x + (f.x < 0 ? -f.w * 0.48 : f.w * 0.48), 0.50, f.z]);\n\n // Recessed Magnetic Levitation Emitter Pad (Belly)\n const pad = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.34, 0.08, 24), matDarkMetal);\n pad.position.set(f.x, 0.18, f.z);\n g.add(pad);\n\n const padRing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.24, 0.035, 12, 24), matNeon);\n padRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n padRing.position.set(f.x, 0.17, f.z);\n g.add(padRing);\n });\n\n // Side Rocker Panels & Doors\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.10, 0.38, 1.45, 0.03), matBody, [-0.92, 0.52, 0.05]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.10, 0.38, 1.45, 0.03), matBody, [0.92, 0.52, 0.05]);\n\n // Aethelgard Door Badges\n const badgeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: T.fenderBadge(), transparent: true });\n const bL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.1, 0.28), badgeMat);\n bL.position.set(-0.98, 0.52, 0.05); bL.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2; g.add(bL);\n const bR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.1, 0.28), badgeMat);\n bR.position.set(0.98, 0.52, 0.05); bR.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2; g.add(bR);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 3. SUPERCAR COCKPIT CANOPY & INTERIOR\n // ==========================================\n // Angled Windshield (Steep 28-degree rake forward)\n const windshield = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.15, 0.42, 0.85, 0.04), matGlass, [0, 0.88, 0.45]);\n windshield.rotation.x = D(-28);\n\n // Roof Canopy Cap\n const roof = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.10, 0.22, 1.1, 0.04), matGlass, [0, 1.05, -0.32]);\n roof.rotation.x = D(-6);\n\n // Rear Sloped Fastback Window\n const rearGlass = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.05, 0.28, 0.75, 0.04), matGlass, [0, 0.88, -1.05]);\n rearGlass.rotation.x = D(22);\n\n // Gold Structural Roof Spine (A-pillar to fastback)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.05, 2.3, 0.02), matGold, [0, 1.12, -0.3]).rotation.x = D(-3);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.18, 0.05, 0.06, 0.02), matGold, [0, 1.05, 0.1]);\n\n // Cockpit Interior Tub & Detail\n const interior = new THREE.Group(); interior.position.set(0, 0.62, 0.0); g.add(interior);\n // Carbon center console\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.24, 0.22, 1.2, 0.02), matCarbon, [0, 0.14, 0], [0,0,0], interior);\n // 2 Race Bucket Seats\n for (const sx of [-0.34, 0.34]) {\n // Cushion\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.36, 0.12, 0.44, 0.03), matTrim, [sx, 0.12, -0.2], [0,0,0], interior);\n // Backrest\n const back = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.34, 0.54, 0.12, 0.03), matTrim, [sx, 0.42, -0.42], [D(-14),0,0], interior);\n // Gold Headrest\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.22, 0.15, 0.09, 0.02), matGold, [sx, 0.72, -0.50], [D(-14),0,0], interior);\n }\n // Glowing Telemetry Dashboard Screen\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.52, 0.24, 0.04, 0.02), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: T.dashboard() }), [0, 0.38, 0.45], [D(-25), 0, 0], interior);\n // F1-Style Flight Yoke\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.28, 0.14, 0.04, 0.01), matGold, [-0.34, 0.34, 0.26], [D(-20), 0, 0], interior);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 4. CANARD WINGLETS, VERTICAL TAILFINS & SPOILER\n // ==========================================\n // Swept Mid-Canard Winglets\n const wingL = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.55, 0.05, 0.65, 0.02), matCarbon, [-1.15, 0.52, 0.1]);\n wingL.rotation.set(0, D(-16), D(6));\n const wingR = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.55, 0.05, 0.65, 0.02), matCarbon, [1.15, 0.52, 0.1]);\n wingR.rotation.set(0, D(16), D(-6));\n\n // Dual Outward-Canted Vertical Tailfins\n for (const [tx, rotZ] of [[-0.85, D(-16)], [0.85, D(16)]]) {\n const fin = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.68, 0.95, 0.03), matBody, [tx, 1.02, -1.65]);\n fin.rotation.set(D(-14), 0, rotZ);\n // Cyan illuminated fin tip\n const finTip = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.05, 0.08, 0.90, 0.01), matNeon, [tx + (tx < 0 ? -0.04 : 0.04), 1.34, -1.72]);\n finTip.rotation.set(D(-14), 0, rotZ);\n }\n\n // High-Downforce Carbon Supercar Spoiler\n const pylonL = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.06, 0.48, 0.16, 0.02), matCarbon, [-0.52, 1.02, -1.95]);\n pylonL.rotation.x = D(-22);\n const pylonR = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.06, 0.48, 0.16, 0.02), matCarbon, [0.52, 1.02, -1.95]);\n pylonR.rotation.x = D(-22);\n\n const spoilerWing = mkMesh(chamferBox(2.15, 0.06, 0.42, 0.02), matCarbon, [0, 1.25, -2.12]);\n spoilerWing.rotation.x = D(-8);\n // Full-width Cyan Neon Underside Glow on Spoiler\n mkMesh(chamferBox(2.05, 0.02, 0.05, 0.01), matNeon, [0, 1.21, -2.12]);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 5. PROPULSION: DUAL PLASMA ROCKET THRUSTERS\n // ==========================================\n for (const tx of [-0.52, 0.52]) {\n // Cylindrical Carbon Engine Housing\n const casing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.26, 0.95, 20), matCarbon);\n casing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n casing.position.set(tx, 0.58, -1.65);\n g.add(casing);\n\n // Titanium Stepped Exhaust Nozzle Ring\n const nozzle = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.26, 0.26, 24, 1, true), matDarkMetal);\n nozzle.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n nozzle.position.set(tx, 0.58, -2.22);\n g.add(nozzle);\n\n // Inner Gold Retaining Lip\n const lip = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.21, 0.22, 20, 1, true), matGold);\n lip.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n lip.position.set(tx, 0.58, -2.23);\n g.add(lip);\n\n // Glowing Cyan Plasma Core\n const core = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.17, 24), matNeon);\n core.rotation.y = Math.PI;\n core.position.set(tx, 0.58, -2.24);\n g.add(core);\n\n // Center Afterburner Spike\n const spike = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.05, 0.22, 16), matDarkMetal);\n spike.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n spike.position.set(tx, 0.58, -2.12);\n g.add(spike);\n }\n\n // Rear Engine Deck Ventilation Louvers (Gold slats)\n for (let z = -0.7; z >= -1.25; z -= 0.12) {\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.82, 0.02, 0.05, 0.01), matGold, [0, 0.78, z]);\n }\n\n // Classic Roblox Stud Connectors (6 gold studs along engine deck)\n for (const sx of [-0.28, 0, 0.28]) {\n for (const sz of [-0.55, -0.72]) {\n const stud = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.045, 0.045, 0.025, 14), matGold);\n stud.position.set(sx, 0.79, sz);\n g.add(stud);\n }\n }\n\n // ==========================================\n // 6. LIGHTING SUITE: HYPER-LED HEADLIGHTS & TAILLIGHTS\n // ==========================================\n // Front Angular Cyber Headlights (Aggressive Quadra/Lamborghini style)\n for (const hx of [-0.60, 0.60]) {\n // Upper horizontal bar\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.36, 0.045, 0.05, 0.01), matHeadlight, [hx, 0.46, 2.30]).rotation.y = (hx < 0 ? 1 : -1) * D(-12);\n // Angled vertical slash\n const slash = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.14, 0.04, 0.01), matHeadlight, [hx + (hx < 0 ? -0.16 : 0.16), 0.39, 2.27]);\n slash.rotation.z = (hx < 0 ? 1 : -1) * D(25);\n }\n\n // Center Razor LED Monostrip\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.65, 0.025, 0.04, 0.01), matHeadlight, [0, 0.44, 2.34]);\n\n // Full-Width Rear Crimson Brake Light Bar (Recessed under tail)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.78, 0.055, 0.05, 0.01), matTaillight, [0, 0.66, -2.18]);\n // F1-Style Rain / Reverse Light Flasher\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.20, 0.10, 0.04, 0.01), matTaillight, [0, 0.28, -2.25]);\n\n // Underglow Neon Tubes (Left & Right)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.04, 2.8, 0.01), matNeon, [-0.80, 0.20, -0.1]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.04, 2.8, 0.01), matNeon, [0.80, 0.20, -0.1]);\n\n return g;\n}\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini Proportions)\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { makeEngine, lightRig } from './core/engine.js';\nimport { buildNeonSpeeder } from './speeder.js';\nimport { canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\nconst ANGLES = [\n { id: 'speeder_angle_1_hero', title: 'VIEW 01: FRONT 3/4 HERO', desc: 'Aggressive low-angle stance, nose splitter, LED bar, cockpit canopy', pos: [-3.4, 1.4, 3.2], target: [0, 0.55, 0.1], fov: 36 },\n { id: 'speeder_angle_2_side', title: 'VIEW 02: PURE SIDE PROFILE', desc: 'Sleek aerodynamic wedge, canard winglets, door badges, hover clearance', pos: [-5.4, 1.05, 0.0], target: [0, 0.55, 0.0], fov: 30 },\n { id: 'speeder_angle_3_rear', title: 'VIEW 03: REAR 3/4 THRUSTERS', desc: 'Dual plasma rocket engines, titanium nozzles, spoiler, crimson brake bar', pos: [3.4, 1.5, -3.2], target: [0, 0.55, -0.3], fov: 36 },\n { id: 'speeder_angle_4_front', title: 'VIEW 04: FRONT HEAD-ON', desc: 'Symmetrical width, razor-thin white LED beam, dual lower cyan fog lights', pos: [0.0, 0.95, 4.8], target: [0, 0.55, 0.6], fov: 32 },\n { id: 'speeder_angle_5_top', title: 'VIEW 05: TOP-DOWN 3/4 ELEVATED', desc: 'Dual gold racing stripes, canopy interior, heat slats, wing geometry', pos: [-2.8, 4.4, 1.8], target: [0, 0.45, 0.0], fov: 38 },\n];\n\nfunction canvasToBlob(canvas) {\n return new Promise((res) => canvas.toBlob(res, 'image/png'));\n}\n\nasync function uploadImage(name, blob) {\n await fetch(`/save?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {\n method: 'POST',\n body: blob,\n });\n}\n\nasync function init() {\n const masterCanvas = document.getElementById('viewCanvas');\n const masterCtx = masterCanvas.getContext('2d');\n\n // Offscreen WebGL Canvas for rendering each angle\n const glCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n glCanvas.width = 1280;\n glCanvas.height = 760;\n\n const E = makeEngine(glCanvas, { w: 1280, h: 760, samples: 4, shadowSize: 2048 });\n\n // Build the 3D Showroom Scene\n const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n scene.background = new THREE.Color('#060911');\n\n // High-End Automotive Studio Lighting\n const lights = lightRig(scene, {\n key: '#FFFBE8', keyI: 3.2, keyPos: [4.5, 11, 5.5],\n rimCol: '#00F0FF', rimI: 2.2,\n sky: '#38BDF8', ground: '#0F172A', hemiI: 0.68,\n shadowBox: 12, target: [0, 0.5, 0]\n });\n\n // Secondary Warm Gold Rim from rear-right\n const warmRim = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#F59E0B', 1.8);\n warmRim.position.set(-5, 4.5, -5);\n scene.add(warmRim);\n\n // Soft Front-Fill Light (preventing dark carbon crushing)\n const frontFill = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#93C5FD', 0.85);\n frontFill.position.set(-2, 3, 6);\n scene.add(frontFill);\n\n // Showroom Floor: Cyber Grid Reflective Hexagon Platform\n const floorTex = canvasTex('showroom_floor', 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#080D18'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n g.strokeStyle = '#1E293B'; g.lineWidth = 2;\n g.strokeRect(0, 0, w, h);\n g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.18)'; g.lineWidth = 1;\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(w/2, 0); g.lineTo(w/2, h); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, h/2); g.lineTo(w, h/2); g.stroke();\n }, [14, 14]);\n\n const floorMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: floorTex,\n roughness: 0.30,\n metalness: 0.40,\n });\n\n const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(28, 28), floorMat);\n floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n floor.receiveShadow = true;\n scene.add(floor);\n\n // Circular Neon Trim Ring on Floor\n const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(4.0, 4.12, 64);\n const ringMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: neonCol,\n emissive: neonCol,\n emissiveIntensity: 1.6,\n roughness: 0.1,\n });\n\n const matHeadlight = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#F0F9FF',\n matDarkMetal = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#0F172A',\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.75,\n });\n\n const mkMesh = (geo, mat, pos = [0,0,0], rot = [0,0,0], parent = g) => {\n const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);\n m.position.set(...pos);\n m.rotation.set(...rot);\n m.castShadow = true;\n m.receiveShadow = true;\n parent.add(m);\n return m;\n };\n\n // });\n\n // Build the 3D Studio Scene\n const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n scene.background = new THREE.Color('#05070D');\n\n // Studio Lighting for Massive Monumental Skyscraper\n const lights = cam.updateProjectionMatrix();\n cam.position.set(...cfg.pos);\n cam.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(...cfg.target));\n\n E.render(scene, cam, {\n bloom: 0.25,\n bloomThreshold: 1.30,\n bloomRadius: 0.48,\n exposure: 1.05,\n sat: 1.20,\n vignette: 0.16,\n focus: cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3(...cfg.target)),\n aperture: 0.0001\n });\n\n // Save individual angle image\n const blob = await canvasToBlob(glCanvas);\n await uploadImage(`${cfg.id}.png`, blob);\n\n // Draw onto Master Sheet\n masterCtx.fillStyle = '#090F1D';\n masterCtx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);\n masterCtx.drawImage(glCanvas, p.x + 4, p.y + 4, p.w - 8, p.h - 50);\n\n masterCtx.strokeStyle = '#1E293B';\n masterCtx.lineWidth = 2;\n masterCtx.strokeRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);\n\n masterCtx.fillStyle = '#0B132B';\n masterCtx.fillRect(p.x, p.y + p.h - 46, p.w, 46);\n masterCtx.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF';\n masterCtx.lineWidth = 2;\n masterCtx.beginPath();\n masterCtx.moveTo(p.x, Sovereign Apex Citadel — Boss Skyscraper with Halo Rings & Orbiting Floating Islands (Refined Edition)\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { chamferBox, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\nconst D = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad;\n\nexport function buildApexTower(opts = {}) {\n const g = new THREE.Group();\n\n // Colors & Materials\n const colObsidian = '#0A0E17'; // Dark obsidian monocoque\n const colMarble = '#F8FAFC'; // Pearlescent white marble\n const colGold = '#F59E0B'; // Sovereign Gold\n const colCyan = '#00F0FF'; // High-tech Cyan\n const colPurple = '#7E22CE'; // Monarch Purple\n const colRock = '#1E293B'; // Anti-grav dark crag\n\n // Texture Generators\n const texWindows = canvasTex('tower_windows', 256, 512, (ctx, w, h) => {\n ctx.fillStyle = '#0B1120'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n ctx.fillStyle = '#38BDF8';\n // Vertical high-density illuminated window slits\n for (let x = 12; x < w - 12; x += 22) {\n for (let y = 16; y < h - 16; y += 28) {\n if ((x * 13 + y * 7) % 5 !== 0) {\n ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + ((x + y) % 6) * 0.1;\n ctx.fillRect(x, y, 13, 16);\n }\n }\n }\n ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n // Gold architectural trim vertical mullions\n ctx.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';\n ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 8, h);\n ctx.fillRect(w - 8, 0, 8, h);\n }, [4, 8]);\n\n const texGuildHolo = canvasTex('guild_hologram', 512, 256, (ctx, w, h) => {\n ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);\n ctx.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF'; ctx.lineWidth = 4;\n ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, w - 20, h - 20);\n // Outer diamond frame\n ctx.beginPath();\n ctx.moveTo(w / 2, 20); ctx.lineTo(w - 20, h / 2);\n ctx.lineTo(w / 2, h - 20); ctx.lineTo(20, h / 2);\n ctx.closePath(); ctx.stroke();\n // Guild text\n ctx.font = '900 36px sans-serif'; ctx.fillStyle = '#F59E0B'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';\n ctx.fillText('SOVEREIGN GUILD', w / 2, 90);\n ctx.font = 'bold 22px monospace'; ctx.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';\n ctx.fillText('[ RANK 1 // CITADEL 01 ]', w / 2, 130);\n ctx.font = 'bold 16px sans-serif'; ctx.fillStyle = '#C084FC';\n ctx.fillText('POWER LEVEL: 9,999,999', w / 2, 175);\n ctx.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';\n ctx.fillRect(w / 2 - 80, 195, 160, 4);\n }, [1, 1]);\n\n const matObsidian = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colObsidian, roughness: 0.32, metalness: 0.68, envMapIntensity: 1.4\n });\n\n const matMarble = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colMarble, roughness: 0.20, metalness: 0.18, envMapIntensity: 1.8\n });\n\n const matGold = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colGold, roughness: 0.16, metalness: 0.94\n });\n\n const matWindows = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: texWindows, roughness: 0.24, metalness: 0.52\n });\n\n const matCyanNeon = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colCyan, emissive: colCyan, emissiveIntensity: 2.2, roughness: 0.1\n });\n\n const matPurpleNeon = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colPurple, emissive: colPurple, emissiveIntensity: 2.6, roughness: 0.1\n });\n\n const matCrystalCore = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({\n color: '#00F0FF', emissive: '#00B4D8', emissiveIntensity: 1.6,\n roughness: 0.05, transmission: 0.85, thickness: 1.2, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9\n });\n\n const matRock = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colRock, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.1\n });\n\n const matGrass = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#059669', roughness: 0.75, metalness: 0.05\n });\n\n const mkMesh = (geo, mat, pos = [0,0,0], rot = [0,0,0], parent = g) => {\n const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);\n m.position.set(...pos);\n m.rotation.set(...rot);\n m.castShadow = true;\n m.receiveShadow = true;\n parent.add(m);\n return m;\n };\n\n // ==============================================================\n // 1. FORTRESS FOUNDATION & LOWER BUTTRESSES (Y: 0m to 14m)\n // ==============================================================\n // Massive Octagonal Stepped Base Platform (Width 18m, Height 4m)\n const baseMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#090D16', roughness: 0.38, metalness: 0.55 });\n mkMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(9.5, 11.2, 3.6, 8), baseMat, [0, 1.8, 0]);\n\n // Golden Foundation Trim Tier\n const baseGoldRing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(9.6, 9.6, 0.45, 8), matGold);\n baseGoldRing.position.set(0, 3.6, 0); g.add(baseGoldRing);\n\n // Stepped Plinth\n mkMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(8.2, 8.8, 2.0, 8), matObsidian, [0, 4.6, 0]);\n\n // 4 Diagonal Architectural Corner Buttress Pillars\n const angles = [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5];\n angles.forEach((ang) => {\n const r = 7.6;\n const bx = Math.sin(ang) * r;\n const bz = Math.cos(ang) * r;\n const buttress = mkMesh(chamferBox(2.2, 16.0, 2.2, 0.08), matObsidian, [bx, 8.0, bz]);\n buttress.rotation.y = ang + Math.PI / 4;\n // Gold vertical spine\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.35, 16.2, 0.35, 0.02), matGold, [bx, 8.0, bz]).rotation.y = ang + Math.PI / 4;\n // Cyan vertical conduit groove\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 15.5, 0.08, 0.01), matCyanNeon, [bx * 0.94, 8.0, bz * 0.94]);\n });\n\n // ==============================================================\n // 2. MID-TIER TOWER BODY & COMMERCE FLOORS (Y: 12m to 42m)\n // ==============================================================\n // Lower Tower Body (Width 8.8m, Height 14m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(8.8, 14.0, 8.8, 0.15), matWindows, [0, 12.6, 0]);\n\n // Intermediate Stepped Balcony Shelf (At Y = 19.6m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(9.6, 0.45, 9.6, 0.05), matGold, [0, 19.6, 0]);\n\n // Main Mid-Tower Monolith (Width 7.6m, Depth 7.6m, Height 22m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(7.6, 22.0, 7.6, 0.15), matWindows, [0, 30.6, 0]);\n\n // White Marble Corner Pilasters with Gold Ribs\n for (const mx of [-3.8, 3.8]) {\n for (const mz of [-3.8, 3.8]) {\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.1, 34.0, 1.1, 0.06), matMarble, [mx, 22.5, mz]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.25, 34.2, 0.25, 0.02), matGold, [mx, 22.5, mz]);\n }\n }\n\n // Giant 3D Holographic Guild Crest Billboard (Mounted on front facade)\n const holoPlane = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(7.2, 4.0), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n map: texGuildHolo, transparent: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide\n }));\n holoPlane.position.set(0, 24.0, 4.05);\n g.add(holoPlane);\n\n // Hologram Projector Brackets\n mkMesh(chamferBox(7.4, 0.25, 0.6, 0.02), matGold, [0, 26.2, 4.0]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(7.4, 0.25, 0.6, 0.02), matGold, [0, 21.8, 4.0]);\n\n // Cantilevered VIP Landing Pad (Mid-tower balcony at Y = 32m)\n const padGrp = new THREE.Group(); padGrp.position.set(0, 32.0, -4.8); g.add(padGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(5.8, 0.45, 4.4, 0.06), matObsidian, [0, 0, 0], [0,0,0], padGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(5.9, 0.15, 4.5, 0.02), matGold, [0, 0.22, 0], [0,0,0], padGrp);\n // Glowing Landing Circle\n const padRing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(1.7, 1.85, 32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: colCyan, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));\n padRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; padRing.position.y = 0.25; padGrp.add(padRing);\n // Diagonal support trusses\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.28, 4.8, 0.28, 0.02), matGold, [-2.3, -2.2, 1.3], [D(35), 0, 0], padGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.28, 4.8, 0.28, 0.02), matGold, [2.3, -2.2, 1.3], [D(35), 0, 0], padGrp);\n\n // ==============================================================\n // 3. UPPER SPONSOR TIER & BEVEL SETBACK (Y: 42m to 54m)\n // ==============================================================\n // Upper Tapered Spire Base (Width 5.8m, Height 14m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(5.8, 14.0, 5.8, 0.12), matObsidian, [0, 48.0, 0]);\n\n // Vertical Cyan Energy Ribbons along 4 faces\n for (const rotY of [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5]) {\n const ribbon = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.28, 14.0, 0.15, 0.02), matCyanNeon, [0, 48.0, 2.96]);\n ribbon.rotation.y = rotY;\n }\n\n // Setback Observation Deck Shelf (Y = 55m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(6.6, 0.5, 6.6, 0.06), matGold, [0, 55.0, 0]);\n\n // ==============================================================\n // 4. THE GIANT DUAL HALO RINGS (ORBITING ENERGY ARCS)\n // ==============================================================\n const haloGroup = new THREE.Group();\n haloGroup.position.set(0, 55.5, 0);\n haloGroup.rotation.set(D(22), D(15), D(-8));\n g.add(haloGroup);\n\n // Outer Segmented Tech Ring (Radius 8.4m)\n const outerRingGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(8.4, 0.38, 16, 64);\n const outerRing = new THREE.Mesh(outerRingGeo, matGold);\n haloGroup.add(outerRing);\n\n // Outer Ring Cyan Energy Core\n const outerCoreGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(8.4, 0.15, 12, 64);\n const outerCore = new THREE.Mesh(outerCoreGeo, matCyanNeon);\n haloGroup.add(outerCore);\n\n // 8 Segmented Armor Clamps on Outer Ring\n for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n const ang = (i * Math.PI * 2) / 8;\n const cx = Math.cos(ang) * 8.4;\n const cy = Math.sin(ang) * 8.4;\n const clamp = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.0, 1.0, 0.58, 0.04), matObsidian, [cx, cy, 0], [0, 0, ang], haloGroup);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.25, 1.05, 0.25, 0.02), matPurpleNeon, [cx, cy, 0], [0, 0, ang], haloGroup);\n }\n\n // Inner Plasma Ring (Radius 6.5m, tilted counter to outer ring)\n const innerRingGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(6.5, 0.24, 16, 48);\n const innerRing = new THREE.Mesh(innerRingGeo, matPurpleNeon);\n innerRing.rotation.x = D(28);\n haloGroup.add(innerRing);\n\n // 4 Energy Tether Pylons Connecting Tower Neck to Halo\n angles.forEach((ang) => {\n const tx = Math.sin(ang) * 4.4;\n const tz = Math.cos(ang) * 4.4;\n const tether = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.22, 0.22, 4.8, 0.02), matCyanNeon, [tx, 55.5, tz]);\n tether.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(0, 55.5, 0));\n });\n\n // ==============================================================\n // 5. DETACHED FLOATING APEX SPIRE & SOVEREIGN GEM (Y: 58m to 75m)\n // ==============================================================\n // Floating Gap of 3 meters between main tower and detached apex!\n const apexGroup = new THREE.Group();\n apexGroup.position.set(0, 59.5, 0);\n g.add(apexGroup);\n\n // Giant Glowing Crystalline Core Gem (Floating in the anti-grav gap)\n const gemGeo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1.7, 0);\n const gem = new THREE.Mesh(gemGeo, matCrystalCore);\n gem.position.set(0, 0, 0);\n gem.scale.set(1.0, 1.9, 1.0);\n apexGroup.add(gem);\n\n // Inverted Lower Apex Funnel\n const lowerFunnel = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.5, 3.4, 8), matGold);\n lowerFunnel.position.set(0, -1.9, 0);\n lowerFunnel.rotation.x = Math.PI;\n apexGroup.add(lowerFunnel);\n\n // Soaring Detached Master Spire Needle (Height 17m)\n const spireNeedle = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.3, 17.0, 8), matMarble);\n spireNeedle.position.set(0, 9.8, 0);\n apexGroup.add(spireNeedle);\n\n // 4 Golden Corner Splines hugging the needle\n for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n const ang = (i * Math.PI * 2) / 4;\n const sx = Math.sin(ang) * 1.15;\n const sz = Math.cos(ang) * 1.15;\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.20, 16.5, 0.20, 0.02), matGold, [sx, 9.5, sz], [0, ang, 0], apexGroup);\n }\n\n // Extreme Peak Beacon Light (Shooting vertical sky beam)\n const beaconCore = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.14, 0.9, 12), matCyanNeon);\n beaconCore.position.set(0, 18.5, 0);\n apexGroup.add(beaconCore);\n\n // Vertical Volumetric Sky Beam Cylinder\n const beamGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.20, 1.1, 48.0, 16, 1, true);\n const beamMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: '#00F0FF', transparent: true, opacity: 0.38, side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n const skyBeam = new THREE.Mesh(beamGeo, beamMat);\n skyBeam.position.set(0, 42.0, 0);\n apexGroup.add(skyBeam);\n\n // ==============================================================\n // 6. THREE ORBITING FLOATING SKY-ISLANDS (MINIATURE TERRAINS)\n // ==============================================================\n const ISLAND_CONFIGS = [\n // Island 1: West Floating Garden Estate (Y: 26m, Radius 11.5m)\n {\n pos: [-11.2, 25.5, 3.2], rotY: D(35), w: 6.5, d: 5.6, h: 4.5,\n hasBuilding: true, hasPad: true, bridgeTarget: [-3.8, 26.5, 1.2]\n },\n // Island 2: North-East Guild Courtyard (Y: 34m, Radius 10.5m)\n {\n pos: [8.8, 33.5, 6.4], rotY: D(-45), w: 5.4, d: 5.0, h: 4.0,\n hasBuilding: false, hasPad: true, bridgeTarget: [3.8, 34.0, 2.0]\n },\n // Island 3: South High Lookout Sanctuary (Y: 42m, Radius 9.2m)\n {\n pos: [2.6, 42.0, -9.2], rotY: D(110), w: 4.8, d: 4.4, h: 3.6,\n hasBuilding: true, hasPad: false, bridgeTarget: [1.1, 42.5, -2.8]\n },\n ];\n\n ISLAND_CONFIGS.forEach((isl) => {\n const isGrp = new THREE.Group();\n isGrp.position.set(...isl.pos);\n isGrp.rotation.y = isl.rotY;\n g.add(isGrp);\n\n // Island Underside: Inverted Jagged Rock Stalactite (Anti-grav earth mass)\n const rockCrag = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(isl.w * 0.48, isl.h, 7), matRock);\n rockCrag.position.set(0, -isl.h / 2, 0);\n rockCrag.rotation.x = Math.PI;\n isGrp.add(rockCrag);\n\n // Glowing Cyan Anti-Grav Crystal Deposit embedded in bottom of island rock\n const antiGravGem = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(0.48), matCyanNeon);\n antiGravGem.position.set(0, -isl.h * 0.85, 0);\n isGrp.add(antiGravGem);\n\n // Island Top Surface: Lush Green Lawn\n mkMesh(chamferBox(isl.w, 0.45, isl.d, 0.08), matGrass, [0, 0.15, 0], [0,0,0], isGrp);\n\n // Golden Perimeter Safety Balustrades\n const railMat = matGold;\n mkMesh(chamferBox(isl.w, 0.35, 0.06, 0.01), railMat, [0, 0.45, isl.d / 2 - 0.05], [0,0,0], isGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(isl.w, 0.35, 0.06, 0.01), railMat, [0, 0.45, -isl.d / 2 + 0.05], [0,0,0], isGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.06, 0.35, isl.d, 0.01), railMat, [isl.w / 2 - 0.05, 0.45, 0], [0,0,0], isGrp);\n\n // Mini-House / Guild Pavilion on Island\n if (isl.hasBuilding) {\n const houseGrp = new THREE.Group(); houseGrp.position.set(-isl.w * 0.15, 0.35, 0); isGrp.add(houseGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(2.3, 1.6, 2.3, 0.05), matMarble, [0, 0.8, 0], [0,0,0], houseGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(2.7, 0.14, 2.7, 0.02), matGold, [0, 1.65, 0], [0,0,0], houseGrp);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.9, 0.85, 0.04, 0.01), matCyanNeon, [0, 0.85, 1.16], [0,0,0], houseGrp);\n }\n\n // Private Landing Pad on Island\n if (isl.hasPad) {\n const padPos = isl.hasBuilding ? [isl.w * 0.28, 0.38, 0] : [0, 0.38, 0];\n const pad = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.95, 1.0, 0.12, 20), matObsidian);\n pad.position.set(...padPos);\n isGrp.add(pad);\n const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.72, 0.80, 24), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: colCyan, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));\n ring.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; ring.position.set(padPos[0], padPos[1] + 0.07, padPos[2]);\n isGrp.add(ring);\n }\n\n // Translucent Energy Sky-Bridge Beam connecting Island to Main Tower\n const bridgeStart = new THREE.Vector3(...isl.pos);\n const bridgeEnd = new THREE.Vector3(...isl.bridgeTarget);\n const bridgeDist = bridgeStart.distanceTo(bridgeEnd);\n const bridgeMid = bridgeStart.clone().lerp(bridgeEnd, 0.5);\n\n const bridgeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.65, 0.08, bridgeDist), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: colCyan, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55\n }));\n bridgeMesh.position.copy(bridgeMid);\n bridgeMesh.lookAt(bridgeEnd);\n g.add(bridgeMesh);\n });\n\n return g;\n}\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini Projects/Nirvana/Automation reel 30, 9], target: [-10.2, 26.0, 3.2], fov: 38 },\n { id: 'tower_angle_5_topdown', title: 'VIEW 05: AERIAL ISOMETRIC OVERLOOK', desc: 'Bird-eye view looking down through halo rings, radial islands, and VIP pad', pos: [-28, 80, 24], target: [0, 42, 0], fov: 46 },\n];\n\nfunction canvasToBlob(canvas) {\n return new Promise((res) => canvas.toBlob(res, 'image/png'));\n}\n\nasync function uploadImage(name, blob) {\n await fetch(`/save?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {\n method: 'POST',\n body: blob,\n });\n}\n\nasync function init() {\n const masterCanvas = document.getElementById('viewCanvas');\n const masterCtx = masterCanvas.getContext('2d');\n\n // Offscreen WebGL Canvas\n const glCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n glCanvas.width = 1280;\n glCanvas.height = 760;\n\n const E = makeEngine(glCanvas, { w: 1280, h: 760, samples: 4, shadowSize: 2048 });\n\n // Build the 3D Studio Scene\n const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n scene.background = new THREE.Color('#05070D');\n\n // Studio Lighting for Massive Monumental Skyscraper\n const lights = lightRig(scene, {\n key: '#FFFBE8', keyI: 3.2, keyPos: [28, 70, 38],\n rimCol: '#00F0FF', rimI: 2.2,\n sky: '#38BDF8', ground: '#0F172A', hemiI: 0.80,\n shadowBox: 50, target: [0, 35, 0]\n });\n\n // Secondary Warm Gold Rim from rear-right\n const warmRim = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#F59E0B', 2.0);\n warmRim.position.set(-28, 48, -32);\n scene.add(warmRim);\n\n // Soft Front Fill from lower-left\n const frontFill = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#93C5FD', 0.75);\n frontFill.position.set(-18, // Iconic Vibrant Taxi Yellow\n const colCharcoal = '#1E293B'; // Dark Trim\n const colCyan = '#00F0FF'; // High-tech Cyan\n const colAmber = '#F59E0B'; // Hazard Amber\n const colBrake = '#FF0044'; // Crimson Taillight\n\n const matBody = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colYellow, roughness: 0.28, metalness: 0.35, envMapIntensity: 1.4\n });\n\n const matDark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colCharcoal, roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.55\n });\n\n const matChecker = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: T.taxiChecker(), roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.25\n });\n\n const matGlass = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({\n color: '#0284C7', roughness: 0.08, transmission: 0.70,\n thickness: 0.4, transparent: true, opacity: 0.75, metalness: 0.15\n });\n\n const matNeon = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colCyan, emissive: colCyan, emissiveIntensity: 2.0, roughness: 0.1\n });\n\n const matAmber = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colAmber, emissive: colAmber, emissiveIntensity: 2.4, roughness: 0.1\n });\n\n const matHeadlight = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: '#F8FAFC', emissive: '#E0F2FE', emissiveIntensity: 2.5\n });\n\n const matTaillight = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: colBrake, emissive: colBrake, emissiveIntensity: 2.2\n });\n\n const mkMesh = (geo, mat, pos = [0,0,0], rot = [0,0,0], parent = g) => {\n const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);\n m.position.set(...pos);\n m.rotation.set(...rot);\n m.castShadow = true;\n m.receiveShadow = true;\n parent.add(m);\n return m;\n };\n\n // ==========================================\n // 1. MAIN TAXI CHASSIS & LOWER TRAY\n // ==========================================\n // Lower dark skid tray (Length 3.8m, Width 1.9m, Height 0.22m)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.9, 0.22, 3.8, 0.04), matDark, [0, 0.28, 0]);\n\n // Main Yellow Body Tub\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.82, 0.48, 3.7, 0.06), matBody, [0, 0.58, 0]);\n\n // Checkerboard Beltline Stripe (Runs along left and right side)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.14, 3.5, 0.01), matChecker, [-0.92, 0.65, 0]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.04, 0.14, 3.5, 0.01), matChecker, [0.92, 0.65, 0]);\n\n // Front Sloped Hood (Chunky friendly bevel)\n const hood = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.68, 0.26, 1.1, 0.05), matBody, [0, 0.68, 1.3]);\n hood.rotation.x = D(-8);\n\n // Front Grille & Bumper\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.75, 0.18, 0.15, 0.03), matDark, [0, 0.42, 1.88]);\n // Chrome / Yellow Grille Slats\n for (let y = 0.38; y <= 0.46; y += 0.04) {\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.9, 0.015, 0.02, 0.005), matAmber, [0, y, 1.95]);\n }\n\n // Front & Rear License Plates\n const plateMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: T.taxiPlate() });\n const fPlate = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.5, 0.24), plateMat);\n fPlate.position.set(0, 0.32, 1.96); g.add(fPlate);\n\n const rPlate = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.5, 0.24), plateMat);\n rPlate.position.set(0, 0.38, -1.91); rPlate.rotation.y = Math.PI; g.add(rPlate);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 2. CABIN GREENHOUSE & INTERIOR\n // ==========================================\n // Upright Wrap-Around Windshield (Steep friendly angle)\n const windshield = mkMesh(chamferBox(1.62, 0.52, 0.85, 0.04), matGlass, [0, 1.05, 0.52]);\n windshield.rotation.x = D(-24);\n\n // Passenger Cabin Greenhouse Body (Side windows & roof)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.62, 0.58, 1.8, 0.05), matGlass, [0, 1.12, -0.4]);\n\n // Yellow Roof Cap\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.65, 0.12, 2.3, 0.04), matBody, [0, 1.44, -0.15]);\n\n // Yellow A-Pillars & B-Pillars\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.55, 0.08, 0.02), matBody, [-0.78, 1.08, 0.75]).rotation.x = D(-24);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.55, 0.08, 0.02), matBody, [0.78, 1.08, 0.75]).rotation.x = D(-24);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.58, 0.10, 0.02), matBody, [-0.79, 1.12, -0.35]);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.08, 0.58, 0.10, 0.02), matBody, [0.79, 1.12, -0.35]);\n\n // Interior: Seats, Taxi Meter & Yoke\n const interior = new THREE.Group(); interior.position.set(0, 0.72, 0); g.add(interior);\n // Front Driver Seat (Left side)\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.42, 0.14, 0.44, 0.03), matDark, [-0.36, 0.10, 0.1], [0,0,0], interior);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.40, 0.50, 0.12, 0.03), matDark, [-0.36, 0.38, -0.1], [D(-10),0,0], interior);\n // Rear Passenger Bench Seat\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.35, 0.15, 0.50, 0.03), matDark, [0, 0.10, -0.85], [0,0,0], interior);\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.35, 0.52, 0.14, 0.03), matDark, [0, 0.38, -1.05], [D(-10),0,0], interior);\n\n // Dashboard & Glowing Taxi Meter Screen\n mkMesh(chamferBox(1.3, 0.22, 0.35, 0.02), matDark, [0, 0.25, 0.55], [0,0,0], interior);\n // Taxi Meter Fare Box\n const meterBox = mkMesh(chamferBox(0.24, 0.14, 0.08, 0.01), matAmber, [0.15, 0.42, 0.6], [D(-15), 0, 0], interior);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 3. ROOFTOP HOLOGRAPHIC TAXI SIGN\n // ==========================================\n const roofSignGrp = new THREE.Group(); roofSignGrp.position.set(0, 1.54, 0.05); g.add(roofSignGrp);\n // Aerodynamic Pod Base\n mkMesh(chamferBox(0.9, 0.10, 0.45, 0.02), matDark, [0, 0, 0], [0,0,0], roofSignGrp);\n\n // Dual-Sided Illuminated TAXI Sign\n const signMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: T.taxiRoofSign() });\n const signF = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.85, 0.32), signMat);\n signF.position.set(0, 0.18, 0.04); roofSignGrp.add(signF);\n\n const signB = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.85, 0.32), signMat);\n signB.position.set(0, 0.18, -0.04); signB.rotation.y = Math.PI; roofSignGrp.add(signB);\n\n // Flashing Amber Beacon on Top of Sign\n const beacon = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.08, 0.12, 16), matAmber);\n beacon.position.set(0, 0.38, 0);\n roofSignGrp.add(beacon);\n\n // ==========================================\n // 4. Visual Turnaround Master Sheet\n\n![Commuter Sky-Taxi Turnaround](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/taxi_master_sheet.png)\n\n### Turnaround Angle Breakdown\n1. **View 01 (Front 3/4 Hero)**: [taxi_angle_1_hero.png](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/taxi_angle_1_hero.png) \n *Features*: Vibrant taxi yellow chassis, checkerboard beltline, beveled hood, glowing round headlights, illuminated rooftop sign, front hover nacelles.\n2. **View 02 (Pure Side Profile)**: [taxi_angle_2_side.png](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/taxi_angle_2_side.png) \n *Features*: Iconic boxy Roblox silhouette, hover clearance height, dual passenger windows, side mirrors, lower magnetic rocker panels.\n3. **View 03 (Rear 3/4 Thrusters)**: [taxi_angle_3_rear.png](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/taxi_angle_3_rear.png) \n *Features*: Dual cylindrical ion thruster nozzles with `#00F0FF` glowing emitters, horizontal crimson brake bar, bumper license plate `CAB-42`.\n4. **View 04 (Front Head-On)**: [taxi_angle_4_front.png](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/taxi_angle_4_front.png) \n *Features*: Symmetrical wide-stance bumper, dual round chrome-bezeled headlights, horizontal orange grille ribs, windshield beveling.\n5. **View 05 (Top-Down 3/4 Elevated)**: [taxi_angle_5_top.png](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/taxi_angle_5_top.png) \n *Features*: Rooftop beacon sign (`[ TAXI ]` FARE: 50R // SKY-CAB), interior seating blockout, dashboard taxi meter visible through tinted glass canopy.\n\n---\n\n## 2.
