Sovereign Apex Citadel (Boss Tower + Floating Islands + Crystal Spire)\n// - Stepped Commercial Cyber-Towers (Tiered setbacks, helipads, holo-billboards)\n// - Residential Pod Highrises (\"Mini Houses\", balconies, ACs, solar arrays)\n// - High-Speed Maglev Sky-Train (Apex Express traversing elevated monorail)\n// - Suspended Sky-Highway System (Skyway 101, overhead digital sign gantry)\n// - Air Traffic Streams: Heavy Cargo Barges, Commuter Sky-Taxis, Neon Speeders\n// - Foreground Hero Speeder banking past camera lens with glowing thrusters\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { makeEngine, lightRig } from './core/engine.js';\nimport { createBeveledBox, chamferBox, Textures, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// Import our 8 modular assets\nimport { buildApexTower } from './apex_tower.js';\nimport { buildSteppedTower } from './stepped_tower.js';\nimport { buildPodHighrise } from './pod_highrise.js';\nimport { buildSkyTrain } from './sky_train.js';\nimport { buildSkyHighway } from './sky_highway.js';\nimport { buildCargoBarge } from './cargo_barge.js';\nimport { buildSkyTaxi } from './taxi.js';\nimport { buildNeonSpeeder } from './speeder.js';\n\nexport function buildMetropolisSkyline(options = {}) {\n const city = new THREE.Group();\n city.name = 'AethelgardMetropolis';\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 1. DEEP BACKGROUND: SOVEREIGN APEX CITADEL (BOSS TOWER)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const apexTower = buildApexTower();\n apexTower.scale.set(1.6, 1.6, 1.6);\n // Positioned in deep center-background towering into the cyber clouds\n apexTower.position.set(0, 0, -280);\n city.add(apexTower);\n\n // Distant Horizon Silhouette Towers (Flanking the Apex Citadel)\n const distantMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x080D18,\n roughness: 0.8,\n metalness: 0.5\n });\n\n const distantWindowTex = canvasTex('dist_win', 128, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#060A14'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n for (let y = 8; y < h; y += 16) {\n for (let x = 8; x < w; x += 12) {\n if ((x + y) % 5 === 0) {\n g.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.5 ? '#38BDF8' : '#F59E0B';\n g.fillRect(x, y, 4, 8);\n }\n }\n }\n }, [1, 4]);\n\n const matDistantTower = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x0C1220,\n map: distantWindowTex,\n roughness: 0.5\n });\n\n [\n [-80, -320, 1.3], [80, -320, 1.4],\n [-130, -350, 1.1], [130, -350, 1.2],\n [-45, -260, 0.9], [55, -270, 0.95]\n ].forEach(([x, z, s]) => {\n const dTower = createBeveledBox(16 * s, 70 * s, 16 * s, 0.2, 1, matDistantTower);\n dTower.position.set(x, 35 * s, z);\n city.add(dTower);\n });\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 2. MID-GROUND SKYWAY CANYON: COMMERCIAL & RESIDENTIAL TOWERS\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Left Bank (West Flank: X < 0)\n // Commercial Tower 1 (Mid-distance, high setbacks)\n const commLeft1 = buildSteppedTower();\n commLeft1.scale.set(1.1, 1.1, 1.1);\n commLeft1.position.set(-42, 0, -140);\n commLeft1.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(commLeft1);\n\n // Residential Pod Stack 1 (Closer, high density)\n const podLeft1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podLeft1.position.set(-28, 0, -75);\n podLeft1.rotation.y = 0.5;\n city.add(podLeft1);\n\n // Residential Pod Stack 2 (Mid-distance)\n const podLeft2 = buildPodHighrise();\n podLeft2.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n podLeft2.position.set(-58, 0, -190);\n podLeft2.rotation.y = -0.25;\n city.add(podLeft2);\n\n // Right Bank (East Flank: X > 0)\n // Commercial Tower 2 (Main commercial focal tower with vertical holo-ad)\n const commRight1 = buildSteppedTower();\n commRight1.scale.set(1.15, 1.15, 1.15);\n commRight1.position.set(45, 0, -125);\n commRight1.rotation.y = -0.4;\n city.add(commRight1);\n\n // Residential Pod Stack 3 (Warm domestic contrast)\n const podRight1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podRight1.position.set(26, 0, -68);\n podRight1.rotation.y = -0.45;\n city.add(podRight1);\n\n // Commercial Tower 3 (Far right flank)\n const commRight2 = buildSteppedTower();\n commRight2.scale.set(0.95, 0.95, 0.95);\n commRight2.position.set(65, 0, -180);\n commRight2.rotation.y = 0.2;\n city.add(commRight2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 3. SUSPENDED SKY-BRIDGES (CONNECTING TOWERS ACROSS THE CHASM)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const matSkyBridge = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x1A2230,\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.55\n });\n\n const matBridgeGlass = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n roughness: 0.1,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.6\n });\n\n function createSkyBridge(fromPos, toPos, yPos) {\n const bridgeGroup = new THREE.Group();\n const vFrom = new THREE.Vector3(...fromPos, yPos);\n const vTo = new THREE.Vector3(...toPos, yPos);\n const len = vFrom.distanceTo(vTo);\n const mid = new THREE.Vector3().addVectors(vFrom, vTo).multiplyScalar(0.5);\n\n const bBox = createBeveledBox(len, 2.6, 2.8, 0.05, 1, matSkyBridge);\n bBox.position.copy(mid);\n bBox.lookAt(vTo);\n bBox.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n bridgeGroup.add(bBox);\n\n // Glowing glass observation strip along bridge sides\n const bGlass = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(len - 0.4, 1.2, 2.85), matBridgeGlass);\n bGlass.position.copy(mid);\n bGlass.lookAt(vTo);\n bGlass.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n bridgeGroup.add(bGlass);\n\n return bridgeGroup;\n }\n\n // Sky-Bridge 1: Connecting Left Commercial Tower to Left Pod Highrise at Y = 22m\n city.add(createSkyBridge([-42, -140], [-58, -190], 22.0));\n // Sky-Bridge 2: Connecting Right Commercial Tower to Right Pod Highrise at Y = 18m\n city.add(createSkyBridge([45, -125], [65, -180], 18.0));\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 4. HIGH-ALTITUDE TRANSIT: MAGLEV SKY-TRAIN ON ELEVATED MONORAIL\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const train1 = buildSkyTrain();\n train1.scale.set(0.85, 0.85, 0.85);\n // Positioned high above the canyon traversing horizontally at Y = 36m, Z = -155m\n train1.position.set(-6.0, 34.0, -155);\n train1.rotation.y = -0.15; // angled slightly towards downtown\n city.add(train1);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 5. MID-ALTITUDE ARTERIAL EXPRESSWAY: SKYWAY 101\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const highwaySection1 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection1.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection1.position.set(0, 4.0, -95);\n highwaySection1.rotation.y = 0.22; // diagonal crossing through the canyon\n city.add(highwaySection1);\n\n // Extension span of Highway to the left\n const highwaySection2 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection2.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection2.position.set(-34.0, 4.0, -102.5);\n highwaySection2.rotation.y = 0.22;\n city.add(highwaySection2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 6. PROCEDURAL AIR TRAFFIC STREAMS (ACTIVE SKYWAY)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Heavy Sky-Barge 1: Slow industrial freight hauler cruising low-mid\n const barge1 = buildCargoBarge();\n barge1.scale.set(0.65, 0.65, 0.65);\n barge1.position.set(-18.0, 16.0, -110);\n barge1.rotation.y = -0.3; // drifting outward\n city.add(barge1);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 1: Cruising along mid-altitude flight lane\n const taxi1 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi1.scale.set(0.85, 0.85, 0.85);\n taxi1.position.set(-8.0, 24.0, -70);\n taxi1.rotation.y = 0.15;\n city.add(taxi1);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 2: Approaching commercial tower helipad\n const taxi2 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi2.scale.set(0.7, 0.7, 0.7);\n taxi2.position.set(38.0, 14.5, -120);\n taxi2.rotation.y = -1.2; // turning toward helipad\n city.add(taxi2);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 3: Distant commuter in traffic stream\n const taxi3 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi3.scale.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);\n taxi3.position.set(12.0, 28.0, -170);\n taxi3.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(taxi3);\n\n // Neon Speeder 1 (Mid-ground speeder overtaking traffic)\n const midSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n midSpeeder.scale.set(0.75, 0.75, 0.75);\n midSpeeder.position.set(6.0, 22.0, -85);\n midSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.2;\n city.add(midSpeeder);\n\n // Neon Speeder 2 (Distant fast racer banking around left tower)\n const distSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n distSpeeder.scale.set(0.45, 0.45, 0.45);\n distSpeeder.position.set(-32.0, 26.0, -135);\n distSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.6;\n distSpeeder.rotation.z = -0.25; // banking turn\n city.add(distSpeeder);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 7. FOREGROUND HERO ELEMENT: CLOSE SPEEDER BANKING PAST CAMERA\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // High-speed speeder in foreground right quadrant, angled dynamically\n const heroSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n heroSpeeder.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n heroSpeeder.position.set(4.8, 19.5, -18.0);\n heroSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.28; // angled away from camera into the city\n heroSpeeder.rotation.z = -0.22; // dramatic bank angle\n heroSpeeder.rotation.x = -0.08; // nose diving slightly forward\n city.add(heroSpeeder);\n\n // Glowing Cyan Ion Thruster Jet Plumes behind Hero Speeder\n const matJetPlume = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.75\n });\n\n [-0.68, 0.68].forEach(tz => {\n const plume = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.32, 2.4, 12),\n matJetPlume\n );\n plume.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;\n plume.position.set(3.2, 19.5 + tz * 0.15, -18.0 - 1.8 + tz * 0.4);\n city.add(plume);\n });\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 8. BEDROCK VOID BASE & LOWER DIGITAL ABYSS (Y: -10 to -2)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Colossal floating bedrock slab supporting the city above the void\n const matBedrock = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x080B12,\n roughness: 0.9,\n metalness: 0.2\n });\n\n const bedrockSlab = createBeveledBox(300, 12, 400, 0.5, 1, matBedrock);\n THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00FF88,\n wireframe: true,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.18\n });\n const voidGrid = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(350, 450, 24, 28), voidGridMat);\n ============================================================================\n// THE GLITCH MARKET — EPISODE 1 // SHOT 1: AETHELGARD METROPOLIS SKYLINE\n// High-Density Multi-Layered Urban Assembly:\n// - Deep Background: Sovereign Apex Citadel (Boss Tower + 3 Floating Islands + Crystal Spire)\n// - Mid-Ground: Dense canyon of Stepped Commercial Towers, Residential Pod Highrises (\"Mini Houses\")\n// - Transit Corridors: High-Speed Maglev Train on elevated monorail, Suspended Skyway 101\n// - Mid-Air Traffic: Commuter Sky-Taxis, Heavy Cargo Barge, racing Neon Speeders\n// - Foreground: Hero Speeder banking dynamically with glowing cyan ion plumes\n// - Underbelly: The Glitch Void with digital wireframe grid & upward cyan light shafts\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { createBeveledBox, chamferBox, Textures, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// Modular Assets\nimport { buildApexTower } from './apex_tower.js';\nimport { buildSteppedTower } from './stepped_tower.js';\nimport { buildPodHighrise } from './pod_highrise.js';\nimport { buildSkyTrain } from './sky_train.js';\nimport { buildSkyHighway } from './sky_highway.js';\nimport { buildCargoBarge } from './cargo_barge.js';\nimport { buildSkyTaxi } from './taxi.js';\nimport { buildNeonSpeeder } from './speeder.js';\n\nexport function buildMetropolisSkyline(options = {}) {\n const city = new THREE.Group();\n city.name = 'AethelgardMetropolis';\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 1. DEEP BACKGROUND: SOVEREIGN APEX CITADEL (BOSS TOWER)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const apexTower = buildApexTower();\n apexTower.scale.set(1.5, 1.5, 1.5);\n // Positioned in deep center-background towering into the cyber clouds\n apexTower.position.set(0, 0, -260);\n city.add(apexTower);\n\n // Distant Horizon Silhouette Towers with glowing office windows\n const distantWindowTex = canvasTex('dist_win_dense', 128, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#060B18'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n for (let y = 6; y < h; y += 12) {\n for (let x = 6; x < w; x += 10) {\n if ((x * 3 + y * 7) % 4 !== 0) {\n g.fillStyle = (x + y) % 3 === 0 ? '#38BDF8' : '#F59E0B';\n g.fillRect(x, y, 5, 7);\n }\n }\n }\n }, [2, 6]);\n\n const matDistantTower = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x0A1020,\n map: distantWindowTex,\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.5\n });\n\n [\n [-65, -300, 1.3], [65, -300, 1.35],\n [-110, -340, 1.1], [110, -340, 1.15],\n [-38, -230, 0.9], [42, -235, 0.95]\n ].forEach(([x, z, s]) => {\n const dTower = createBeveledBox(14 * s, 85 * s, 14 * s, 0.2, 1, matDistantTower);\n dTower.position.set(x, 42 * s, z);\n city.add(dTower);\n });\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 2. MID-GROUND CANYON: COMMERCIAL TOWERS & POD HIGH-RISES (DENSE LAYOUT)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Left Flank (West)\n // Stepped Commercial Tower 1 (Mid-left with facing corporate holo-billboard)\n const commLeft1 = buildSteppedTower();\n commLeft1.scale.set(1.05, 1.05, 1.05);\n commLeft1.position.set(-36, 0, -115);\n commLeft1.rotation.y = 0.45;\n city.add(commLeft1);\n\n // Residential Pod Highrise 1 (Closer left with warm domestic windows & balconies)\n const podLeft1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podLeft1.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n podLeft1.position.set(-22, 2.0, -65);\n podLeft1.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(podLeft1);\n\n // Distant Pod Highrise 2 (Deep left)\n const podLeft2 = buildPodHighrise();\n podLeft2.scale.set(0.85, 0.85, 0.85);\n podLeft2.position.set(-48, 0, -170);\n podLeft2.rotation.y = -0.3;\n city.add(podLeft2);\n\n // Right Flank (East — framing the right side of the vertical shot)\n // Residential Pod Highrise 3 (Close right foreground mid-tier)\n const podRight1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podRight1.scale.set(1.05, 1.05, 1.05);\n podRight1.position.set(22, 0, -55);\n podRight1.rotation.y = -0.5;\n city.add(podRight1);\n\n // Stepped Commercial Tower 2 (Main commercial highrise on right)\n const commRight1 = buildSteppedTower();\n commRight1.scale.set(1.1, 1.1, 1.1);\n commRight1.position.set(38, 0, -110);\n commRight1.rotation.y = -0.4;\n city.add(commRight1);\n\n // Stepped Commercial Tower 3 (Deep right skyline)\n const commRight2 = buildSteppedTower();\n commRight2.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n commRight2.position.set(52, 0, -165);\n commRight2.rotation.y = 0.25;\n city.add(commRight2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 3. SUSPENDED SKY-BRIDGES (CONNECTING TOWERS ACROSS THE VOID)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const matSkyBridge = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x1A2230,\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.55\n });\n\n const matBridgeGlass = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n roughness: 0.1,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.6\n });\n\n function createSkyBridge(fromPos, toPos, yPos) {\n const bridgeGroup = new THREE.Group();\n const vFrom = new THREE.Vector3(...fromPos, yPos);\n const vTo = new THREE.Vector3(...toPos, yPos);\n const len = vFrom.distanceTo(vTo);\n const mid = new THREE.Vector3().addVectors(vFrom, vTo).multiplyScalar(0.5);\n\n const bBox = createBeveledBox(len, 2.6, 2.8, 0.05, 1, matSkyBridge);\n bBox.position.copy(mid);\n bBox.lookAt(vTo);\n bBox.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n bridgeGroup.add(bBox);\n\n const bGlass = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(len - 0.4, 1.2, 2.85), matBridgeGlass);\n bGlass.position.copy(mid);\n bGlass.lookAt(vTo);\n bGlass.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n bridgeGroup.add(bGlass);\n\n return bridgeGroup;\n }\n\n city.add(createSkyBridge([-36, -115], [-22, -65], 20.0));\n city.add(createSkyBridge([22, -55], [38, -110], 18.0));\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 4. HIGH-ALTITUDE TRANSIT: HIGH-SPEED MAGLEV SKY-TRAIN (APEX EXPRESS)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const train1 = buildSkyTrain();\n train1.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n // Gliding horizontally across the high canyon at Y = 36m, Z = -145m\n train1.position.set(-4.0, 34.0, -145);\n train1.rotation.y = -0.12;\n city.add(train1);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 5. MID-ALTITUDE ARTERIAL EXPRESSWAY: SKYWAY 101\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Suspended high above the void at Y = 12m\n const highwaySection1 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection1.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection1.position.set(0, 12.0, -85);\n highwaySection1.rotation.y = 0.24;\n city.add(highwaySection1);\n\n const highwaySection2 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection2.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection2.position.set(-34.0, 12.0, -93);\n highwaySection2.rotation.y = 0.24;\n city.add(highwaySection2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 6. PROCEDURAL AIR TRAFFIC STREAMS (ACTIVE SKYWAY)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Heavy Cargo Hauler (Titan-88): Cruising mid-low with shipping containers\n const barge1 = buildCargoBarge();\n barge1.scale.set(0.65, 0.65, 0.65);\n barge1.position.set(-16.0, 20.0, -105);\n barge1.rotation.y = -0.25;\n city.add(barge1);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 1: Cruising along mid-altitude flight corridor\n const taxi1 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi1.scale.set(0.85, 0.85, 0.85);\n taxi1.position.set(-6.0, 26.0, -60);\n taxi1.rotation.y = 0.2;\n city.add(taxi1);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 2: Approaching commercial tower helipad on right\n const taxi2 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi2.scale.set(0.75, 0.75, 0.75);\n taxi2.position.set(32.0, 21.0, -100);\n taxi2.rotation.y = -1.1;\n city.add(taxi2);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 3: Distant commuter in traffic stream\n const taxi3 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi3.scale.set(0.55, 0.55, 0.55);\n taxi3.position.set(14.0, 30.0, -160);\n taxi3.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(taxi3);\n\n // Neon Speeder 1 (Mid-ground speeder overtaking traffic)\n const midSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n midSpeeder.scale.set(0.75, 0.75, 0.75);\n midSpeeder.position.set(5.0, 23.0, -78);\n midSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.25;\n city.add(midSpeeder);\n\n // Neon Speeder 2 (Distant fast racer banking around left tower)\n const distSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n distSpeeder.scale.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);\n distSpeeder.position.set(-28.0, 28.0, -130);\n distSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.55;\n distSpeeder.rotation.z = -0.28;\n city.add(distSpeeder);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 7. FOREGROUND HERO ELEMENT: CLOSE SPEEDER BANKING PAST CAMERA\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Dynamic sports car banking sharply past the right foreground\n const heroSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n heroSpeeder.scale.set(1.15, 1.15, 1.15);\n heroSpeeder.position.set(5.2, 17.8, -16.0);\n heroSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.32; // angled into the urban canyon\n heroSpeeder.rotation.z = -0.26; // dramatic banking lean\n heroSpeeder.rotation.x = -0.10; // nose down accelerating\n city.add(heroSpeeder);\n\n // Glowing Cyan Ion Thruster Jet Plumes behind Hero Speeder\n const matJetPlume = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.85\n });\n\n [-0.78, 0.78].forEach(tz => {\n const plume = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.38, 2.8, 12),\n matJetPlume\n );\n plume.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;\n plume.position.set(3.4, 17.8 + tz * 0.18, -16.0 - 2.1 + tz * 0.45);\n city.add(plume);\n });\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 8. THE GLITCH VOID & SUSPENDED FLOATING BEDROCK FOUNDATIONS\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Instead of a flat tabletop, each skyscraper cluster sits on floating voxel bedrock\n const matVoxelBedrock = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x070B14,\n roughness: 0.85,\n metalness: 0.3\n });\n\n function createFloatingIsland(x, z, w, d, h) {\n const islandGroup = new THREE.Group();\n // Stepped beveled strata\n const topCap = createBeveledBox(w, h * 0.3, d, 0.15, 1, matVoxelBedrock);\n topCap.position.set(x, -h * 0.15, z);\n islandGroup.add(topCap);\n\n const midLayer = createBeveledBox(w * 0.8, h * 0.4, d * 0.8, 0.2, 1, matVoxelBedrock);\n midLayer.position.set(x, -h * 0.45, z);\n islandGroup.add(midLayer);\n\n const botKeel = createBeveledBox(w * 0.5, h * 0.3, d * 0.5, 0.25, 1, matVoxelBedrock);\n botKeel.position.set(x, -h * 0.75, z);\n islandGroup.add(botKeel);\n\n return islandGroup;\n }\n\n // Floating foundations under major tower clusters\n city.add(createFloatingIsland(-32, -100, 48, 60, 18));\n city.add(createFloatingIsland(34, -95, 52, 65, 20));\n city.add(createFloatingIsland(0, -250, 75, 80, 28));\n\n // The Glitch Void Bottom Grid (Deep infinite abyss at Y = -40m)\n const voidGridMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00FF88,\n wireframe: true,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.22\n });\n const voidGrid = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(500, 600, 32, 40), voidGridMat);\n voidGrid.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n voidGrid.position.set(0, -42.0, -180);\n city.add(voidGrid);\n\n // Vertical Cyan & Violet Upward Light Shafts from the Underbelly Void\n const lightShaftMatCyan = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.12,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n\n const lightShaftMatPurple = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x8B5CF6,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.10,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n\n [\n [-15, -120, lightShaftMatCyan],\n [18, -135, lightShaftMatPurple],\n [-4, -190, lightShaftMatCyan],\n [8, -80, lightShaftMatCyan]\n ].forEach(([sx, sz, smat]) => {\n const beam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.8, 3.5, 90, 16, 1, true), smat);\n beam.position.set(sx, 10.0, sz);\n city.add(beam);\n });\n\n return city;\n}\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini ============================================================================\n// THE GLITCH MARKET — EPISODE 1 // SHOT 1 MULTI-ANGLE RENDERER & AUDIT COMPOSITOR\n// Produces:\n// 1. shot1_keyframe_01.png (1080x1920 Master Vertical Keyframe)\n// 2. shot1_angle_2_horizon.png (1920x800 Wide Cinematic Horizon)\n// 3. shot1_angle_3_lowangle.png (1080x1920 Low-Angle Void Look-Up)\n// 4. shot1_metropolis_master.png (2400x1350 4-Panel Master Production Audit Sheet)\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { makeEngine, lightRig } from './core/engine.js';\nimport { buildMetropolisSkyline } from './shot1_skyline.js';\n\nfunction canvasToBlob(canvas) {\n return new Promise((res) => canvas.toBlob(res, 'image/png'));\n}\n\nasync function uploadImage(name, blob) {\n await fetch(`/save?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {\n method: 'POST',\n body: blob,\n });\n}\n\nasync function init() {\n const masterCanvas = document.getElementById('viewCanvas');\n const masterCtx = masterCanvas.getContext('2d');\n\n // Build the 3D Metropolis Scene\n const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n scene.background = new THREE.Color('#03050C');\n // Atmospheric Deep Void Fog\n scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2('#03050C', 0.0032);\n\n // Directional High-Altitude City Key Light\n const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#FFFBE8', 3.0);\n keyLight.position.set(45, 85, -60);\n keyLight.target.position.set(0, 20, -130);\n scene.add(keyLight);\n scene.add(keyLight.target);\n\n // Intense Cyan Underbelly Void Rim Light\n const cyanRim = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#00F0FF', 3.6);\n cyanRim.position.set(-50, -10, -110);\n cyanRim.target.position.set(0, 22, -130);\n scene.add(cyanRim);\n scene.add(cyanRim.target);\n\n // Warm Amber Commercial Fill Light\n const amberFill = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#F59E0B', 2.4);\n amberFill.position.set(55, 30, -80);\n scene.add(amberFill);\n\n // Ambient Sky/Ground Light (Pure void ground, no brown bounce)\n const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight('#38BDF8', '#020408', 0.85);\n scene.add(hemi);\n\n // Build the complete multi-asset city\n const city = buildMetropolisSkyline();\n scene.add(city);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // RENDER PASS 1: MASTER VERTICAL KEYFRAME 01 (1080 x 1920)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const vertCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n vertCanvas.width = 1080;\n vertCanvas.height = 1920;\n const vertEngine = makeEngine(vertCanvas, { w: 1080, h: 1920, samples: 4, shadowSize: 2048 });\n\n const camVert = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(52, 1080 / 1920, 0.1, 800);\n camVert.position.set(7.6, 21.5, -2.0);\n camVert.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(0.0, 18.0, -135.0));\n\n vertEngine.render(scene, camVert, {\n bloom: 0.35,\n bloomThreshold: 1.15,\n bloomRadius: 0.52,\n exposure: 1.10,\n sat: 1.28,\n vignette: 0.18,\n focus: 32.0,\n aperture: 0.0001\n });\n\n const vertBlob = await canvasToBlob(vertCanvas);\n await uploadImage('shot1_keyframe_01.png', vertBlob);\n console.log('SAVED: shot1_keyframe_01.png');\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // RENDER PASS 2: WIDE CINEMATIC 2.39:1 HORIZON VIEW (1920 x 800)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const wideCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n wideCanvas.width = 1920;\n wideCanvas.height = 800;\n const wideEngine = makeEngine(wideCanvas, { w: 1920, h: 800, samples: 4, shadowSize: 2048 });\n\n const camWide = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, 1920 / 800, 0.1, 800);\n camWide.position.set(0.0, 32.0, ============================================================================\n// THE GLITCH MARKET — EPISODE 1 // SHOT 1: AETHELGARD METROPOLIS SKYLINE\n// High-Density Multi-Layered Urban Assembly:\n// - Deep Background: Sovereign Apex Citadel (Boss Tower + 3 Floating Islands + Crystal Spire)\n// - Mid-Ground: Dense canyon of Stepped Commercial Towers, Residential Pod Highrises (\"Mini Houses\")\n// - Transit Corridors: High-Speed Maglev Train on elevated monorail, Suspended Skyway 101\n// - Mid-Air Traffic: Commuter Sky-Taxis, Heavy Cargo Barge, racing Neon Speeders\n// - Foreground: Hero Speeder banking dynamically with glowing cyan ion plumes\n// - Underbelly: The Glitch Void with digital wireframe grid & upward cyan light shafts\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { createBeveledBox, chamferBox, Textures, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// Modular Assets\nimport { buildApexTower } from './apex_tower.js';\nimport { buildSteppedTower } from './stepped_tower.js';\nimport { buildPodHighrise } from './pod_highrise.js';\nimport { buildSkyTrain } from './sky_train.js';\nimport { buildSkyHighway } from './sky_highway.js';\nimport { buildCargoBarge } from './cargo_barge.js';\nimport { buildSkyTaxi } from './taxi.js';\nimport { buildNeonSpeeder } from './speeder.js';\n\nexport function buildMetropolisSkyline(options = {}) {\n const city = new THREE.Group();\n city.name = 'AethelgardMetropolis';\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 1. DEEP BACKGROUND: SOVEREIGN APEX CITADEL (BOSS TOWER)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const apexTower = buildApexTower();\n apexTower.scale.set(1.5, 1.5, 1.5);\n apexTower.position.set(0, 0, -250);\n city.add(apexTower);\n\n // Distant Horizon Silhouette Towers with glowing office windows\n const distantWindowTex = canvasTex('dist_win_dense', 128, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#050A14'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n for (let y = 6; y < h; y += 12) {\n for (let x = 6; x < w; x += 10) {\n if ((x * 3 + y * 7) % 4 !== 0) {\n g.fillStyle = (x + y) % 3 === 0 ? '#38BDF8' : '#F59E0B';\n g.fillRect(x, y, 5, 7);\n }\n }\n }\n }, [2, 6]);\n\n const matDistantTower = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x080D1A,\n map: distantWindowTex,\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.5\n });\n\n [\n [-65, -290, 1.3], [65, -290, 1.35],\n [-110, -330, 1.1], [110, -330, 1.15],\n [-38, -220, 0.9], [42, -225, 0.95]\n ].forEach(([x, z, s]) => {\n const dTower = createBeveledBox(14 * s, 85 * s, 14 * s, 0.2, 1, matDistantTower);\n dTower.position.set(x, 42 * s, z);\n city.add(dTower);\n });\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 2. MID-GROUND CANYON: COMMERCIAL TOWERS & POD HIGH-RISES\n // Facing window facades toward camera for maximum visual density!\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Left Flank (West)\n // Stepped Commercial Tower 1 (Vertical Holo-Ad facing toward camera)\n const commLeft1 = buildSteppedTower();\n commLeft1.scale.set(1.05, 1.05, 1.05);\n commLeft1.position.set(-32, 2.0, -100);\n commLeft1.rotation.y = -0.25; // rotated so holo-billboard & windows face viewer!\n city.add(commLeft1);\n\n // Residential Pod Highrise 1 (Balconies & warm windows facing camera)\n const podLeft1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podLeft1.scale.set(1.05, 1.05, 1.05);\n podLeft1.position.set(-20, 2.0, -60);\n podLeft1.rotation.y = -0.15;\n city.add(podLeft1);\n\n // Distant Pod Highrise 2 (Deep left skyline)\n const podLeft2 = buildPodHighrise();\n podLeft2.scale.set(0.85, 0.85, 0.85);\n podLeft2.position.set(-46, 0, -160);\n podLeft2.rotation.y = 0.3;\n city.add(podLeft2);\n\n // Right Flank (East — framing the right side of the vertical shot)\n // Stepped Commercial Tower 2 (Main commercial highrise on right with helipad)\n const commRight1 = buildSteppedTower();\n commRight1.scale.set(1.1, 1.1, 1.1);\n commRight1.position.set(30, 2.0, -95);\n commRight1.rotation.y = 0.35; // windows and landing pad facing viewer!\n city.add(commRight1);\n\n // Residential Pod Highrise 3 (Close right foreground mid-tier with colorful mini-houses)\n const podRight1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podRight1.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n podRight1.position.set(22, 2.0, -52);\n podRight1.rotation.y = 0.45; // balconies facing camera!\n city.add(podRight1);\n\n // Stepped Commercial Tower 3 (Deep right skyline)\n const commRight2 = buildSteppedTower();\n commRight2.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n commRight2.position.set(50, 0, -155);\n commRight2.rotation.y = -0.2;\n city.add(commRight2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 3. SUSPENDED SKY-BRIDGES (CONNECTING TOWERS ACROSS THE VOID)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const matSkyBridge = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x1A2230,\n roughness: 0.45,\n metalness: 0.55\n });\n\n const matBridgeGlass = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n roughness: 0.1,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.65\n });\n\n function createSkyBridge(fromPos, toPos, yPos) {\n const bridgeGroup = new THREE.Group();\n const vFrom = new THREE.Vector3(...fromPos, yPos);\n const vTo = new THREE.Vector3(...toPos, yPos);\n const len = vFrom.distanceTo(vTo);\n const mid = new THREE.Vector3().addVectors(vFrom, vTo).multiplyScalar(0.5);\n\n const bBox = createBeveledBox(len, 2.6, 2.8, 0.05, 1, matSkyBridge);\n bBox.position.copy(mid);\n bBox.lookAt(vTo);\n bBox.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n bridgeGroup.add(bBox);\n\n const bGlass = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(len - 0.4, 1.2, 2.85), matBridgeGlass);\n bGlass.position.copy(mid);\n bGlass.lookAt(vTo);\n bGlass.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n bridgeGroup.add(bGlass);\n\n return bridgeGroup;\n }\n\n city.add(createSkyBridge([-32, -100], [-20, -60], 22.0));\n city.add(createSkyBridge([22, -52], [30, -95], 20.0));\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 4. HIGH-ALTITUDE TRANSIT: HIGH-SPEED MAGLEV SKY-TRAIN (APEX EXPRESS)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const train1 = buildSkyTrain();\n train1.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n // Gliding horizontally across the high canyon at Y = 35m, Z = -135m\n train1.position.set(-2.0, 34.0, -135);\n train1.rotation.y = -0.10;\n city.add(train1);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 5. MID-ALTITUDE ARTERIAL EXPRESSWAY: SKYWAY 101\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Suspended high above the void at Y = 14m\n const highwaySection1 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection1.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection1.position.set(0, 13.0, -78);\n highwaySection1.rotation.y = 0.22;\n city.add(highwaySection1);\n\n const highwaySection2 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection2.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection2.position.set(-34.0, 13.0, -85.5);\n highwaySection2.rotation.y = 0.22;\n city.add(highwaySection2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 6. PROCEDURAL AIR TRAFFIC STREAMS (ACTIVE SKYWAY)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Heavy Cargo Hauler (Titan-88): Cruising mid-low with shipping containers\n const barge1 = buildCargoBarge();\n barge1.scale.set(0.65, 0.65, 0.65);\n barge1.position.set(-14.0, 22.0, -95);\n barge1.rotation.y = -0.22;\n city.add(barge1);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 1: Cruising along mid-altitude flight corridor\n const taxi1 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi1.scale.set(0.85, 0.85, 0.85);\n taxi1.position.set(-5.0, 26.0, -55);\n taxi1.rotation.y = 0.18;\n city.add(taxi1);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 2: Approaching commercial tower helipad on right\n const taxi2 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi2.scale.set(0.75, 0.75, 0.75);\n taxi2.position.set(28.0, 22.0, -90);\n taxi2.rotation.y = -1.1;\n city.add(taxi2);\n\n // Commuter Sky-Taxi 3: Distant commuter in traffic stream\n const taxi3 = buildSkyTaxi();\n taxi3.scale.set(0.55, 0.55, 0.55);\n taxi3.position.set(12.0, 31.0, -150);\n taxi3.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(taxi3);\n\n // Neon Speeder 1 (Mid-ground speeder overtaking traffic)\n const midSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n midSpeeder.scale.set(0.75, 0.75, 0.75);\n midSpeeder.position.set(4.0, 24.0, -72);\n midSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.25;\n city.add(midSpeeder);\n\n // Neon Speeder 2 (Distant fast racer banking around left tower)\n const distSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n distSpeeder.scale.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);\n distSpeeder.position.set(-25.0, 29.0, -120);\n distSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.55;\n distSpeeder.rotation.z = -0.28;\n city.add(distSpeeder);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 7. FOREGROUND HERO ELEMENT: CLOSE SPEEDER BANKING PAST CAMERA\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const heroSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n heroSpeeder.scale.set(1.2, 1.2, 1.2);\n heroSpeeder.position.set(4.6, 17.5, -15.0);\n heroSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.30;\n heroSpeeder.rotation.z = -0.26;\n heroSpeeder.rotation.x = -0.10;\n city.add(heroSpeeder);\n\n // Glowing Cyan Ion Thruster Jet Plumes behind Hero Speeder\n const matJetPlume = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.85\n });\n\n [-0.82, 0.82].forEach(tz => {\n const plume = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.40, 3.2, 12),\n matJetPlume\n );\n plume.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;\n plume.position.set(2.8, 17.5 + tz * 0.18, -15.0 - 2.2 + tz * 0.45);\n city.add(plume);\n });\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 8. THE GLITCH VOID & FLOATING OBSIDIAN BEDROCK ISLANDS\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Dark reflective obsidian bedrock under tower bases (No brown!)\n const matVoxelBedrock = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x0A0F1A,\n roughness: 0.35,\n metalness: 0.7\n });\n\n function createFloatingIsland(x, z, w, d, h) {\n const islandGroup = new THREE.Group();\n const topCap = createBeveledBox(w, h * 0.3, d, 0.15, 1, matVoxelBedrock);\n topCap.position.set(x, -h * 0.15, z);\n islandGroup.add(topCap);\n\n const midLayer = createBeveledBox(w * 0.8, h * 0.4, d * 0.8, 0.2, 1, matVoxelBedrock);\n midLayer.position.set(x, -h * 0.45, z);\n islandGroup.add(midLayer);\n\n const botKeel = createBeveledBox(w * 0.5, h * 0.3, d * 0.5, 0.25, 1, matVoxelBedrock);\n botKeel.position.set(x, -h * 0.75, z);\n islandGroup.add(botKeel);\n\n return islandGroup;\n }\n\n city.add(createFloatingIsland(-28, -90, 42, 55, 16));\n city.add(createFloatingIsland(28, -85, 46, 58, 18));\n city.add(createFloatingIsland(0, -240, 70, 75, 26));\n\n // The Glitch Void Bottom Grid (Deep infinite abyss at Y = -35m)\n const voidGridMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n wireframe: true,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.28\n });\n const voidGrid = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(600, 700, 36, 44), voidGridMat);\n voidGrid.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n voidGrid.position.set(0, -35.0, -160);\n city.add(voidGrid);\n\n // Soft Upward Cyan Light Shafts positioned in the deep background (Z < -130)\n const lightShaftMatCyan = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.05,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n\n const lightShaftMatPurple = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x8B5CF6,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.04,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n\n [\n [-24, -180, lightShaftMatCyan],\n [26, -195, lightShaftMatPurple],\n [-8, -230, lightShaftMatCyan],\n [10, -150, lightShaftMatCyan]\n ].forEach(([sx, sz, smat]) => {\n const beam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2, 4.5, 110, 16, 1, true), smat);\n '#38BDF8' : '#F5D0FE';\n g.fillRect(sx, sy, sz, sz);\n }\n\n // Horizon City Smog Neon Glow\n const hGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, h * 0.75, 0, h);\n hGrad.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.0)');\n hGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.22)');\n hGrad.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35)');\n g.fillStyle = hGrad;\n g.fillRect(0, h * 0.75, w, h * 0.25);\n }, [1, 1]),\n\n // Sprawling Lower City Ground Grid (Dense Metropolis Map)\n citySprawlGround: () => canvasTex('city_sprawl', 1024, 1024, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#050811'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Dense grid of city blocks with micro-windows\n const bSize = 64;\n for (let bx = 0; bx < w; bx += bSize) {\n for (let by = 0; by < h; by += bSize) {\n // Block footprint\n g.fillStyle = '#0A0F1D';\n g.fillRect(bx + 4, by + 4, bSize - 8, bSize - 8);\n\n // Thousands of tiny rooftop & building window points\n for (let ix = bx + 8; ix < bx + bSize - 8; ix += 8) {\n for (let iy = by + 8; iy < by + bSize - 8; iy += 8) {\n if ((ix * 7 + iy * 13) % 3 !== 0) {\n const col = (ix + iy) % 4 === 0 ? Cyber Celestial Skybox: Nebula clouds, celestial data moon, voxel starfield, cyan horizon glow\n// - Sprawling Lower City Underbelly: 800m glowing street grid, 25+ ground cyber-blocks, neon conduits\n// - Horizon Megacity Silhouettes: 40+ layered distant skyscrapers with dense glowing window matrices\n// - Mid-Ground Canyon: Stepped Commercial Towers, Pod Highrises, crisscrossing Sky-Bridges\n// - Giant Holographic Billboards: GLITCH MARKET, SHADOW MONARCH, AETHELGARD\n// - Multi-Tier Transit: High-Speed Maglev Train, Dual Skyways (Y=14m, Y=22m) with digital gantries\n// - Swarming Air Traffic: 18+ Sky-Taxis, Cargo Barges, and Speeders with light trails\n// - Foreground Hero Speeder: Monarch-01 banking sharply with glowing cyan ion plumes\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { createBeveledBox, chamferBox, Textures, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// Modular Assets\nimport { buildApexTower } from './apex_tower.js';\nimport { buildSteppedTower } from './stepped_tower.js';\nimport { buildPodHighrise } from './pod_highrise.js';\nimport { buildSkyTrain } from './sky_train.js';\nimport { buildSkyHighway } from './sky_highway.js';\nimport { buildCargoBarge } from './cargo_barge.js';\nimport { buildSkyTaxi } from './taxi.js';\nimport { buildNeonSpeeder } from './speeder.js';\n\nexport function buildMetropolisSkyline(options = {}) {\n const city = new THREE.Group();\n city.name = 'AethelgardMetropolis';\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 1. GRAND CYBER SKY BACKDROP DOME (NEBULA, DATA MOON & STARFIELD)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const skyGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(550, 550, 450, 48, 1, true);\n const skyMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n map: Textures.cyberSkyBackdrop(),\n side: THREE.BackSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const skyDome = new THREE.Mesh(skyGeo, skyMat);\n skyDome.position.set(0, 120, -180);\n city.add(skyDome);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 2. SPRAWLING LOWER CITY UNDERBELLY (800m x 800m DENSE METROPOLIS GRID)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: Textures.citySprawlGround(),\n roughness: 0.35,\n metalness: 0.5\n });\n\n const cityGround = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(800, 800), groundMat);\n cityGround.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n cityGround.position.set(0, -6.0, -180);\n city.add(cityGround);\n\n // Ground-Level Cyber-Blocks & Industrial Slum Pods (25+ low-to-mid buildings)\n const matLowerBlock = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x111624,\n roughness: 0.55,\n metalness: 0.4\n });\n\n const matNeonSign = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00F0FF });\n const matOrangeSign = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xF59E0B });\n const matMagentaSign = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xEC4899 });\n\n for (let gx = -160; gx <= 160; gx += 40) {\n for (let gz = -240; gz <= -40; gz += 45) {\n if (Math.abs(gx) > 20 || gz < -140) {\n const bHeight = 8 + ((Math.abs(gx) * 3 + Math.abs(gz)) % 18);\n const bWidth = 18 + (Math.abs(gx) % 12);\n const bDepth = 18 + (Math.abs(gz) % 12);\n\n const lowerBlock = createBeveledBox(bWidth, bHeight, bDepth, 0.1, 1, matLowerBlock);\n lowerBlock.position.set(gx + ((gz % 7) * 2), bHeight / 2 - 6.0, gz);\n city.add(lowerBlock);\n\n // Neon storefront signs and rooftop vents on lower blocks\n const signCol = (gx + gz) % 3 === 0 ? matNeonSign : (gx + gz) % 3 === 1 ? matOrangeSign : matMagentaSign;\n const sign = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(bWidth * 0.7, 0.4, 0.2), signCol);\n sign.position.set(gx + ((gz % 7) * 2), bHeight - 7.5, gz + bDepth / 2 + 0.12);\n city.add(sign);\n\n // Rooftop AC / Machinery box with studs\n const roofUnit = createBeveledBox(4.0, 1.6, 4.0, 0.05, 1, matLowerBlock);\n roofUnit.position.set(gx + ((gz % 7) * 2), bHeight - 5.2, gz);\n city.add(roofUnit);\n }\n }\n }\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 3. HORIZON MEGACITY SKYLINE (40+ DISTANT TOWERS ACROSS ENTIRE HORIZON)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const matDistantTower = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: Textures.denseHighriseFacade(),\n roughness: 0.35,\n metalness: 0.45\n });\n\n const matAviationRed = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFF1744 });\n const matAviationCyan = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00F0FF });\n\n // Generate a continuous dense arc of skyscrapers across the horizon\n for (let i = -20; i <= 20; i++) {\n const angle = (i / 20) * (Math.PI * 0.45);\n const dist = 320 + Math.abs(i) * 5 + ((i * 17) % 25);\n const tx = Math.sin(angle) * dist;\n const tz = -Math.cos(angle) * dist - 30;\n const th = 70 + ((Math.abs(i) * 11) % 65);\n const tw = 16 + (Math.abs(i) % 10);\n const td = 16 + ((i * 7) % 10);\n\n const horizonTower = createBeveledBox(tw, th, td, 0.2, 1, matDistantTower);\n horizonTower.position.set(tx, th / 2 - 6.0, tz);\n city.add(horizonTower);\n\n // Flashing summit aviation beacon\n const beaconMat = i % 2 === 0 ? matAviationRed : matAviationCyan;\n const beacon = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.8, 8, 8), beaconMat);\n beacon.position.set(tx, th - 5.5, tz);\n city.add(beacon);\n\n // Slender roof antenna\n const ant = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.1, 0.25, 8.0, 6), matLowerBlock);\n ant.position.set(tx, th - 2.0, tz);\n city.add(ant);\n }\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 4. -0.22;\n city.add(commLeft1);\n\n // Stepped Commercial Tower 2 (Outer left)\n const commLeft2 = buildSteppedTower();\n commLeft2.scale.set(0.95, 0.95, 0.95);\n commLeft2.position.set(-68, 0, -165);\n commLeft2.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(commLeft2);\n\n // Residential Pod Highrise 1 (Near left with colorful mini-houses & warm windows)\n const podLeft1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podLeft1.scale.set(1.1, 1.1, 1.1);\n podLeft1.position.set(-22, 0, -62);\n podLeft1.rotation.y = -0.15;\n city.add(podLeft1);\n\n // Residential Pod Highrise 2 (Mid left)\n const podLeft2 = Ensuring the replacements meet the requirement of not feeling repetitive, even with modular repetition, is now the primary objective.\n\n\n","tools":[{"name":"write_file","args":{"Content":"// ============================================================================\n// THE GLITCH MARKET — 3D ASSETS: EXPANDED MODULAR BUILDING ARCHETYPES\n// 8 Brand-New Authentic Roblox UGC Building Models for Dense Megalopolis:\n// 1. Twin-Spire Gateway Tower (Dual hexagonal spires with cross-skybridge arch)\n// 2. Cantilevered Tetris Midrise (Interlocking staggered cantilever blocks)\n// 3. Hexagonal Data-Silo (Brutalist server monolith with vertical cooling fins)\n// 4. Sloped Wedge Sky-Blade (Aerodynamic angled skyscraper with diagonal trusses)\n// 5. Cylindrical Neo-Rotunda Tower (Concentric observation tiers & 360 wrap ticker)\n// 6. Compact Cyber-Shophouse Block (Low-rise street bodegas, neon awnings, roll-up doors, ACs)\n// 7. Stepped Terraced Apartment Block (Ziggurat stepped residential block with rooftop gardens)\n// 8. Industrial Power Substation (Heavy steel transformer gantry with glowing conduits)\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from '../vendor/three.module.js';\nimport { createBeveledBox, chamferBox, Textures, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// Common Palette Materials (Cached for performance)\nconst MATS = {\n darkConcrete: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x111622, roughness: 0.65, metalness: 0.35 }),\n steelAlloy: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1E2638, roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.6 }),\n lightPlate: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xCBD5E1, roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.4 }),\n terracotta: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xB91C1C, roughness: 0.5 }),\n cyberTeal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0D9488, roughness: 0.4 }),\n industrialAmber: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xD97706, roughness: 0.45 }),\n glassCyan: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00F0FF, roughness: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.65 }),\n glowCyan: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00F0FF }),\n glowAmber: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xF59E0B }),\n glowMagenta: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xEC4899 }),\n glowRed: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFF1744 }),\n glowGreen: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00FF88 }),\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 1. TWIN-SPIRE GATEWAY TOWER\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildTwinSpireTower(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'TwinSpireGatewayTower';\n const h = opts.height || 55;\n const w = opts.width || 22;\n const colAccent = opts.accentColor || MATS.glowCyan;\n\n const spireW = w * 0.38;\n const gap = w * 0.24;\n\n // Left & Right Spires\n [-gap / 2 - spireW / 2, gap / 2 + spireW / 2].forEach(x => {\n // Main Hexagonal Column\n const shaft = createBeveledBox(spireW, h * 0.85, spireW, 0.15, 2, MATS.steelAlloy);\n shaft.position.set(x, (h * 0.85) / 2, 0);\n root.add(shaft);\n\n // Vertical illuminated facade stripes\n const winStrip = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(spireW * 0.7, h * 0.8, 0.1), colAccent);\n winStrip.position.set(x, (h * 0.8) / 2 + 2, spireW / 2 + 0.06);\n root.add(winStrip);\n\n // Tapered Spire Needle Crown\n const needle = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(spireW * 0.45, h * 0.25, 6), MATS.lightPlate);\n needle.position.set(x, h * 0.85 + (h * 0.25) / 2, 0);\n root.add(needle);\n\n // Tip aviation light\n const beacon = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.35, 8, 8), MATS.glowRed);\n beacon.position.set(x, h * 0.98 + (h * 0.25) / 2, 0);\n root.add(beacon);\n });\n\n // High-Altitude Sky-Bridge Arch connecting the two spires at 75% height\n const bridge = createBeveledBox(w + 1.0, 3.8, spireW * 0.9, 0.08, 1, MATS.darkConcrete);\n bridge.position.set(0, h * 0.65, 0);\n root.add(bridge);\n\n const bridgeGlass = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w * 0.9, 2.0, spireW * 0.95), MATS.glassCyan);\n bridgeGlass.position.set(0, h * 0.65, 0);\n root.add(bridgeGlass);\n\n // Ground Atrium Base\n const base = createBeveledBox(w + 4, 6.0, spireW + 4, 0.2, 2, MATS.darkConcrete);\n base.position.set(0, 3.0, 0);\n root.add(base);\n\n return root;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 2. CANTILEVERED TETRIS MIDRISE (STACKED OFFSET BLOCKS)\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildTetrisMidrise(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'TetrisMidrise';\n const tiers = opts.tiers || 6;\n const blockSize = opts.blockSize || 7.0;\n\n const palettes = [MATS.darkConcrete, MATS.steelAlloy, MATS.cyberTeal, MATS.terracotta, MATS.industrialAmber];\n\n for (let i = 0; i < tiers; i++) {\n const y = i * (blockSize * 0.85) + (blockSize * 0.85) / 2;\n // Alternate cantilever shifts in X and Z\n const shiftX = (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * (i * 0.85);\n const shiftZ = ((i + 1) % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * (i * 0.65);\n const mat = palettes[i % palettes.length];\n\n const block = createBeveledBox(blockSize, blockSize * 0.8, blockSize, 0.1, 2, mat);\n block.position.set(shiftX, y, shiftZ);\n root.add(block);\n\n // Glowing window band on each block\n const win = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(blockSize - 0.8, blockSize * 0.35, blockSize + 0.12), MATS.glassCyan);\n win.position.set(shiftX, y, shiftZ);\n root.add(win);\n\n // Under-cantilever cyan downlight\n if (i > 0) {\n const downLight = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.0, 0.1, 2.0), MATS.glowCyan);\n downLight.position.set(shiftX, y - (blockSize * 0.4) - 0.05, shiftZ);\n root.add(downLight);\n }\n }\n\n return root;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 3. HEXAGONAL DATA-SILO (BRUTALIST SERVER MONOLITH)\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildHexDataSilo(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'HexDataSilo';\n const h = opts.height || 42;\n const radius = opts.radius || 7.5;\n\n // Hexagonal Prism Main Body\n const hexGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius * 1.1, h, 6);\n const hexBody = new THREE.Mesh(hexGeo, MATS.darkConcrete);\n hexBody.position.set(0, h / 2, 0);\n root.add(hexBody);\n\n // Vertical Heat Sink Cooling Fins running up the corners\n for (let a = 0; a < 6; a++) {\n const angle = (a / 6) * Math.PI * 2;\n const fx = Math.sin(angle) * (radius + 0.4);\n const fz = Math.cos(angle) * (radius + 0.4);\n\n const fin = createBeveledBox(0.3, h * 0.9, 1.2, 0.02, 1, MATS.steelAlloy);\n fin.position.set(fx, h / 2, fz);\n fin.rotation.y = angle;\n root.add(fin);\n }\n\n // Recessed Glowing Server Light Racks (Magenta & Cyan)\n for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) {\n const ry = (h * 0.2) + r * (h * 0.18);\n const rackBand = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius + 0.05, radius + 0.05, 1.4, 6),\n r % 2 === 0 ? MATS.glowCyan : MATS.glowMagenta\n );\n rackBand.position.set(0, ry, 0);\n root.add(rackBand);\n }\n\n // Heavy Machinery Rooftop Deck & Microwave Radar\n const roofDome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius * 0.65, 12, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2), MATS.steelAlloy);\n roofDome.position.set(0, h, 0);\n root.add(roofDome);\n\n const radarMast = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12, 0.2, 4.5, 8), MATS.steelAlloy);\n radarMast.position.set(0, h + 2.2, 0);\n root.add(radarMast);\n\n const radarDish = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.6, 0.6, 12, 1, true), MATS.steelAlloy);\n radarDish.rotation.x = Math.PI / 3;\n radarDish.position.set(0, h + 4.0, 0.6);\n root.add(radarDish);\n\n return root;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 4. SLOPED WEDGE SKY-BLADE (AERODYNAMIC ANGLED SKYSCRAPER)\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildWedgeSkyBlade(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'WedgeSkyBlade';\n const h = opts.height || 52;\n const w = opts.width || 14;\n const d = opts.depth || 18;\n\n // Extruded Right-Angle Wedge Shape\n const shape = new THREE.Shape();\n shape.moveTo(-d / 2, 0);\n shape.lineTo(d / 2, 0);\n shape.lineTo(d / 2, h * 0.4);\n shape.lineTo(-d / 2, h);\n shape.closePath();\n\n const geom = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {\n depth: w,\n bevelEnabled: true,\n bevelThickness: 0.12,\n bevelSize: 0.12,\n bevelSegments: 2\n });\n geom.center();\n\n const wedgeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, MATS.steelAlloy);\n wedgeMesh.position.set(0, h / 2, 0);\n wedgeMesh.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n root.add(wedgeMesh);\n\n // Glowing Front Blade Edge Light (Cyan Knife-Edge)\n const edgeLight = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, h * 0.85, 0.18), MATS.glowCyan);\n edgeLight.position.set(0, h / 2 + 2, d / 2 + 0.1);\n root.add(edgeLight);\n\n // Diagonal Side Structural Trusses\n [-w / 2 - 0.1, w / 2 + 0.1].forEach(x => {\n const truss = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.2, 0.2, h * 0.9, 8), MATS.darkConcrete);\n truss.rotation.x = 0.35;\n truss.position.set(x, h / 2, 0);\n root.add(truss);\n });\n\n // Rooftop Angled Landing Helipad\n const pad = createBeveledBox(w * 0.75, 0.4, w * 0.75, 0.05, 1, MATS.darkConcrete);\n pad.position.set(0, h * 0.92, -d * 0.2);\n root.add(pad);\n\n const padRing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(2.0, 2.3, 16), MATS.glowAmber);\n padRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n padRing.position.set(0, h * 0.92 + 0.22, -d * 0.2);\n root.add(padRing);\n\n return root;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 5. CYLINDRICAL NEO-ROTUNDA TOWER (TIERED CONCENTRIC RINGS)\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildRotundaTower(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'RotundaTower';\n const tiers = opts.tiers || 4;\n const baseRadius = opts.radius || 11.0;\n const tierHeight = opts.tierHeight || 9.5;\n\n for (let i = 0; i < tiers; i++) {\n const r = baseRadius * (1.0 - i * 0.16);\n const y = i * tierHeight + tierHeight / 2;\n\n // Cylindrical Tier Body\n const cyl = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r * 0.95, r, tierHeight, 24), MATS.darkConcrete);\n cyl.position.set(0, y, 0);\n root.add(cyl);\n\n // Cantilevered Observation Ring Balcony\n const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r + 1.2, r + 1.2, 0.4, 24), MATS.steelAlloy);\n ring.position.set(0, y + tierHeight / 2 - 0.2, 0);\n root.add(ring);\n\n // Glowing Neon Ring Edge Light\n const neonRing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(r + 1.22, 0.08, 8, 24), i % 2 === 0 ? MATS.glowCyan : MATS.glowAmber);\n neonRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n neonRing.position.set(0, y + tierHeight / 2 - 0.2, 0);\n root.add(neonRing);\n\n // Wrap-around panoramic glass strip\n const glassStrip = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r * 0.96, r * 0.96, tierHeight * 0.4, 24, 1, true), MATS.glassCyan);\n glassStrip.position.set(0, y, 0);\n root.add(glassStrip);\n }\n\n // Crown Dome & Needle\n const totalH = tiers * tierHeight;\n const crownDome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(baseRadius * 0.4, 16, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2), MATS.lightPlate);\n crownDome.position.set(0, totalH, 0);\n root.add(crownDome);\n\n const crownNeedle = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.25, 7.0, 8), MATS.steelAlloy);\n crownNeedle.position.set(0, totalH + 3.5, 0);\n root.add(crownNeedle);\n\n return root;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 6. COMPACT CYBER-SHOPHOUSE / CORNER BODEGA BLOCK (LOW-RISE STREET LIFE)\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildCornerShophouse(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'CyberShophouse';\n const w = opts.width || 12;\n const h = opts.height || 14;\n const d = opts.depth || 10;\n const shopColor = opts.shopColor || MATS.terracotta;\n\n // Ground Floor Bodega / Ramen Shop\n const groundFloor = createBeveledBox(w, 4.5, d, 0.08, 2, MATS.darkConcrete);\n groundFloor.position.set(0, 2.25, 0);\n root.add(groundFloor);\n\n // Shopfront Roll-up Metal Door & Counter\n const rollUpDoor = createBeveledBox(w * 0.7, 3.2, 0.2, 0.03, 1, MATS.steelAlloy);\n rollUpDoor.position.set(0, 1.8, d / 2 + 0.1);\n root.add(rollUpDoor);\n\n // Glowing Neon Shop Awning (Amber / Magenta)\n const awning = createBeveledBox(w * 0.85, 0.3, 1.6, 0.02, 1, MATS.glowAmber);\n awning.rotation.x = 0.2;\n awning.position.set(0, 3.8, d / 2 + 0.8);\n root.add(awning);\n\n // Upper Living Quarters (Stories 2-3)\n const upperBody = createBeveledBox(w - 0.4, h - 4.5, d - 0.4, 0.08, 2, shopColor);\n upperBody.position.set(0, 4.5 + (h - 4.5) / 2, 0);\n root.add(upperBody);\n\n // Windows with cozy warm glow\n for (let wx = -w * 0.3; wx <= w * 0.3; wx += w * 0.3) {\n const win = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 2.0, 0.1), MATS.glowAmber);\n win.position.set(wx, 8.5, d / 2 - 0.12);\n root.add(win);\n }\n\n // Exterior AC Compressor Unit hanging on side\n const ac = createBeveledBox(1.2, 0.8, 0.6, 0.02, 1, MATS.steelAlloy);\n ac.position.set(w / 2 + 0.32, 7.5, 0);\n root.add(ac);\n\n // Rooftop Water Tank with Hazard Band & Studs\n const tank = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2, 1.2, 2.6, 12), MATS.steelAlloy);\n tank.position.set(-w * 0.25, h + 1.3, -d * 0.2);\n root.add(tank);\n\n // Roof Parapet Studs\n for (let sx = -w * 0.4; sx <= w * 0.4; sx += 1.4) {\n const stud = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12, 0.12, 0.08, 8), MATS.darkConcrete);\n stud.position.set(sx, h + 0.05, d / 2 - 0.4);\n root.add(stud);\n }\n\n return root;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 7. STEPPED TERRACED APARTMENT BLOCK (ZIGGURAT RESIDENTIAL)\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildTerraceApartment(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'TerraceApartment';\n const steps = opts.steps || 4;\n const baseW = opts.width || 20;\n const stepH = opts.stepHeight || 6.0;\n const baseD = opts.depth || 16;\n\n for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {\n const sw = baseW * (1.0 - s * 0.18);\n const sd = baseD * (1.0 - s * 0.18);\n const sy = s * stepH + stepH / 2;\n\n const block = createBeveledBox(sw, stepH, sd, 0.1, 2, s % 2 === 0 ? MATS.cyberTeal : MATS.steelAlloy);\n block.position.set(0, sy, -s * (baseD * 0.08));\n root.add(block);\n\n // Stepped Terrace Rooftop Balcony with green solar tiles\n const balcony = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(sw * 0.9, sd * 0.3), MATS.glowGreen);\n balcony.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n balcony.position.set(0, sy + stepH / 2 + 0.02, -s * (baseD * 0.08) + sd * 0.3);\n root.add(balcony);\n\n // Terrace Safety Railing\n const rail = createBeveledBox(sw * 0.92, 0.6, 0.08, 0.01, 1, MATS.glowAmber);\n rail.position.set(0, sy + stepH / 2 + 0.32, -s * (baseD * 0.08) + sd * 0.46);\n root.add(rail);\n }\n\n return root;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 8. INDUSTRIAL POWER SUBSTATION & CONDUIT GANTRY\n// ============================================================================\nexport function buildIndustrialSubstation(opts = {}) {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'IndustrialSubstation';\n const w = opts.width || 16;\n const h = opts.height || 18;\n\n // Steel Foundation Slab\n const foundation = createBeveledBox(w, 1.2, 12, 0.08, 1, MATS.darkConcrete);\n foundation.position.set(0, 0.6, 0);\n root.add(foundation);\n\n // Twin High-Voltage Transformers\n [-4.2, 4.2].forEach(x => {\n const xfmr = createBeveledBox(5.2, 4.8, 5.2, 0.1, 2, MATS.steelAlloy);\n xfmr.position.set(x, 3.6, 0);\n root.add(xfmr);\n\n // Ceramic Insulator Bushings (3 per transformer)\n [-1.6, 0, 1.6].forEach(bz => {\n const bushing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.45, 1.8, 8), MATS.terracotta);\n bushing.position.set(x, 6.8, bz);\n root.add(bushing);\n\n const sparkGlow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.18, 8, 8), MATS.glowCyan);\n sparkGlow.position.set(x, 7.8, bz);\n root.add(sparkGlow);\n });\n });\n\n // Steel Lattice Overhead Gantry Arch\n const gantryBar = createBeveledBox(w + 2, 0.8, 0.8, 0.04, 1, MATS.steelAlloy);\n gantryBar.position.set(0, h, 0);\n root.add(gantryBar);\n\n [-w / 2, w / 2].forEach(lx => {\n const col = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.45, h, 8), MATS.steelAlloy);\n col.position.set(lx, h / 2, 0);\n root.add(col);\n });\n\n // High-Voltage Illuminated Power Conduits\n [-3.0, 0, 3.0].forEach(cx => {\n const cable = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.08, 0.08, 14), MATS.glowCyan);\n cable.position.set(cx, h - 0.5, 0);\n root.add(cable);\n });\n\n return root;\n}\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini Projects/Nirvana/Automation reel workflow/roblox-glitch-market/src/buildings.js"}},{"name":"write_file","args":{"Content":"// ============================================================================\n// THE GLITCH MARKET — EPISODE 1 // SHOT 1: AETHELGARD METROPOLIS SKYLINE\n// High-Density Architectural Assembly with 8+ Brand-New Distinct 3D Building Models:\n// - Grand Cyber Celestial Skybox (Nebula wisps, data moon, voxel starfield)\n// - NO flat circuit-board grid — replaced with real 3D street-level shophouses,\n// bodegas, neon awnings, industrial substations, and multi-tier building foundations!\n// - 8+ Distinct 3D Building Archetypes instanced with varied scales & rotations:\n// 1. Twin-Spire Gateway Towers\n// 2. Cantilevered Tetris Midrises\n// 3. Hexagonal Data-Silos\n// 4. Sloped Wedge Sky-Blades\n// 5. Cylindrical Neo-Rotunda Towers\n// 6. Industrial Power Substations\n// + The Sovereign Apex Citadel & Stepped Commercial Spire & Pod Highrise\n// - High-Speed Maglev Train, Suspended Skyway 101, and Swarming Air Traffic\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { createBeveledBox, chamferBox, Textures, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// Core Assets\nimport { buildApexTower } from './apex_tower.js';\nimport { buildSteppedTower } from './stepped_tower.js';\nimport { buildPodHighrise } from './pod_highrise.js';\nimport { buildSkyTrain } from './sky_train.js';\nimport { buildSkyHighway } from './sky_highway.js';\nimport { buildCargoBarge } from './cargo_barge.js';\nimport { buildSkyTaxi } from './taxi.js';\nimport { buildNeonSpeeder } from './speeder.js';\n\n// 8 Brand-New Building Models\nimport {\n buildTwinSpireTower,\n buildTetrisMidrise,\n buildHexDataSilo,\n buildWedgeSkyBlade,\n buildRotundaTower,\n buildCornerShophouse,\n buildTerraceApartment,\n buildIndustrialSubstation\n} from './buildings.js';\n\nexport function buildMetropolisSkyline(options = {}) {\n const city = new THREE.Group();\n city.name = 'AethelgardMetropolis';\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 1. GRAND CYBER SKY BACKDROP DOME (NEBULA, DATA MOON & STARFIELD)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const skyGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(550, 550, 480, 48, 1, true);\n const skyMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n map: Textures.cyberSkyBackdrop(),\n side: THREE.BackSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const skyDome = new THREE.Mesh(skyGeo, skyMat);\n skyDome.position.set(0, 130, -180);\n city.add(skyDome);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 2. REAL 3D GROUND PAVEMENT (DARK METROPOLITAN ASPHALT BEDROCK)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const matStreetAsphalt = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x0A0D16,\n roughness: 0.85,\n metalness: 0.15\n });\n\n const streetFloor = createBeveledBox(500, 3.0, 500, 0.2, 1, matStreetAsphalt);\n streetFloor.position.set(0, -1.5, -160);\n city.add(streetFloor);\n\n // Roadway curbs and dark pavement slabs\n const matCurb = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1E2638, roughness: 0.7 });\n const centerCurb = createBeveledBox(14, 0.4, 400, 0.05, 1, matCurb);\n centerCurb.position.set(0, 0.2, -160);\n city.add(centerCurb);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 3. LOWER-TIER REAL 3D STREET BLOCKS (BODEGAS, SHOPHOUSES & SUBSTATIONS)\n // Completely replacing the flat circuit-board grid with real 3D architecture!\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const shophouseColors = [\n new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xB91C1C, roughness: 0.5 }), // Red\n new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0D9488, roughness: 0.4 }), // Teal\n new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xD97706, roughness: 0.45 }), // Gold\n new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1E293B, roughness: 0.6 }), // Slate\n ];\n\n // Dense row of street shophouses along Left Street Frontage (X = -24 to -12)\n const leftShops = [\n { z: -35, rot: 0.2, col: 0, s: 1.0 },\n { z: -50, rot: -0.1, col: 1, s: 1.1 },\n { z: -68, rot: 0.15, col: 2, s: 0.95 },\n { z: -88, rot: 0.0, col: 3, s: 1.05 },\n { z: -110, rot: -0.2, col: 0, s: 1.15 },\n ];\n leftShops.forEach((d, idx) => {\n const shop = buildCornerShophouse({ shopColor: shophouseColors[d.col] });\n shop.scale.set(d.s, d.s, d.s);\n shop.position.set(-16.0, 0, d.z);\n shop.rotation.y = d.rot;\n city.add(shop);\n });\n\n // Dense row of street shophouses along Right Street Frontage (X = +12 to +24)\n const rightShops = [\n { z: -32, rot: -0.3, col: 2, s: 1.0 },\n { z: -48, rot: 0.15, col: 0, s: 1.05 },\n { z: -66, rot: -0.1, col: 1, s: 1.1 },\n { z: -85, rot: 0.2, col: 3, s: 0.95 },\n { z: -105, rot: -0.15, col: 2, s: 1.0 },\n ];\n rightShops.forEach((d, idx) => {\n const shop = buildCornerShophouse({ shopColor: shophouseColors[d.col] });\n shop.scale.set(d.s, d.s, d.s);\n shop.position.set(16.0, 0, d.z);\n shop.rotation.y = d.rot;\n city.add(shop);\n });\n\n // Industrial Power Substations on street corners\n const sub1 = buildIndustrialSubstation({ width: 14, height: 16 });\n sub1.position.set(-28, 0, -42);\n sub1.rotation.y = 0.4;\n city.add(sub1);\n\n const sub2 = buildIndustrialSubstation({ width: 16, height: 18 });\n sub2.position.set(28, 0, -78);\n sub2.rotation.y = -0.5;\n city.add(sub2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 4. MID-TIER ARCHITECTURAL CANYON (TETRIS, TERRACES, WEDGES & ROTUNDAS)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Model 2: Cantilevered Tetris Midrise (Left Near-Midground: X = -32, Z = -58)\n const tetris1 = buildTetrisMidrise({ tiers: 7, blockSize: 6.8 });\n tetris1.position.set(-32, 0, -58);\n tetris1.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(tetris1);\n\n // Model 2: Cantilevered Tetris Midrise (Right Midground: X = +35, Z = -115)\n const tetris2 = buildTetrisMidrise({ tiers: 8, blockSize: 6.2 });\n tetris2.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n tetris2.position.set(36, 0, -115);\n tetris2.rotation.y = -0.45;\n city.add(tetris2);\n\n // Model 4: Sloped Wedge Sky-Blade (Left Flank: X = -45, Z = -95)\n const blade1 = buildWedgeSkyBlade({ height: 58, width: 15, depth: 20 });\n blade1.position.set(-44, 0, -95);\n blade1.rotation.y = 0.25;\n city.add(blade1);\n\n // Model 4: Sloped Wedge Sky-Blade (Right Foreground Flank: X = +28, Z = -45)\n const blade2 = buildWedgeSkyBlade({ height: 48, width: 13, depth: 16 });\n blade2.position.set(28, 0, -45);\n blade2.rotation.y = -0.65;\n city.add(blade2);\n\n // Model 5: Cylindrical Neo-Rotunda Tower (Right Mid-Canyon: X = +42, Z = -85)\n const rotunda1 = buildRotundaTower({ tiers: 4, radius: 10.5, tierHeight: 9.0 });\n rotunda1.position.set(40, 0, -85);\n rotunda1.rotation.y = 0.3;\n city.add(rotunda1);\n\n // Model 5: Cylindrical Neo-Rotunda Tower (Left Deep-Mid: X = -52, Z = -140)\n const rotunda2 = buildRotundaTower({ tiers: 5, radius: 9.0, tierHeight: 8.5 });\n rotunda2.position.set(-52, 0, -140);\n rotunda2.rotation.y = -0.4;\n city.add(rotunda2);\n\n // Model 7: Stepped Terraced Ziggurat Apartment (Left Street Corner: X = -38, Z = -75)\n const terrace1 = buildTerraceApartment({ steps: 5, width: 22, depth: 18, stepHeight: 5.5 });\n terrace1.position.set(-36, 0, -78);\n terrace1.rotation.y = -0.15;\n city.add(terrace1);\n\n // Model 7: Stepped Terraced Apartment (Right Street Corner: X = +38, Z = -62)\n const terrace2 = buildTerraceApartment({ steps: 4, width: 18, depth: 15, stepHeight: 5.8 });\n terrace2.position.set(34, 0, -62);\n terrace2.rotation.y = 0.5;\n city.add(terrace2);\n\n // Core Asset: Stepped Commercial Cyber-Tower (Left Focal Skyscraper: X = -28, Z = -120)\n const steppedComm1 = buildSteppedTower();\n steppedComm1.scale.set(1.15, 1.15, 1.15);\n steppedComm1.position.set(-28, 0, -125);\n steppedComm1.rotation.y = -0.22;\n city.add(steppedComm1);\n\n // Core Asset: Stepped Commercial Cyber-Tower (Right Focal Skyscraper: X = +28, Z = -135)\n const steppedComm2 = buildSteppedTower();\n steppedComm2.scale.set(1.1, 1.1, 1.1);\n steppedComm2.position.set(26, 0, -135);\n steppedComm2.rotation.y = 0.35;\n city.add(steppedComm2);\n\n // Core Asset: Residential Pod Highrise (Mini-Houses // Habitation Stacks: X = +18, Z = -38)\n const podStack1 = buildPodHighrise();\n podStack1.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n podStack1.position.set(20, 0, -38);\n podStack1.rotation.y = 0.45;\n city.add(podStack1);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 5. HIGH-RISE GATEWAY & DATA SILOS (MID-TO-DEEP SKYLINE)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // Model 1: Twin-Spire Gateway Tower (Left Skyline Anchor: X = -45, Z = -175)\n const twinSpire1 = buildTwinSpireTower({ height: 68, width: 26 });\n twinSpire1.position.set(-45, 0, -175);\n twinSpire1.rotation.y = 0.2;\n city.add(twinSpire1);\n\n // Model 1: Twin-Spire Gateway Tower (Right Skyline Anchor: X = +48, Z = -170)\n const twinSpire2 = buildTwinSpireTower({ height: 64, width: 24 });\n twinSpire2.position.set(48, 0, -170);\n twinSpire2.rotation.y = -0.3;\n city.add(twinSpire2);\n\n // Model 3: Hexagonal Data-Silo (Left Background: X = -22, Z = -195)\n const hexSilo1 = buildHexDataSilo({ height: 56, radius: 9.0 });\n hexSilo1.position.set(-22, 0, -195);\n city.add(hexSilo1);\n\n // Model 3: Hexagonal Data-Silo (Right Background: X = +24, Z = -200)\n const hexSilo2 = buildHexDataSilo({ height: 58, radius: 9.5 });\n hexSilo2.position.set(24, 0, -200);\n city.add(hexSilo2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 6. DEEP BACKGROUND BOSS TOWER: SOVEREIGN APEX CITADEL\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const apexTower = buildApexTower();\n apexTower.scale.set(1.7, 1.7, 1.7);\n // Dominating center-background towering into the celestial nebula sky\n apexTower.position.set(0, 0, -255);\n city.add(apexTower);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 7. CRISS-CROSSING SUSPENDED SKY-BRIDGES ACROSS THE CANYON\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const matBridge = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1E293B, roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.6 });\n const matBridgeGlass = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00F0FF, roughness: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.75 });\n\n function addSkyBridge(fromXYZ, toXYZ) {\n const vFrom = new THREE.Vector3(...fromXYZ);\n const vTo = new THREE.Vector3(...toXYZ);\n const len = vFrom.distanceTo(vTo);\n const mid = new THREE.Vector3().addVectors(vFrom, vTo).multiplyScalar(0.5);\n\n const bridgeMesh = createBeveledBox(len, 2.8, 3.2, 0.06, 1, matBridge);\n bridgeMesh.position.copy(mid);\n bridgeMesh.lookAt(vTo);\n bridgeMesh.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n city.add(bridgeMesh);\n\n const glassMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(len - 0.4, 1.4, 3.25), matBridgeGlass);\n glassMesh.position.copy(mid);\n glassMesh.lookAt(vTo);\n glassMesh.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);\n city.add(glassMesh);\n }\n\n // Sky-Bridges spanning across the canyon at 3 different heights!\n addSkyBridge([-16, 18, -68], [16, 18, -66]); // Lower Skyway bridge\n addSkyBridge([-28, 28, -125], [26, 28, -135]); // High Cross-Canyon bridge\n addSkyBridge([-32, 22, -58], [-44, 22, -95]); // Left Flank bridge\n addSkyBridge([28, 24, -45], [40, 24, -85]); // Right Flank bridge\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 8. ELEVATED TRANSIT: HIGH-SPEED MAGLEV SKY-TRAIN & SKYWAYS\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // High-Speed Maglev Sky-Train traversing high monorail beam at Y = 36m\n const train1 = buildSkyTrain();\n train1.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n train1.position.set(-2.0, 36.0, -140);\n train1.rotation.y = -0.10;\n city.add(train1);\n\n // Suspended Skyway 101 Expressway (Lower Arterial: Y = 13m)\n const highwaySection1 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection1.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection1.position.set(0, 13.0, -82);\n highwaySection1.rotation.y = 0.22;\n city.add(highwaySection1);\n\n const highwaySection2 = buildSkyHighway();\n highwaySection2.scale.set(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n highwaySection2.position.set(-34.0, 13.0, -89.5);\n highwaySection2.rotation.y = 0.22;\n city.add(highwaySection2);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 9. HIGH-DENSITY AIR TRAFFIC (16+ VEHICLES IN TRANSIT)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const trafficData = [\n ['barge', -14.0, 22.0, -96, -0.22, 0.65],\n ['barge', 26.0, 19.0, -125, 0.35, 0.60],\n ['taxi', -6.0, 26.0, -56, 0.18, 0.85],\n ['taxi', 22.0, 22.0, -88, -1.1, 0.75],\n ['taxi', 12.0, 31.0, -150, 0.35, 0.55],\n ['taxi', -22.0, 16.0, -75, 0.45, 0.70],\n ['taxi', 16.0, 16.0, -68, 0.2, 0.80],\n ['speeder', 4.0, 24.0, -72, 0.25, 0.75],\n ['speeder', -20.0, 29.0, -118, 0.55, 0.50],\n ['speeder', 14.0, 27.0, -98, -0.4, 0.65],\n ['speeder', -8.0, 18.0, -45, 0.15, 0.90],\n ['speeder', 30.0, 33.0, -138, -0.6, 0.55],\n ];\n\n trafficData.forEach(([type, x, y, z, rotY, s]) => {\n let veh;\n if (type === 'taxi') veh = buildSkyTaxi();\n else if (type === 'barge') veh = buildCargoBarge();\n else veh = buildNeonSpeeder();\n\n veh.scale.set(s, s, s);\n veh.position.set(x, y, z);\n veh.rotation.y = rotY;\n city.add(veh);\n });\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 10. FOREGROUND HERO ELEMENT: CLOSE SPEEDER BANKING PAST CAMERA\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const heroSpeeder = buildNeonSpeeder();\n heroSpeeder.scale.set(1.2, 1.2, 1.2);\n heroSpeeder.position.set(4.6, 17.5, -15.0);\n heroSpeeder.rotation.y = 0.30;\n heroSpeeder.rotation.z = -0.26;\n heroSpeeder.rotation.x = -0.10;\n city.add(heroSpeeder);\n\n // High-Energy Cyan Ion Jet Exhaust Plumes\n const matJetPlume = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00F0FF, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 });\n [-0.82, 0.82].forEach(tz => {\n const plume = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.42, 3.6, 12), matJetPlume);\n plume.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;\n plume.position.set(2.6, 17.5 + tz * 0.18, -15.0 - 2.4 + tz * 0.45);\n city.add(plume);\n });\n\n return city;\n}\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini Projects/Nirvana/Automation reel
