GLITCH MARKET — SHOT 2 MASTER PRODUCTION SCENE & INTEGRATION\n// SECTOR 04: THE COLOSSEUM DEATHMATCH ARENA (FLOATING PVP RING)\n//\n// Full Integration of All 4 Completed Batches:\n// - Batch A: Core Colosseum Architecture (60m deck, 8 pylons, forcefield, jumbotron HUD, repulsors)\n// - Batch B: 3D Spectator Audience (60+ avatars: Noobs, Pros, Bacon Hairs, VIPs, Lightsticks, Banners)\n// - Batch C: Periphery & Background (Broadcaster Sky-Tower, Docking Pad, 3 Billboards, Skiff, Drones)\n// - Batch D: Battle Scars & Atmosphere (Cracked Crater, Volumetric God Rays, Pyrotechnics, Abyss City)\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { Textures } from './core/geo.js';\nimport { buildColosseumArena } from './colosseum_arena.js';\nimport { buildNoobAvatar } from './noob_avatar.js';\nimport {\n buildProSpectator,\n buildBaconHairSpectator,\n buildVipSpectator,\n buildCheeringBanner\n} from './spectator_avatars.js';\nimport {\n buildBroadcasterTower,\n buildDockingPlatform,\n buildSponsorBillboard,\n buildMicroDrone,\n buildSecuritySkiff\n} from './arena_periphery.js';\nimport {\n buildImpactCrater,\n buildVolumetricSpotlights,\n buildPyrotechnicJets,\n buildAbyssMetropolisBackdrop\n} from './arena_effects.js';\n\n// Camera Angles Configuration\nexport const MASTER_ANGLES = [\n {\n id: 'shot2_angle_1_hero_vertical',\n title: 'SHOT 2 // OFFICIAL VERTICAL 9:16 MASTER HERO KEYFRAME',\n desc: 'Deck-level dramatic vertical opener: smoldering crater, jumbotron HUD 00:45, forcefield, 3D crowd & sky-tower',\n aspect: '9:16',\n width: 1080,\n height: 1920,\n pos: [14.0, 8.5, 26.0],\n target: [-4.0, 16.0, -8.0],\n fov: 54\n },\n {\n id: 'shot2_angle_2_grandstand_pano',\n title: 'ANGLE 2 // AMPHITHEATER GRANDSTAND & CROWD PANORAMIC',\n desc: 'Wide 3/4 aerial view showcasing 60m ring, 60+ cheering avatars, 8 pylons, docking pad & sky-tower',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [48.0, 36.0, 48.0],\n target: [0.0, 10.0, 0.0],\n fov: 46\n },\n {\n id: 'shot2_angle_3_ring_duel',\n title: 'ANGLE 3 // COMBATANT RING-LEVEL GLADIATOR PERSPECTIVE',\n desc: 'Low combat perspective across cracked obsidian crater towards bully side, backlit by god rays & torch plumes',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [6.0, 5.6, 18.0],\n target: [2.0, 6.0, -14.0],\n fov: 48\n },\n {\n id: 'shot2_angle_4_jumbotron_vip',\n title: 'ANGLE 4 // 3D JUMBOTRON HUD & VIP OBSERVATION SKYBOX',\n desc: 'Telephoto framing of match timer 00:45, Solo Leveling alert, tuxedo VIP patrons & micro-drone tracking',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [-14.0, 26.0, 22.0],\n target: [0.0, 25.0, 0.0],\n fov: 38\n },\n {\n id: 'shot2_angle_5_docking_broadcaster',\n title: 'ANGLE 5 // BROADCASTER SKY-TOWER & PATROL SKIFF AERIAL',\n desc: 'High-altitude peripheral view: LIVE BLOX-NET sports tower, docked Sky-Taxi CAB-42, billboards & enforcer skiff',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [-42.0, 34.0, -32.0],\n target: [-20.0, 18.0, 10.0],\n fov: 44\n }\n];\n\nfunction canvasToBlob(canvas) {\n return new Promise((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/png'));\n}\n\nasync function uploadImage(name, blob) {\n const resp = await fetch(`/save?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {\n method: 'POST',\n body: blob\n });\n if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to upload ${name}: ${resp.status}`);\n}\n\n/**\n * Builds and populates the 3D crowd into the arena grandstands\n */\nexport function populateSpectatorAudience() {\n const crowdGroup = new THREE.Group();\n crowdGroup.name = 'PopulatedSpectatorAudience';\n\n const lightstickColors = ['#00F0FF', '#EC4899', '#FBBF24', '#00FF88'];\n\n // Populate 5 Bleacher Tiers\n const standTiers = 5;\n for (let s = 0; s < standTiers; s++) {\n const innerRadius = 34.0 + s * 4.8;\n const tierR = innerRadius + 2.4;\n const tierY = 1.2 + s * 2.2;\n\n // Number of avatars per tier (increasing outwards)\n const count = 10 + s * 3; // 10, 13, 16, 19, 22 -> 80 avatars total!\n for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n // Angular spacing around amphitheater (leave small gap near docking skybridge)\n const angle = (i * Math.PI * 2) / count + (s * 0.18);\n // Skip quadrant near docking pad gantry (around angle ~ 5.5 to 6.0 rad)\n if (angle > 5.4 && angle < 6.1) continue;\n\n const px = Math.cos(angle) * tierR;\n const pz = Math.sin(angle) * tierR;\n\n let avatar;\n const roll = (i + s * 7) % 10;\n const lsCol = lightstickColors[(i + s) % lightstickColors.length];\n\n if (roll < 4) {\n // Classic Noob Fan (40% of crowd)\n const isSeated = (i % 2 === 0);\n avatar = buildNoobAvatar({ seated: isSeated, lightstickColor: lsCol });\n } else if (roll < 7) {\n // Bacon Hair Starter Spectator (30% of crowd)\n avatar = buildBaconHairSpectator({ lightstickColor: lsCol });\n } else {\n // Rich / Pro Spectator (30% of crowd)\n avatar = buildProSpectator({ lightstickColor: lsCol });\n }\n\n avatar.position.set(px, tierY, pz);\n // Face toward center ring\n avatar.lookAt(0, tierY, 0);\n\n // Slight natural orientation jitter\n avatar.rotation.y += (Math.sin(i * 3 + s) * 0.15);\n crowdGroup.add(avatar);\n }\n }\n\n // Place Holographic Cheering Banners across the bleachers\n const bannerPositions = [\n { tier: 2, angle: 0.5, type: 1 }, // RICH_BULLY #1\n { tier: 3, angle: 1.8, type: 2 }, // BACON HAIR CLUTCH UP\n { tier: 2, angle: 2.9, type: 1 }, // RICH_BULLY #1\n { tier: 4, angle: 3.8, type: 2 }, // BACON HAIR CLUTCH UP\n { tier: 1, angle: 4.8, type: 1 }, // RICH_BULLY #1\n ];\n\n bannerPositions.forEach(b => {\n const tierR = (34.0 + b.tier * 4.8) + 2.4;\n const tierY = 1.2 + b.tier * 2.2;\n const bx = Math.cos(b.angle) * tierR;\n const bz = Math.sin(b.angle) * tierR;\n\n const banner = buildCheeringBanner(b.type);\n banner.position.set(bx, tierY, bz);\n banner.lookAt(0, tierY, 0);\n THE CLASH SHOCKWAVE VFX (Ground Zero Impact Point)\n// - Expanding gold/crimson additive shockwave rings\n// - Blinding white contact flash flare & explosive spark debris\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { createBeveledBox, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// PROCEDURAL TEXTURES\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function createMagmaArmorTexture() {\n return canvasTex('magma_armor_fissures', 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {\n // Dark volcanic basalt base\n g.fillStyle = '#090D18';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Subtle basalt texture grain\n g.fillStyle = '#111827';\n for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {\n const rx = (i * 37) % w;\n const ry = (i * 73) % h;\n g.fillRect(rx, ry, 3, 3);\n }\n\n // Glowing Molten Magma Veins\n const numVeins = 10;\n for (let v = 0; v < numVeins; v++) {\n let x = (v * w) / numVeins + 20;\n let y = 0;\n\n // Dark crevice background\n g.strokeStyle = '#450A0A';\n g.lineWidth = 8;\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(x, y);\n\n const segments = 8;\n const pts = [{ x, y }];\n for (let s = 1; s <= segments; s++) {\n const ny = (h / segments) * s;\n const nx = x + Math.sin(s * 1.8 + v) * 28;\n pts.push({ x: nx, y: ny });\n g.lineTo(nx, ny);\n }\n g.stroke();\n\n // Outer orange lava glow\n g.strokeStyle = '#EA580C';\n g.lineWidth = 4.5;\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);\n for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) g.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);\n g.stroke();\n\n // Molten yellow core vein\n g.strokeStyle = '#FDE047';\n g.lineWidth = 1.8;\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);\n for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) g.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);\n g.stroke();\n }\n }, [1, 1]);\n}\n\nexport function createGildedFiligreeTexture() {\n return canvasTex('gilded_filigree', 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {\n // Rich royal obsidian & gold plate\n g.fillStyle = '#17130A';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Gold borders\n g.strokeStyle = '#F59E0B';\n g.lineWidth = 8;\n g.strokeRect(8, 8, w - 16, h - 16);\n\n g.strokeStyle = '#FDE047';\n g.lineWidth = 3;\n g.strokeRect(16, 16, w - 32, h - 32);\n\n // Center imperial crest diamond\n const cx = w / 2;\n const cy = h / 2;\n g.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(cx, cy - 80);\n g.lineTo(cx + 60, cy);\n g.lineTo(cx, cy + 80);\n g.lineTo(cx - 60, cy);\n g.closePath();\n g.fill();\n\n g.fillStyle = '#FEF08A';\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(cx, cy - 40);\n g.lineTo(cx + 30, cy);\n g.lineTo(cx, cy + 40);\n g.lineTo(cx - 30, cy);\n g.closePath();\n g.fill();\n }, [1, 1]);\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 1. FIGHTER 1: LORD KAELEN (THE GILDED DOMINUS CHAMPION)\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nexport function buildLordKaelen() {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'LordKaelen_DominusChampion';\n\n // Materials\n const matGoldPlate = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xF59E0B,\n metalness: 0.9,\n roughness: 0.18,\n map: createGildedFiligreeTexture()\n });\n\n const matGoldBright = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xFDE047,\n metalness: 0.92,\n roughness: 0.14\n });\n\n const matDominusHood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xD97706,\n metalness: 0.75,\n roughness: 0.25\n });\n\n const matDeepVoid = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x030712 });\n const matGlowGold = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFEF08A });\n const matRoyalCape = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x991B1B,\n roughness: 0.45,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n\n // Base R6 Dimensions: Head 1.25x1.25, Torso 2x2x1, Limbs 1x2x1\n const torso = new THREE.Group();\n torso.name = 'Torso';\n\n // Torso Block with Gilded Plate\n const torsoMesh = createBeveledBox(2.0, 2.0, 1.0, 0.04, 2, matGoldPlate);\n torso.add(torsoMesh);\n\n // Diamond Chest Crest\n const crest = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.35, 0), matGoldBright);\n crest.position.set(0, 0.25, 0.55);\n torso.add(crest);\n\n // Royal Golden Belt & Buckle\n const belt = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.08, 0.25, 1.08), matGoldBright);\n belt.position.set(0, -0.85, 0);\n torso.add(belt);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // HEAD & DOMINUS HOOD\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const headGroup = new THREE.Group();\n headGroup.position.set(0, 1.45, 0);\n\n // Inner Head Block (Deep shadow inside hood)\n const innerHead = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), matDeepVoid);\n headGroup.add(innerHead);\n\n // Dominus Empyreus Hood (Outer Shell)\n const hoodTop = createBeveledBox(1.5, 0.45, 1.5, 0.05, 2, matDominusHood);\n hoodTop.position.set(0, 0.65, 0);\n 8), matGoldBright);\n pommel.position.set(0, -1.25, 0);\n sword.add(pommel);\n\n // 3.4m Radiant Blade Body\n const bladeMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xFEF08A,\n emissive: hornGroup.position.set(side * 0.75, 0.45, 0.1);\n\n // 4 Curved Segments per Horn\n for (let h = 0; h < 4; h++) {\n const segW = 0.22 - h * 0.035;\n const segH = 0.45;\n const seg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(segW, segH, 5), matDemonHorn);\n seg.position.set(side * (h * 0.18), h * 0.32, -h * 0.08);\n seg.rotation.z = side * (-0.35 - h * 0.15);\n seg.rotation.x = -0.15;\n Vertical Lens Flare Cross / Star Spikes\n const spikeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xFEF08A,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.8,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const spikeH = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(7.0, 0.45), spikeMat);\n shock.add(spikeH);\n\n const spikeV = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.45, 7.0), spikeMat);\n shock.add(spikeV);\n\n // 5. Radial Flying Spark Shards & Magma Splinters\n const sparkMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xFCD34D,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending\n });\n for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {\n const angle = (i * Math.PI * 2) / 28 + (i * 0.2);\n const dist = 1.4 + (i % 5) * 0.7;\n const sx = Math.cos(angle) * dist;\n const sy = ((i % 4) - 1.5) * 0.6;\n const sz = Math.sin(angle) * dist;\n\n const spark = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12, 0.12, 0.5), sparkMat);\n spark.position.set(sx, sy, sz);\n spark.lookAt(0, 0, 0);\n shock.add(spark);\n }\n\n return shock;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 4. function buildArenaClashDuo() {\n const duelRig = new THREE.Group();\n duelRig.name = 'ArenaClashDuo';\n\n // Position Vulcan planted in the crater center\n const vulcan = buildVulcanBerserker();\n kaelen.position.set(0.15, 2.75, 1.45);\n kaelen.rotation.y = Math.PI - 0.15; // Facing toward Vulcan\n duelRig.add(kaelen);\n\n // Position the Clash Shockwave right at the weapon collision point\n });\n\n const matBasaltPlate = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x090D18,\n metalness: 0.4,\n roughness: 0.75,\n map: createMagmaArmorTexture()\n });\n\n // 4.5m Heavy Carbon Haft\n const 0.25, 0.08, 8, 24), matLavaRing);\n ring.rotation.x = 0.4 * r;\n ring.rotation.y = 0.6 * r;\n hammerhead.add(ring);\n }\n\n // Floating Magma Ember Particles around Hammer\n const matEmber = new hammer;\n}\n\n/**\n * Builds Full Vulcan-99 Character Rig\n */\nexport function buildVulcanBerserker() {\n const root = new THREE.Group();\n root.name = 'Vulcan99_MagmaBerserker';\n\n // Materials\n shoulder\n const firePlume = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.35, 1.1, 6),\n new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xF97316,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.8,\n blending: torso.add(hammer);\n\n // Arms gripping hammer overhead\n const armL = new THREE.Group();\n armL.position.set(-1.3, 0.75, 0);\n const armLMesh = createBeveledBox(0.95, 1.9, 0.95, 0.04, 2, matBasaltPlate);\n armLMesh.position.set(0, -0.75, 0);\n armL.add(armLMesh);\n armL.rotation.x = Math.PI * 0.52;\n armL.rotation.z = -0.45;\n armL.rotation.y = -0.2;\n torso.add(armL);\n\n const armR armR.rotation.x = Math.PI * 0.48;\n armR.rotation.z = 0.42;\n armR.rotation.y = 0.25;\n torso.add(armR);\n\n // Legs in dynamic jump-brace / planted power posture\n const legL = new THREE.Group();\n legL.position.set(-0.72, -1.0, 0);\n const legLMesh = createBeveledBox(1.02, 2.1, 1.02, 0.04, 2, matBasaltPlate);\n legLMesh.position.set(0, -1.0, 0);\n legL.add(legLMesh);\n legL.rotation.z = 0.28;\n THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xFEF08A,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.7,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const spikeH = new 0.6;\n const sx = Math.cos(angle) * dist;\n const sy = ((i % 5) - 2.0) * 0.5;\n const sz = Math.sin(angle) * dist;\n\n const spark = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.09, 0.09, 0.4),\n (i % 2 === 0) ? sparkMatGold : sparkMatRed\n );\n spark.position.set(sx, sy, sz);\n spark.lookAt(0, 0, 0);\n shock.add(spark);\n }\n\n // C-04: Ground-Level Impact Ripple Ring\n const groundRipple = new shock;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// FULL DYNAMIC ARENA SPRINT & CLASH ENSEMBLE\n// Vulcan-99 (Magma Berserker) braced in power parry\n const vulcan = buildVulcanBerserker();\n vulcan.position.set(0, 0, -0.6);\n vulcan.rotation.y = 0.15;\n clashScene.add(vulcan);\n\n // V-05: Vulcan's Magma Kinetic Sprint Trail\n const vulcanTrail = buildMagmaSprintTrail(-15.0, -14.0, 0.0, -0.6);\n clashScene.add(vulcanTrail);\n\n // 3. Central Clash Shockwave at Weapon Impact Point\n const shockwave = buildClashShockwave();\n shockwave.position.set(0.08, 2.85, 0.35);\n clashScene.add(shockwave);\n\n // C-05: Dynamic Dual Opposing Clash Lighting\n const lightGold = new THREE.PointLight(0xFDE047, 4.2, 16.0);\n lightGold.position.set(0.8, 3.2, 0.8);\n clashScene.add(lightGold);\n\n const lightRed = new THREE.PointLight(0xEF4444, Batch 2 — Vulcan-99 (The Magma Berserker)\n**Raid Boss Rig, Demonic Horns, Volcanic Basalt Plate, Hellfire Warhammer & Magma Vortex VFX** \n*Project: The Glitch Market — Roblox UGC 3D Short Series (Episode 1: The Shadow's Awakening)*\n\n---\n\n## 1. Executive Summary & Batch Verification\n\nFor **Batch 2 (Vulcan-99 — The Magma Berserker)**, we engineered the complete, high-tier Roblox UGC raid-boss juggernaut rig across 5 core itemized assets (`V-01` through `V-05`).\n\nVulcan-99 embodies raw subterranean destruction: heavy volcanic basalt plate armor etched with procedural glowing molten fissures (`#EA580C` and `#FDE047`), a charred titanium battle helm flanked by 4-segment curved demon horns and a glowing red visor slit, spiked basalt pauldrons with active orange fire plume jets (`#F97316`), a colossal 4.5m Hellfire Colossus Warhammer wreathed in **3 swirling magma flame vortex rings** with 12 orbiting ember particles, and a smoldering scorched skid trail on the arena deck leading into a cracked basalt takeoff launch pit.\n\nAll 5 assets have been visually audited across 5 studio camera angles rendered at 1280×760 and composited onto the 2400×1350 Master Production Audit Sheet: [vulcan_master_sheet.png](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/vulcan_master_sheet.png).\n\n![vulcan_master_sheet](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/vulcan_master_sheet.png)\n\n---\n\n## 2. 5-Angle Studio Audit Breakdown\n\n````carousel\n![View 01: Hero 3/4 Perspective](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/vulcan_angle_1_hero.png)\n\n![View 02: Demonic Horned Helm & Visor](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/vulcan_angle_2_horns_visor.png)\n\n![View 03: Spiked Magma Pauldrons & Fire Jets](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/vulcan_angle_3_pauldrons_fire.png)\n\n![View 04: Hellfire Warhammer & Vortex VFX](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/vulcan_angle_4_warhammer_vortex.png)\n\n![View 05: Molten Sprint Trail & Cracked Pit](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/vulcan_angle_5_sprint_trail.png)\n````\n\n---\n\n## 3. Technical Specification Ledger (Assets V-01 to V-05)\n\n### Asset V-01: Demonic Horned Battle Helm & Molten Visor Slit\n- **Battle Helm**: 1.38m × 1.38m charred titanium block helm (`#1A1F2E`, metalness `0.72`) with reinforced facial plating.\n- **Curved Demon Horns**: Pair of 4-segment curved horns curving outward and backward, progressing from charcoal basalt (`#2A0A0A`) to glowing molten Executive Summary & Batch Verification\n\nFor **Batch 3 (Mid-Air Kinetic Collision & Arena Clash VFX)**, we engineered the complete ground-zero explosive contact system across 5 core itemized assets (`C-01` through `C-05`).\n\nThis system models the exact millisecond of physical and energetic impact where **Lord Kaelen's Gilded Sunfire Greatsword** slams downward into **Vulcan-99's two-handed Hellfire Colossus Warhammer parry** at coordinates `Y = 2.85m` directly over the cracked obsidian crater deck.\n\nThe contact event features an additive white-hot luminance singularity core, multi-axis 8m lens flare star cross spikes, concentric dual-energy expanding shockwave rings (Holy Gold `#F59E0B` and Hellfire Carmine `#EF4444`), 36 flying solar and magma debris splinters flung radially in 360 degrees, a secondary planar ground ripple ring propagating flush onto the crater floor, and dynamic opposing gold vs. fire point lights.\n\nAll 5 assets have been visually audited across 5 studio camera angles rendered at 1280×760 and composited onto the 2400×1350 Master Production Audit Sheet: [clash_vfx_master_sheet.png](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/clash_vfx_master_sheet.png).\n\n![clash_vfx_master_sheet](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/clash_vfx_master_sheet.png)\n\n---\n\n## (`SphereGeometry(0.35, 16, 16)`, additive `#FFFFFF`, opacity `0.9`, `depthWrite: false`) centered at `Y = 2.85m` at the exact blade-on-hammer collision point.\n- **Multi-Axis 8m Star Spikes**: 3D visibility from every camera perspective.\n\n### Asset C-02: Dual-Tone Expanding Spherical Clash Shockwave Rings\n- **Inner Holy Gold Ring**: Concentric planar shockwave disc (`RingGeometry(1.8, 3.2, 32)`, additive `#F59E0B`, opacity `0.8`) representing the solar burst from the Sunfire Greatsword.\n- **Outer Hellfire Carmine Ring**: Concentric planar shockwave disc (`RingGeometry(3.0, 4.8, Shards**: 18 high-velocity elongated golden crystal splinters (`BoxGeometry(0.09, 0.09, 0.4)`, additive `#FCD34D`) exploding radially outward.\n- **Magma Ember Splinters**: 18 high-velocity basalt molten embers (`BoxGeometry(0.09, 0.09, 0.4)`, additive `#FF3D00`) scattering in 360-degree trajectories with pitch dispersion.\n\n### Asset C-04: Ground-Level Impact Ripple propagating onto Crater\n- Covers universal R6 anatomy with studs and bevels, 12-segment volumetric 3D bacon hair, expressive decal face with glassy anime eyes and gauze bandage, tattered teal hoodie with kangaroo pouch and drawstrings, indigo denim with frayed knee tear, and auxiliary props.","UserFacing":true},"Content":"# 🛡️ ASSET PRODUCTION AUDIT REPORT // BATCH 1: TOBY (BACON HAIR MC HERO RIG)\n**Project**: *The Glitch Market* — Episode 1: \"The Shadow's Awakening\" \n**Milestone**: Milestone 5 (Shot 4 Character Roster — \"And That's Me...\") \n**Target Sequence**: Shot 4 (Ground-level alley outside Sector 04 Arena Gates) \n**Status**: **100% COMPLETE & VERIFIED** \n**Audit Sheet Artifact**: [`toby_master_sheet.png`](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/toby_master_sheet.png)\n\n---\n\n## 📸 5-Angle Studio Inspection Overview\n\nThe protagonist character rig for **Toby** has been engineered in Three.js and audited across 5 cinematic studio inspection angles compiled into the master production sheet below:\n\n![Toby Master Sheet](file:///C:/Users/dirgh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/08383f18-8836-44c0-b898-f0efe2c3452e/toby_master_sheet.png)\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart LR\n A[\"T-01: Universal R6 Rig
(Studs & 0.04m Bevels)\"] --> MC[\"Toby (MC Hero Rig)\"]\n B[\"T-02: Volumetric 3D Hair
(12 Layered Bacon Mesh Strips)\"] --> MC\n C[\"T-03: Expressive Face Decal
(Glassy Eyes, Bandage, Grime)\"] --> MC\n D[\"T-04: Tattered Outfit
(Teal Hoodie, Frayed Denim)\"] --> MC\n E[\"T-05: Kinematics & Props
(Kneeling Pose, Broken Club)\"] --> MC\n```\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 Detailed Asset Verification\n\n### 1. Asset T-01: Universal R6 Anatomy Rig with Authentic Roblox Studs & Bevels\n- **Module**: [toby_avatar.js](file:///z:/Mini%20Projects/Nirvana/Automation%20reel%20workflow/roblox-glitch-market/src/toby_avatar.js#L524-L635)\n- **Geometry**: Strict authentic Roblox R6 proportions ($2\\times 2\\times 2$ head block, $2\\times 2\\times 1$ torso, $1\\times 2\\times 1$ limbs).\n- **Bevel Architecture**: Soft chamfered edges ($r = 0.04\\text{m}$, 2 subdivisions) preventing harsh razor CGI edges while honoring authentic blocky toy proportions.\n- **Stud Hardware**: Authentic cylindrical top neck stud ($\\varnothing 0.64\\text{m}$) and head stud ($\\varnothing 0.48\\text{m}$) connecting joints authentically.\n\n### 2. slits and floating crown\n */\nexport function buildBullyHeadgear() {\n const headgearGroup = new THREE.Group();\n headgearGroup.name = 'BullyHeadgear';\n\n // Obsidian Fabric Material\n const matDominus = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x07090F,\n roughness: 0.35,\n metalness: 0.4\n });\n\n // Polished 24K Gold Trim Material\n const matGold = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n Pointed Front Peak Brow\n const peakGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.35, 0.4, 4);\n const peak = new THREE.Mesh(peakGeo, matGold);\n peak.rotation.z = Math.PI;\n peak.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;\n peak.position.set(0, 0.72, 0.72);\n headgearGroup.add(peak);\n\n // 3. Gold Trim Rim around Face Opening\n const trimGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.72, 0.05, 8, 24);\n const trim = new THREE.Mesh(trimGeo, matGold);\n trim.position.set(0, 0, 0.68);\n trim.scale.set(0.9, 1.05, 1.0);\n headgearGroup.add(trim);\n\n // 4. Glowing Cyan Eye Slits (Dominus Empyreus style)\n [-0.24, 0.24].forEach(side => {\n const eyeGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.22, 0.055, 0.08);\n const eyeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF\n });\n const eye = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, eyeMat);\n eye.position.set(side, 0.05, 0.69);\n eye.rotation.z = side * -0.22;\n headgearGroup.add(eye);\n\n // Glowing cyan eye flare halo\n const flareGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.45, 0.15);\n const flareMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x38BDF8,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.65,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const flare = new THREE.Mesh(flareGeo, flareMat);\n flare.position.set(side * 1.05, 0.05, 0.70);\n headgearGroup.add(flare);\n });\n\n // 5. crownRingGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.55, 0.58, 0.18, 16, 1, true);\n const crownRing = new THREE.Mesh(crownRingGeo, matGold);\n crownGroup.add(crownRing);\n\n // 5 Crown Points with Cyan Diamonds\n for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n const angle = (i / 5) * Math.PI * 2;\n const px = Math.cos(angle) * 0.56;\n const pz = Math.sin(angle) * 0.56;\n\n const pointGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.12, 0.35, 4);\n const point = new THREE.Mesh(pointGeo, matGold);\n point.position.set(px, 0.22, pz);\n point.rotation.y = angle;\n crownGroup.add(point);\n\n // Diamond gem tip\n const gemGeo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.065);\n const gemMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00F0FF });\n const gem = new THREE.Mesh(gemGeo, gemMat);\n gem.position.set(px, 0.42, pz);\n crownGroup.add(gem);\n }\n\n // Floating Crown Glow Disc\n const glowDiscGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.45, 0.65, 16);\n const glowDiscMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xFDE047,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.35,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const glowDisc = new THREE.Mesh(glowDiscGeo, glowDiscMat);\n glowDisc.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n glowDisc.position.set(0, -0.05, 0);\n crownGroup.add(glowDisc);\n\n headgearGroup.add(crownGroup);\n return headgearGroup;\n}\n\n// P-01: Snapped Beginner Wooden Club (Jagged Fractures & Splinters in Puddle)\n// - P-02: Holographic Level 1 Player Stat Card [LEVEL 1 | STATS: 0 | ROBUX: 0]\n// - P-03: Tarnished Beginner [NOOB] Bronze Badge Medallion\n// - P-04: Colosseum Outer Curb, Reflective Rain Puddles & Rusted Security Gates\n// - P-05: Mocking High-Tier Passerby Avatars (Cyber-Ninja & Neon Streetwear)\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport { createBeveledBox, canvasTex } from './core/geo.js';\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ASSET P-03: TARNISHED BEGINNER [NOOB] BRONZE BADGE\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function buildTarnishedNoobBadge() {\n const badge = new THREE.Group();\n badge.name = 'TarnishedNoobBadge';\n\n const badgeTex = canvasTex('badge_noob_bronze', 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n // Weathered bronze / copper base\n g.fillStyle = '#78350F';\n g.beginPath();\n g.arc(w / 2, h / 2, 115, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n g.fill();\n\n // Tarnished bronze rim\n g.strokeStyle = '#B45309';\n g.lineWidth = 14;\n g.beginPath();\n g.arc(w / 2, h / 2, 105, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n g.stroke();\n\n // Rivets around rim\n g.fillStyle = '#451A03';\n for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n const angle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;\n const rx = w / 2 + Math.cos(angle) * 105;\n const ry = h / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * 105;\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(rx, ry, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n }\n\n // Classic Roblox Noob Icon (Yellow head, Blue torso, Green legs)\n const cx = w / 2;\n const cy = h / 2 - 10;\n\n // Head\n g.fillStyle = '#FACC15';\n g.fillRect(cx - 24, cy - 42, 48, 38);\n // Smile & eyes\n g.fillStyle = '#1E293B';\n g.fillRect(cx - 15, cy - 30, 8, 8);\n g.fillRect(cx + 7, cy - 30, 8, 8);\n g.beginPath();\n g.arc(cx, cy - 18, 10, 0, Math.PI);\n g.stroke();\n\n // Blue Torso\n g.fillStyle = '#0284C7';\n g.fillRect(cx - 32, cy - 2, 64, 46);\n\n // Green Legs\n g.fillStyle = '#16A34A';\n g.fillRect(cx - 30, cy + 46, 28, 40);\n g.fillRect(cx + 2, cy + 46, 28, 40);\n\n // Diagonal Scratches across badge (wear and tear)\n g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30, 15, 5, 0.6)';\n g.lineWidth = 4;\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(40, 60); g.lineTo(210, 200); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(70, 40); g.lineTo(190, 170); g.stroke();\n\n // \"NOOB\" Text ribbon\n g.fillStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.fillRect(cx - 55, cy + 65, 110, 26);\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.font = 'bold 18px monospace';\n g.textAlign = 'center';\n g.fillText('NOOB', cx, cy + 84);\n });\n\n const disc = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.24, 0.035, 24),\n new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xB45309,\n metalness: 0.8,\n roughness: 0.4\n })\n );\n disc.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n badge.add(disc);\n\n const decal = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.44, 0.44),\n new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: badgeTex, transparent: true })\n );\n decal.position.set(0, 0, 0.02);\n badge.add(decal);\n\n return badge;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ASSET P-04: COLOSSEUM OUTER CURB & ENVIRONMENT\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function buildArenaCurbEnvironment() {\n const env = new THREE.Group();\n env.name = 'ArenaCurbEnvironment';\n\n // 1. Wet Asphalt / Cobblestone Street Deck (Reflective ground)\n const streetGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(24, 0.4, 18);\n const streetTex = canvasTex('curb_wet_cobblestone', 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#090D16';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Wet pavers / cobblestone grid\n g.strokeStyle = '#1E293B';\n g.lineWidth = 2;\n for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 32) {\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, 0); g.lineTo(x, h); g.stroke();\n }\n for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 18) {\n const offset = (Math.floor(y / 18) % 2) * 16;\n for (let x = -16; x < w + 16; x += 32) {\n g.strokeRect(x + offset, y, 32, 18);\n }\n }\n // Neon puddle reflection wash (Electric cyan & hot magenta)\n const grad = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h);\n grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08)');\n grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.06)');\n grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08)');\n g.fillStyle = grad;\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n }, [4, 4]);\n\n const streetMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: streetTex,\n color: 0xFFFFFF,\n roughness: 0.35,\n metalness: 0.5\n });\n const street = new THREE.Mesh(streetGeo, streetMat);\n street.position.set(0, -0.2, 2.5);\n env.add(street);\n\n // 2. Concrete Sidewalk Curb Step\n const curbGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(24, 0.45, 4.5);\n const curbMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x1E293B,\n roughness: 0.75,\n metalness: 0.2\n });\n const curb = new THREE.Mesh(curbGeo, curbMat);\n curb.position.set(0, 0.05, -3.2);\n env.add(curb);\n\n // Curb Ledge Lip (The stone edge Toby sits against)\n const lipGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(24, 0.12, 0.35);\n const lipMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x334155,\n roughness: 0.6,\n metalness: 0.3\n });\n const lip = new THREE.Mesh(lipGeo, lipMat);\n lip.position.set(0, 0.25, -1.0);\n env.add(lip);\n\n // 3. Mirror-Like Water Puddles (Reflecting arena lights)\n const puddles = [\n { x: 0.2, z: 0.7, r: 3.4, rot: 0.2 },\n { x: -3.8, z: 2.2, r: 2.2, rot: -0.4 },\n { x: 4.2, z: 1.8, r: 2.6, rot: 0.5 }\n ];\n\n puddles.forEach(p => {\n const puddleGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(p.r, 32);\n puddleGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);\n const puddleMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x050811,\n roughness: 0.06, // ultra glossy water mirror\n metalness: 0.9,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.92\n });\n const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(puddleGeo, puddleMat);\n mesh.position.set(p.x, 0.015, p.z);\n mesh.rotation.y = p.rot;\n env.add(mesh);\n\n // Concentric Ripple Ring\n const rippleGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(p.r * 0.4, p.r * 0.44, 24);\n rippleGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);\n const rippleMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x38BDF8,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.35,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n const ripple = new THREE.Mesh(rippleGeo, rippleMat);\n ripple.position.set(p.x, 0.02, p.z);\n env.add(ripple);\n });\n\n // 4. Heavy Rusted Security Gate Bars (Colosseum Arena Gates)\n const gate = new THREE.Group();\n gate.position.set(0, 0, -4.5);\n\n const barMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x1E2430,\n metalness: 0.85,\n roughness: 0.55\n });\n\n // Vertical security bars (7m tall)\n for (let i = -16; i <= 16; i++) {\n const barGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.065, 0.065, 7.5, 8);\n const bar = new THREE.Mesh(barGeo, barMat);\n bar.position.set(i * 0.68, 3.75, 0);\n gate.add(bar);\n\n // Spear point top\n const spikeGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, 0.35, 4);\n const spike = new THREE.Mesh(spikeGeo, barMat);\n spike.position.set(i * 0.68, 7.6, 0);\n gate.add(spike);\n }\n\n // Horizontal structural cross-beams\n [1.0, 3.8, 6.6].forEach(y => {\n const beamGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(23.5, 0.22, 0.18);\n const beam = new THREE.Mesh(beamGeo, barMat);\n beam.position.set(0, y, 0);\n gate.add(beam);\n });\n\n // Diegetic Warning Placard on Gate: [SECTOR 04 ARENA // NO UNRANKED ALLOWED]\n const signTex = canvasTex('gate_warning_sign', 512, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n // Yellow & black hazard stripes border\n g.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n g.fillStyle = '#0F172A';\n for (let x = -w; x < w * 2; x += 40) {\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(x, 0);\n g.lineTo(x + 25, 0);\n g.lineTo(x - 15, h);\n g.lineTo(x - 40, h);\n g.closePath();\n g.fill();\n }\n // Dark center sign board\n g.fillStyle = '#0F172A';\n g.fillRect(20, 20, w - 40, h - 40);\n g.strokeStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.lineWidth = 4;\n g.strokeRect(20, 20, w - 40, h - 40);\n\n g.fillStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.font = 'bold 24px monospace';\n g.textAlign = 'center';\n g.fillText('⚠ SECTOR 04 COMBAT ZONE ⚠', w / 2, 60);\n\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.font = '900 28px sans-serif';\n g.fillText('RESTRICTED ACCESS', w / 2, 110);\n\n g.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';\n g.font = 'bold 18px monospace';\n g.fillText('MINIMUM RANK: DIAMOND TIER', w / 2, 150);\n\n g.fillStyle = '#94A3B8';\n g.font = 'bold 15px monospace';\n g.fillText('NOOBS & LEVEL 1 PROHIBITED', w / 2, 195);\n });\n\n const sign = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.4, 1.2),\n new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: signTex,\n roughness: 0.4,\n metalness: 0.2\n })\n );\n sign.position.set(0, 3.8, 0.12);\n gate.add(sign);\n\n env.add(gate);\n\n // 5. Overhead Industrial Arena Floodlight Lamp Post\n const postGroup = new THREE.Group();\n postGroup.position.set(-6.5, 0, -2.5);\n\n const postPole = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.18, 8, 12),\n barMat\n );\n postPole.position.set(0, 4, 0);\n postGroup.add(postPole);\n\n const lampArm = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.2, 0.16, 0.16),\n barMat\n );\n lampArm.position.set(0.9, 7.8, 0);\n lampArm.rotation.z = -0.15;\n postGroup.add(lampArm);\n\n const lampHousing = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.2, 0.35, 0.65),\n barMat\n );\n '9:16',\n width: 1080,\n height: 1920,\n pos: [0.95, 0.72, 3.45],\n target: [0.75, 1.85, 0.1],\n fov: 54\n },\n {\n id: 'shot4_angle_2_alley_tiltup',\n title: 'ANGLE 2 // CINEMATIC LOW-ANGLE ALLEY TILT-UP',\n desc: 'Wide ground-level perspective across water puddles, snapped club, clashing player tiers & Colosseum bars',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [-1.8, 0.95, 3.8],\n target: [1.2, 1.85, -0.2],\n fov: 52\n },\n {\n id: 'shot4_angle_3_toby_character_study',\n title: 'ANGLE 3 // TOBY PROTAGONIST CLOSEUP & LEVEL 1 UI',\n desc: 'Close 3/4 perspective on Toby\\'s bruised face, 3D bacon hair, tattered hoodie, broken stick & stat card',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [1.2, 1.45, 1.95],\n target: [0.0, 1.25, 0.35],\n fov: 42\n },\n {\n id: 'shot4_angle_4_bully_mockery_macro',\n title: 'ANGLE 4 // CHAD_ROBUX DOMINANCE & 2.5M ROBUX TAG',\n desc: 'Upward look at Chad_Robux pointing in mockery, obsidian tuxedo, Dominus hood, diamond crown & dragon pet',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [1.1, 1.5, 1.8],\n target: [2.0, 2.5, -0.2],\n fov: 46\n },\n {\n id: 'shot4_angle_5_passerby_street_depth',\n title: 'ANGLE 5 // STREET DEPTH & MOCKING PASSERBYS',\n desc: 'Sidewalk perspective looking past the laughing Cyber-Ninja & Streetwear avatar towards the arena gates',\n aspect: '16:9',\n width: 1280,\n height: 760,\n pos: [6.8, 2.2, 3.6],\n target: [2.2, 1.7, -0.4],\n fov: 46\n }\n];\n\nfunction canvasToBlob(canvas) {\n return new Promise((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/png'));\n}\n\nasync function uploadImage(name, blob) {\n const resp = await fetch(`/save?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {\n method: 'POST',\n body: blob\n });\n if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to upload ${name}: ${resp.status}`);\n}\n\nexport function buildMasterShot4Scene() {\n const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x050811);\n\n // Distant Cyber Skybox Dome\n const skyGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(400, 400, 320, 36, 1, true);\n const skyMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n map: Textures.cyberSkyBackdrop(),\n side: THREE.BackSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const skyDome = new THREE.Mesh(skyGeo, skyMat);\n skyDome.position.set(0, 50, 0);\n scene.add(skyDome);\n\n // Studio / Cinematic Lighting Rig\n const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x38BDF8, 0x0A0F1E, 1.15);\n scene.add(hemi);\n\n const keySun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xFFFBEB, 2.2);\n keySun.position.set(10, 14, 12);\n scene.add(keySun);\n\n const fillCyan = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x00F0FF, 1.5);\n fillCyan.position.set(-10, 8, 6);\n scene.add(fillCyan);\n\n const warmRim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xF59E0B, 2.0);\n warmRim.position.set(8, 6, -10);\n scene.add(warmRim);\n\n // Soft Front Camera Key for characters\n const charKey = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xFFFFFF, 1.6);\n charKey.position.set(1, 3, 5);\n scene.add(charKey);\n\n // Dedicated soft spotlight on Toby\n const tobySpot = new THREE.PointLight(0xFFE4B5, 2.4, 5.5);\n tobySpot.position.set(0.0, 1.8, 1.2);\n scene.add(tobySpot);\n\n // Dedicated spotlight on Chad_Robux\n const chadSpot = new THREE.PointLight(0x00F0FF, 2.0, 6.0);\n chadSpot.position.set(2.0, 3.5, 1.2);\n scene.add(chadSpot);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 1. ENVIRONMENT STAGING (BATCH 3)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const env = buildArenaCurbEnvironment();\n scene.add(env);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 2. ANTAGONIST: CHAD_ROBUX (RICH BULLY PRO) (BATCH 2)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const bully = buildBullyAvatar({\n pose: 'pointing_mock'\n });\n bully.position.set(2.0, 0.05, -0.2);\n bully.rotation.y = -0.55; // turned mockingly toward Toby\n scene.add(bully);\n\n // Holographic VIP Status Tag [ROBUX: 2,500,000 R$]\n const vipTag = buildVIPStatusTag();\n vipTag.position.set(3.25, 2.75, -0.1);\n vipTag.rotation.y = -0.45;\n scene.add(vipTag);\n\n // Floating Luxury Orbit Rings around Chad's waist\n const orbitGroup = new THREE.Group();\n orbitGroup.position.set(2.0, 2.05, -0.2);\n for (let r = 0; r < 2; r++) {\n const ringGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.4 + r * 0.35, 0.025, 8, 32);\n const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: r === 0 ? 0xF59E0B : 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.75,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending\n });\n const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);\n ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2 + 0.15 * (r === 0 ? 1 : -1);\n ring.rotation.y = 0.2 * r;\n orbitGroup.add(ring);\n }\n scene.add(orbitGroup);\n\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n // 4. MOCKING PASSERBY AVATARS (BATCH 3)\n // --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n const passerbys = buildMockingPasserbyAvatars();\n scene.add(passerbys);\n\n return scene;\n}\n\nasync function init() {\n const masterCanvas = document.getElementById('viewCanvas');\n const masterCtx = masterCanvas.getContext('2d');\n\n const scene = buildMasterShot4Scene();\n\n const renderedCanvases = [];\n\n for (const cfg of MASTER_ANGLES) {\n const glCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n glCanvas.width = cfg.width;\n glCanvas.height = cfg.height;\n\n const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({\n canvas: glCanvas,\n antialias: true,\n alpha: false,\n preserveDrawingBuffer: true\n });\n renderer.setSize(cfg.width, cfg.height);\n renderer.setPixelRatio(1);\n renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;\n renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.35;\n\n const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(cfg.fov, cfg.width / cfg.height, 0.1, 350);\n cam.position.set(...cfg.pos);\n cam.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(...cfg.target));\n\n renderer.render(scene, cam);\n\n const angleCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n angleCanvas.width = cfg.width;\n angleCanvas.height = cfg.height;\n const actx = angleCanvas.getContext('2d');\n actx.drawImage(glCanvas, 0, 0);\n\n // Cinematic HUD Badge Overlay\n if (cfg.aspect === '9:16') {\n // Top Production Header\n actx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 8, 17, 0.88)';\n actx.fillRect(36, 40, cfg.width - 72, 92);\n actx.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF';\n actx.lineWidth = 2;\n actx.strokeRect(36, 40, cfg.width - 72, 92);\n\n actx.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';\n actx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';\n actx.fillText('THE GLITCH MARKET // EPISODE 1: THE SHADOW\\'S AWAKENING', 60, 78);\n\n actx.fillStyle = '#94A3B8';\n actx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';\n actx.fillText('SHOT 4: HERO INTRODUCTION • \"AND THAT\\'S ME...\" (INCITING INCIDENT)', 60, 108);\n\n // Bottom Cinematic Subtitle Bar\n actx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 8, 17, 0.92)';\n actx.fillRect(36, cfg.height - 130, cfg.width - 72, 90);\n actx.strokeStyle = '#F59E0B';\n actx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n actx.strokeRect(36, cfg.height - 130, cfg.width - 72, 90);\n\n actx.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';\n actx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';\n actx.fillText('NARRATION [TOBY]: \"And that\\'s me... Level 1. Zero Robux. Common Bacon Hair.\"', 60, cfg.height - 88);\n\n actx.fillStyle = '#38BDF8';\n actx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';\n actx.fillText('CHAD_ROBUX: \"Nice stick, Noob. Go cry outside the gates with the rest of the trash.\"', 60, cfg.height - 58);\n } else {\n // Landscape Overlay\n actx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 8, 17, 0.85)';\n actx.fillRect(24, 24, 730, 68);\n actx.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF';\n actx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n actx.strokeRect(24, 24, 730, 68);\n\n actx.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';\n actx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';\n actx.fillText(cfg.title, 42, 52);\n\n actx.fillStyle = '#94A3B8';\n actx.font = '13px monospace';\n actx.fillText(cfg.desc, 42, 74);\n }\n\n renderedCanvases.push({ canvas: angleCanvas, cfg });\n\n // Upload individual angle\n const blob = await canvasToBlob(angleCanvas);\n await uploadImage(`${cfg.id}.png`, blob);\n console.log(`SAVED: ${cfg.id}.png`);\n\n if (cfg.id === 'shot4_angle_1_hero_vertical') {\n await uploadImage('shot4_keyframe_01.png', blob);\n console.log('SAVED: shot4_keyframe_01.png');\n }\n }\n\n // ==========================================================================\n // COMPOSITE 2400 × 1350 MASTER PRODUCTION SHEET\n // ==========================================================================\n masterCtx.fillStyle = '#050811';\n masterCtx.fillRect(0, 0, 2400, 1350);\n\n // Cyber Grid\n masterCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.05)';\n masterCtx.lineWidth = 1;\n for (let x = 0; x < 2400; x += 60) {\n masterCtx.beginPath(); masterCtx.moveTo(x, 0); masterCtx.lineTo(x, 1350); masterCtx.stroke();\n }\n for (let y = 0; y < 1350; y += 60) {\n masterCtx.beginPath(); masterCtx.moveTo(0, y); masterCtx.lineTo(2400, y); masterCtx.stroke();\n }\n\n // Master Header\n masterCtx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n masterCtx.font = '900 34px sans-serif';\n masterCtx.fillText('THE GLITCH MARKET // SHOT 4 MASTER PRODUCTION SCENE', 45, 55);\n\n masterCtx.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';\n masterCtx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';\n masterCtx.fillText('SHOT 4: HERO INTRODUCTION — COMPLETE 3-BATCH CHARACTER & ENVIRONMENT INTEGRATION', 45, 85);\n\n masterCtx.fillStyle = '#94A3B8';\n masterCtx.font = 'bold 13px monospace';\n masterCtx.textAlign = 'right';\n masterCtx.fillText('EPISODE 1: THE SHADOW\\'S AWAKENING • ALL 14 ASSETS AUDITED & VERIFIED', 2355, 55);\n (12-Seg Hair, Decal, Denim)\"]\n B2[\"Batch 2: Chad_Robux Rig
(Tuxedo, Dominus, Dragon, Rapier)\"]\n B3[\"Batch 3: Props & Curb
(Broken Club, Puddles, Gates, Bystanders)\"]\n end\n B1 --> KF03[\"Official Master Keyframe 03

----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/**\n * Toby's Combat Expressions: 'charge' (fierce grit) & 'shock' (wide dilated terror)\n */\nexport function createTobyCombatFace(expression = 'shock') {\n return canvasTex(`toby_combat_face_${expression}`, 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {\n // Pale classic Roblox yellow skin\n g.fillStyle = '#F8EE89';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Grime & battle smudges\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(74, 48, 28, 0.22)';\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(110, 360, 48, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(380, 140, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n\n // Swollen bruise under left eye\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(126, 34, 206, 0.3)';\n g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(170, 275, 48, 26, 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.35)';\n g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(170, 278, 34, 18, 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n\n // Eyebrows\n g.strokeStyle = '#3E2718';\n g.lineWidth = 15;\n g.lineCap = 'round';\n\n if (expression === 'charge') {\n // Fierce aggressive V-brow\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(120, 195); g.lineTo(220, 225); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(392, 195); g.lineTo(292, 225); g.stroke();\n } else {\n // High-arched horrified shock brow (raised in center)\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(115, 230); g.lineTo(215, 175); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(397, 230); g.lineTo(297, 175); g.stroke();\n }\n\n // Eyes\n if (expression === 'shock') {\n // Massive dilated eyes (Terror)\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(175, 245, 45, 54, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(337, 245, 45, 54, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n\n // Constricted Pinprick Pupils (Shock)\n g.fillStyle = '#0F0703';\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(175, 245, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(337, 245, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n\n // Quivering shock rings around pupils\n g.strokeStyle = '#78350F';\n g.lineWidth = 3;\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(175, 245, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(337, 245, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.stroke();\n\n // Cold sweat beads trickling down forehead/temple\n g.fillStyle = '#38BDF8';\n const sweatDrops = [\n { x: 105, y: 190, r: 8 },\n { x: 115, y: 220, r: 6 },\n { x: 395, y: 200, r: 7 }\n ];\n sweatDrops.forEach(d => {\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n });\n\n // Frostbite creeping on cheek (cyan crystalline frost)\n g.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF';\n g.lineWidth = 3;\n const fx = 120, fy = 310;\n for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n const ang = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(fx, fy);\n g.lineTo(fx + Math.cos(ang) * 35, fy + Math.sin(ang) * 35);\n g.stroke();\n }\n } else {\n // Determined Charge Eyes\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(175, 235, 38, 48, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(337, 235, 38, 48, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n\n g.fillStyle = '#451A03';\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(175, 238, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(337, 238, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(165, 225, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(327, 225, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n }\n\n // Nose Scratch\n g.strokeStyle = '#B91C1C';\n g.lineWidth = 4;\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(238, 280); g.lineTo(274, 272); g.stroke();\n\n // Cheek Bandage\n g.save();\n g.translate(355, 340);\n g.rotate(-0.2);\n g.fillStyle = '#F8FAFC';\n g.fillRect(-42, -18, 84, 36);\n g.fillStyle = '#E2E8F0';\n g.fillRect(-22, -14, 44, 28);\n g.restore();\n\n // Mouth\n g.lineWidth = 8;\n g.lineCap = 'round';\n if (expression === 'charge') {\n // Gritted teeth grit\n g.strokeStyle = '#1F1108';\n g.strokeRect(210, 375, 92, 28);\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.fillRect(212, 377, 88, 24);\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(212, 389); g.lineTo(300, 389); g.stroke();\n for (let x = 230; x < 300; x += 15) {\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, 377); g.lineTo(x, 401); g.stroke();\n }\n } else {\n // Quivering agape mouth in shock/horror\n g.fillStyle = '#3F1515';\n g.beginPath();\n g.ellipse(256, 395, 32, 22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n g.fill();\n g.strokeStyle = '#1F1108';\n g.stroke();\n }\n });\n}\n\n/**\n * Chad's Predatory Combat Smirk Decal with Blue Frostfire Reflection\n */\nexport function createChadCombatFace() {\n return canvasTex('chad_combat_smirk', 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {\n g.fillStyle = '#FFF7ED';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Arrogant cocked eyebrows\n g.strokeStyle = '#18181B';\n g.lineWidth = 14;\n g.lineCap = 'round';\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(110, 165); g.quadraticCurveTo(165, 120, 220, 155); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(292, 175); g.lineTo(395, 160); g.stroke();\n\n // Designer Aviators (Gold Frame)\n g.strokeStyle = '#F59E0B';\n g.lineWidth = 7;\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(215, 230); g.lineTo(297, 230); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(130, 205); g.lineTo(382, 205); g.stroke();\n\n // Obsidian Lenses\n g.fillStyle = '#090D16';\n g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(110, 215, 105, 85, [18, 18, 42, 42]); g.fill(); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(297, 215, 105, 85, [18, 18, 42, 42]); g.fill(); g.stroke();\n\n // Blue Frostfire Blade Reflection in Aviators!\n const drawFrostBladeRef = (lx) => {\n g.save();\n g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(lx, 215, 105, 85, [18, 18, 42, 42]); g.clip();\n\n // Slanted glowing cyan blade reflection\n g.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(lx + 20, 290);\n g.lineTo(lx + 55, 215);\n g.lineTo(lx + 75, 215);\n g.lineTo(lx + 40, 290);\n g.closePath();\n g.fill();\n\n // White-hot core gleam\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(lx + 32, 280);\n g.lineTo(lx + 58, 225);\n g.lineTo(lx + 64, 225);\n g.lineTo(lx + 38, 280);\n g.closePath();\n g.fill();\n\n g.restore();\n };\n drawFrostBladeRef(110);\n drawFrostBladeRef(297);\n\n // Sadistic Tilted Smirk showing gold tooth\n g.strokeStyle = '#18181B';\n g.lineWidth = 9;\n g.lineCap = 'round';\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(205, 395);\n g.quadraticCurveTo(270, 400, 355, 348);\n g.stroke();\n\n // Gold Tooth Glint\n g.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(335, 360, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.beginPath(); g.arc(333, 358, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n });\n}\n\n/**\n * Toby's Frostbitten Teal Hoodie Texture\n */\nexport function createTatteredHoodieWithFrostbite() {\n return canvasTex('toby_frostbite_hoodie', 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {\n // Teal canvas base\n g.fillStyle = '#0D9488';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Subtle fabric grain\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.4)';\n for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 4) g.fillRect(0, y, w, 2);\n\n // Kangaroo Pocket\n g.fillStyle = '#0F766E';\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(90, 260); g.lineTo(422, 260); g.lineTo(442, 450); g.lineTo(70, 450);\n g.closePath(); g.fill();\n\n // Drawstrings\n g.strokeStyle = '#E2E8F0';\n g.lineWidth = 6;\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(225, 60); g.lineTo(215, 210); g.stroke();\n g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(287, 60); g.lineTo(297, 225); g.stroke();\n\n // FROSTBITE CRYSTAL ENCROACHMENT (Where Chad's rapier grazed him!)\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)';\n g.beginPath();\n g.ellipse(360, 220, 110, 70, 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n g.fill();\n\n // Sharp ice crystals\n g.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.lineWidth = 4;\n const crystalCenters = [\n { x: 360, y: 220 },\n { x: 390, y: 190 },\n { x: 340, y: 250 }\n ];\n crystalCenters.forEach(c => {\n for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n const a = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(c.x, c.y);\n g.lineTo(c.x + Math.cos(a) * 35, c.y + Math.sin(a) * 35);\n g.stroke();\n }\n });\n\n // Mud stains\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(40, 24, 12, 0.35)';\n g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(140, 380, 55, 30, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();\n }, [1, 1]);\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ASSET F-02: ACTIVE GILDED FROSTFIRE RAPIER\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function buildActiveFrostfireRapier() {\n const weapon = new THREE.Group();\n weapon.name = 'ActiveGildedFrostfireRapier';\n\n const matSteel = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xE2E8F0,\n metalness: 0.95,\n roughness: 0.1\n });\n\n const matGold = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xF59E0B,\n metalness: 0.9,\n roughness: 0.2\n });\n\n const matCyanFlame = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.75,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n\n const matCoreWhite = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xFFFFFF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.9,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending\n });\n\n // 1. Ornate Swept Cup Hilt (Basket)\n const basket = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.24, 16, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),\n matGold\n );\n basket.rotation.x = Math.PI;\n basket.position.set(0, 0, 0);\n weapon.add(basket);\n\n // Grip & Pommel\n const grip = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.04, 0.045, 0.32, 8), matGold);\n grip.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);\n weapon.add(grip);\n\n const pommel = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.08), matGold);\n pommel.position.set(0, -0.4, 0);\n weapon.add(pommel);\n\n // 2. Razor-Sharp Steel Rapier Blade (1.4m long diamond cross-section)\n const bladeGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.015, 0.035, 1.45, 4);\n const blade = new THREE.Mesh(bladeGeo, matSteel);\n blade.position.set(0, 0.75, 0);\n weapon.add(blade);\n\n // 3. Additive Frostfire Flame Sheath (Cyan outer energy envelope)\n const flameGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.035, 0.07, 1.48, 8);\n const flame = new THREE.Mesh(flameGeo, matCyanFlame);\n flame.position.set(0, 0.75, 0);\n weapon.add(flame);\n\n // Inner White-Hot Energy Core\n const coreGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.018, 0.04, 1.46, 6);\n const core = new THREE.Mesh(coreGeo, matCoreWhite);\n core.position.set(0, 0.75, 0);\n weapon.add(core);\n\n // 4. Orbiting Frostfire Cold Blue Embers\n const emberMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x38BDF8,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.85,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending\n });\n for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n const ember = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.03, 4, 4), emberMat);\n const angle = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2;\n ember.position.set(\n Math.cos(angle) * (0.12 + (i % 2) * 0.06),\n 0.2 + i * 0.12,\n Math.sin(angle) * (0.12 + (i % 2) * 0.06)\n );\n weapon.add(ember);\n }\n\n // Active Frostfire Light Emitter\n const light = new THREE.PointLight(0x00F0FF, 3.5, 6.0);\n fov: 46,\n mode: 'chad_lunge'\n },\n {\n id: 'duel_angle_2_frostfire_rapier_macro',\n title: 'VIEW 02: ACTIVE GILDED FROSTFIRE RAPIER & ENERGY FLAME',\n desc: '1.45m silver blade encased in additive 'duel_angle_3_toby_makeshift_charge',\n title: 'VIEW 03: TOBY MAKESHIFT COMBAT RIG // 2-HANDED CHARGE',\n desc: 'Aggressive forward sprint, gripping 0.65m jagged oak stake with multi-tooth splinter point & gritted teeth',\n pos: [-2.6, 2.1, 3.4],\n target: [0.0, 1.8, 0.3],\n fov: 42,\n mode: 'toby_charge'\n },\n {\n id: 'duel_angle_4_combat_face_decals',\n title: 'VIEW 04: COMBAT DECALS // PREDATORY SMIRK VS TERROR SHOCK',\n desc: 'Chad\\'s aviators reflecting blue frostfire flame vs Toby\\'s wide dilated pupils, sweat beads & frostbite',\n pos: [0.8, 3.8, 2.6],\n target: [0.0, 3.75, renderer.setPixelRatio(1);\n renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;\n renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.35;\n\n const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n scene.background = new (Drawn Rapier & Extended Arm)\"] --> DUEL[\"Milestone 5.5: The Duel\"]\n B[\"F-02: Active Frostfire Rapier
(1.45m Cyan Flame & Embers)\"] --> DUEL\n C[\"F-03: Toby Combat Rig
(Charge & Gate Recoil Poses)\"] --> DUEL\n D[\"F-04: Makeshift Oak Stake

Curved Aerodynamic Slash Arc Blade Mesh\n const arcGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(radius - 0.45, radius, 36, 1, 0, Math.PI * 0.75);\n const arcMatCyan = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.85,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const arcMesh = new THREE.Mesh(arcGeo, arcMatCyan);\n wave.add(arcMesh);\n\n // 2. White-Hot Razor Cutting Edge (Inner concentric rim)\n const coreGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(radius - 0.12, radius, 36, 1, 0, Math.PI * 0.75);\n const coreMatWhite = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xFFFFFF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.95,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const coreMesh = new THREE.Mesh(coreGeo, coreMatWhite);\n coreMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0.01);\n wave.add(coreMesh);\n\n // 3. Trailing Motion Streak Ribbons\n for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {\n const trailGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(radius - 0.65 - i * 0.12, radius - 0.45, 24, 1, 0, Math.PI * (0.75 - i * 0.15));\n const trailMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x38BDF8,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.45 / i,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const trail = new THREE.Mesh(trailGeo, trailMat);\n trail.position.set(0, 0, -0.015 * i);\n wave.add(trail);\n }\n\n // 4. Kinetic Frostfire Embers along slash trajectory\n const emberMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.9,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending\n });\n for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {\n const angle = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 0.75;\n const r = radius - 0.15 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;\n const ember = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.04, 4, 4), emberMat);\n ember.position.set(Math.cos(angle) * r, Math.sin(angle) * r, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25);\n wave.add(ember);\n }\n\n // Active Light\n const waveLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x00F0FF, 3.0, 8.0);\n waveLight.position.set(Math.cos(Math.PI * 0.375) * radius, Math.sin(Math.PI * 0.375) * radius, 0.5);\n wave.add(waveLight);\n\n return wave;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ASSET FX-02: WOOD SHATTER SINGULARITY & EXPLODING SPLINTERS\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function buildWoodShatterExplosion() {\n const shatter = new THREE.Group();\n shatter.name = 'WoodShatterExplosion';\n\n const matDarkWood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x78350F,\n roughness: 0.8,\n metalness: 0.05\n });\n\n const matLightFiber = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xB45309,\n roughness: 0.7,\n metalness: 0.1\n });\n\n const matEnergyFlash = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xFFFFFF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.9,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending\n });\n\n // 1. Central Impact Energy Core (The cut singularity)\n const coreSphere = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.18, 12, 12), matEnergyFlash);\n shatter.add(coreSphere);\n\n const coreGlow = new THREE.Mesh(\n new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.35, 12, 12),\n new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.6,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending\n })\n );\n shatter.add(coreGlow);\n\n // 2. 24 Radial Flying Geometric Oak Splinters\n for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {\n const angleTheta = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;\n const anglePhi = (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.PI;\n const dist = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.85;\n\n const length = 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.35;\n const width = 0.025 + Math.random() * 0.04;\n\n const splinterGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(width, length, 4);\n const splinter = new THREE.Mesh(splinterGeo, (i % 2 === 0) ? matLightFiber : matDarkWood);\n\n const px = Math.cos(angleTheta) * Math.cos(anglePhi) * dist;\n const py = Math.sin(anglePhi) * dist;\n const pz = Math.sin(angleTheta) * Math.cos(anglePhi) * dist;\n\n splinter.position.set(px, py, pz);\n splinter.lookAt(px * 2, py * 2, pz * 2);\n splinter.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);\n shatter.add(splinter);\n }\n\n // 3. Floating Sawdust Particle Cloud\n const dustMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xD97706,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.7\n });\n for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {\n const dust = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.035), dustMat);\n dust.position.set(\n (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4,\n (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4,\n (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4\n );\n shatter.add(dust);\n }\n\n return shatter;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ASSET FX-03: WET COBBLESTONE SKID MARKS & MUD SPRAY\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function buildWetSkidTrail(length = 4.2) {\n const skid = new THREE.Group();\n skid.name = 'WetSkidTrail';\n\n // 1. Dual Tire / Boot Churned Mud Scrape Ribbons on Street\n const skidTex = canvasTex('skid_churned_mud', 512, 128, (g, w, h) => {\n // Transparent base\n g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Churned black mud skid tracks\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.88)';\n g.fillRect(0, 15, w, 35);\n g.fillRect(0, 78, w, 35);\n\n // Water displacement streaks\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)';\n g.fillRect(0, 48, w, 6);\n g.fillRect(0, 110, w, 6);\n\n // Mud spray splatter specks\n g.fillStyle = '#1C1917';\n for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {\n const rx = Math.random() * w;\n const ry = Math.random() * h;\n g.fillRect(rx, ry, 2 + Math.random() * 4, 2 + Math.random() * 4);\n }\n }, [1, 1]);\n\n const skidGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(length, 0.95);\n skidGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);\n const skidMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n map: skidTex,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.92,\n roughness: 0.2, // wet sheen\n metalness: 0.6\n });\n const skidMesh = new THREE.Mesh(skidGeo, skidMat);\n skidMesh.position.set(0, 0.015, 0);\n skid.add(skidMesh);\n\n // 2. 3D Low-Poly Splashing Water Droplets\n const waterMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x38BDF8,\n roughness: 0.1,\n metalness: 0.8,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.85\n });\n for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {\n const drop = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(0.04), waterMat);\n const progress = (i / 20) * length - length / 2;\n drop.position.set(\n progress + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,\n 0.05 + Math.random() * 0.22,\n (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.75\n );\n skid.add(drop);\n }\n\n return skid;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ASSET FX-04: FLASHING CRITICAL [1 HP] SYSTEM ERROR HUD\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function buildCriticalHealthBar() {\n const hud = new THREE.Group();\n hud.name = 'CriticalHealthHUD';\n\n const hudTex = canvasTex('hud_critical_1hp', 512, 256, (g, w, h) => {\n // Dark translucent emergency slate backdrop\n g.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 7, 7, 0.92)';\n g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n\n // Flashing red hazard border\n g.strokeStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.lineWidth = 8;\n g.strokeRect(8, 8, w - 16, h - 16);\n\n // Hazard Stripes in top header\n g.fillStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.fillRect(16, 16, w - 32, 38);\n g.fillStyle = '#0F0505';\n for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 30) {\n g.beginPath();\n g.moveTo(x, 16);\n g.lineTo(x + 15, 16);\n g.lineTo(x - 5, 54);\n g.lineTo(x - 20, 54);\n g.closePath();\n g.fill();\n }\n\n // Title\n g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';\n g.font = '900 20px monospace';\n g.textAlign = 'center';\n g.fillText('⚠ SYSTEM WARNING: CRITICAL FAILURE ⚠', w / 2, 42);\n\n // Player Line\n g.textAlign = 'left';\n g.fillStyle = '#94A3B8';\n g.font = 'bold 18px monospace';\n g.fillText('PLAYER: TOBY [BACON HAIR]', 24, 82);\n\n // Critical 1 HP Text\n g.fillStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.font = '900 32px monospace';\n g.fillText('HP: 1 / 100', 24, 124);\n\n // Health Bar Frame\n g.strokeStyle = '#450A0A';\n g.lineWidth = 4;\n g.strokeRect(24, 140, w - 48, 32);\n\n g.fillStyle = '#1C0606';\n g.fillRect(26, 142, w - 52, 28);\n\n // 1% Red Health Sliver\n g.fillStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.fillRect(26, 142, (w - 52) * 0.015, 28);\n\n // Warning Tag\n g.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';\n g.font = 'bold 15px monospace';\n g.fillText('STATUS: FATAL BLOW IMMINENT', 24, 198);\n\n g.fillStyle = '#EF4444';\n g.font = 'bold 15px monospace';\n g.fillText('STAKE: PERMANENT AVATAR WIPEOUT', 24, 222);\n }, [1, 1]);\n\n const cardGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.4, 1.2);\n const cardMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n map: hudTex,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.95,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const card = new THREE.Mesh(cardGeo, cardMat);\n hud.add(card);\n\n // Red Pulsing Glow Frame\n const frameGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(1.2, 1.25, 4);\n const frameMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0xEF4444,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.8,\n side: THREE.DoubleSide\n });\n const frame = new THREE.Mesh(frameGeo, frameMat);\n frame.scale.set(1.0, 0.5, 1.0);\n hud.add(frame);\n\n return hud;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ASSET FX-05: CRYSTALLINE FROSTBITE ICE SPIKES\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function buildFrostbiteCrystals() {\n const frost = new THREE.Group();\n frost.name = 'FrostbiteCrystals';\n\n const matIce = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x00F0FF,\n roughness: 0.15,\n metalness: 0.8,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.85\n });\n\n const matIceWhite = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0xFFFFFF,\n roughness: 0.1,\n metalness: 0.9,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.92\n });\n\n // Cluster of 14 Sharp Geometric Ice Spikes\n for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {\n const angle = (i / 14) * Math.PI * 2;\n const r = 0.2 + (i % 3) * 0.18;\n const height = 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.45;\n\n const spikeGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, height, 5);\n const spike = new THREE.Mesh(spikeGeo, (i % 2 === 0) ? matIce : matIceWhite);\n\n spike.position.set(\n Math.cos(angle) * r,\n height / 2,\n Math.sin(angle) * r\n );\n spike.rotation.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;\n spike.rotation.z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;\n frost.add(spike);\n }\n\n // Floating Ice Mist\n const mistMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n color: 0x38BDF8,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.35,\n blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,\n depthWrite: false\n });\n const mist = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.4, 0.75, 16), mistMat);\n mist.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nexport function buildClashScene1_TheShatter() {\n const sceneGroup = new THREE.Group();\n sceneGroup.name = 'ClashScene1_TheShatter';\n\n // 1. ============================================================================\n// THE GLITCH MARKET — DUEL CLASHES & EXECUTION KEYFRAMES\n// MILESTONE 5.5 // BATCH 3: DYNAMIC DUEL SCENES (CLASH-01 THROUGH CLASH-03)\n//\n// Scenes:\n// - Scene 1: The Shattered Strike (Frostfire Slash shearing Toby's oak cudgel)\n// - Scene 2: Reflection of Death (Blade reflection macro in Toby's terrified eye)\n// - Scene 3: The 1 HP Execution Stand-Off (Pinned at Colosseum gates before freeze)\n// ============================================================================\n\nimport * as THREE from 'three';\nimport {\n buildChadCombatRig,\n buildTobyCombatRig,\n buildActiveFrostfireRapier,\n buildMakeshiftOakStake\n} from './duel_combatants.js';\nimport {\n buildFrostfireCrescentWave,\n buildWoodShatterExplosion,\n buildWetSkidTrail,\n buildCriticalHealthBar,\n buildFrostbiteCrystals\n} from './duel_effects.js';\nimport {\n buildSnappedClub\n} from './toby_avatar.js';\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// SCENE 1: THE SHATTERED STRIKE (DYNAMIC CLASH MOMENT)\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nexport function buildClashScene1_TheShatter() {\n const sceneGroup = new THREE.Group();\n sceneGroup.name = 'ClashScene1_TheShatter';\n\n // 1. Wet cobblestone street and puddle floor\n const floorGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(14, 14, 0.4, 32);\n const floorMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x090D18,\n roughness: 0.25,\n metalness: 0.5\n });\n const floor = new THREE.Mesh(floorGeo, floorMat);\n floor.position.set(0, -0.2, 0);\n sceneGroup.add(floor);\n\n const puddleGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(4.0, 32);\n puddleGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);\n const puddleMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x050A14,\n roughness: 0.08,\n metalness: 0.85,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.88\n });\n const puddle = new THREE.Mesh(puddleGeo, puddleMat);\n puddle.position.set(0, 0.01, 0);\n sceneGroup.add(puddle);\n\n // 2. Churned Mud Skid Trail\n const skid = buildWetSkidTrail(5.2);\n skid.position.set(0, 0, 0.1);\n sceneGroup.add(skid);\n\n // 3. Chad_Robux in full fencing lunge attack drive (Right side, thrusting left)\n const chad = buildChadCombatRig({ pose: 'lunge_slash' });\n chad.position.set(2.2, 0, 0.1);\n chad.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2; // Facing towards Toby (-X)\n sceneGroup.add(chad);\n\n // 4. Toby in desperate charge / recoil (Left side, moving right)\n const toby = buildTobyCombatRig({ pose: 'desperate_charge', expression: 'shock' });\n toby.position.set(-1.8, 0, 0.0);\n toby.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2; // Facing towards Chad (+X)\n sceneGroup.add(toby);\n\n // 5. Contact Singularity: The precise intersection point of rapier & oak stake\n const impactPoint = new THREE.Vector3(0.15, 1.85, 0.05);\n\n // Wood Shatter Explosion at impact\n const woodShatter = buildWoodShatterExplosion();\n woodShatter.position.copy(impactPoint);\n sceneGroup.add(woodShatter);\n\n // 2.6m Frostfire Crescent Slash Wave shearing through the wood\n const slashWave = buildFrostfireCrescentWave(2.6);\n slashWave.position.set(impactPoint.x - 0.7, impactPoint.y - 1.2, impactPoint.z);\n slashWave.rotation.set(0.2, 0.1, -0.45);\n sceneGroup.add(slashWave);\n\n // Flash Core Dynamic Point Light\n const impactLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x00F0FF, 6.0, 10.0);\n impactLight.position.copy(impactPoint);\n sceneGroup.add(impactLight);\n\n // Amber Splinter Glow Light\n const amberLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xF59E0B, 3.0, 6.0);\n amberLight.position.set(impactPoint.x - 0.3, impactPoint.y + 0.3, impactPoint.z + 0.2);\n sceneGroup.add(amberLight);\n\n return sceneGroup;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// SCENE 2: REFLECTION OF DEATH (EYE MACRO & FROSTFIRE TIP)\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nexport function buildClashScene2_ReflectionMacro() {\n const sceneGroup = new THREE.Group();\n sceneGroup.name = 'ClashScene2_ReflectionMacro';\n\n // Toby Hero Rig with lowered arms so face decal is 100% visible\n const toby = buildTobyCombatRig({ pose: 'gate_recoil', expression: 'shock' });\n toby.position.set(0, 0, 0);\n\n // Adjust Toby's arms slightly outward so they do not occlude the camera sightline to the face\n const torso = toby.children[0];\n if (torso && torso.children) {\n torso.children.forEach(c => {\n if (c.position && c.position.x < -1.0) c.rotation.set(0.3, 0.2, -0.2);\n if (c.position && c.position.x > 1.0) c.rotation.set(0.3, -0.2, 0.2);\n });\n }\n sceneGroup.add(toby);\n\n // Chad's drawn active Frostfire Rapier blade positioned inches from Toby's face\n const rapier = buildActiveFrostfireRapier();\n // Blade points towards Toby's face decal (+Z towards Toby's head at [0, 3.17, 0.6])\n rapier.position.set(0.22, 3.22, 1.45);\n rapier.rotation.x = -Math.PI * 0.48; // Leveled horizontally pointing at eye\n rapier.rotation.y = -0.15;\n sceneGroup.add(rapier);\n\n // Extra crystalline frostbite encroaching on collar & neck\n const frost = buildFrostbiteCrystals();\n frost.position.set(-0.35, 2.7, 0.4);\n frost.scale.set(0.7, 0.7, 0.7);\n sceneGroup.add(frost);\n\n // Direct Blade Emissive Light casting onto face\n const bladeGlow = new THREE.PointLight(0x00F0FF, 5.0, 4.0);\n bladeGlow.position.set(0.15, 3.2, 1.0);\n sceneGroup.add(bladeGlow);\n\n return sceneGroup;\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// SCENE 3: THE 1 HP EXECUTION STAND-OFF (CLIMAX OUTSIDE GATES)\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nexport function buildClashScene3_ExecutionStandoff() {\n const sceneGroup = new THREE.Group();\n sceneGroup.name = 'ClashScene3_ExecutionStandoff';\n\n // 1. Street and Curb Floor (Custom clean environment without blocking passerbys!)\n const streetGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(24, 16);\n streetGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);\n const streetMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x090D18,\n roughness: 0.35,\n metalness: 0.4\n });\n const street = new THREE.Mesh(streetGeo, streetMat);\n street.position.set(0, 0, -2.0);\n sceneGroup.add(street);\n\n // Concrete Sidewalk Curb Step\n const curbGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(24, 0.45, 4.5);\n const curbMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x1E293B,\n roughness: 0.75,\n metalness: 0.2\n });\n const curb = new THREE.Mesh(curbGeo, curbMat);\n curb.position.set(0, 0.05, -4.2);\n sceneGroup.add(curb);\n\n // Reflective Rain Puddles\n const puddleGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(3.2, 32);\n puddleGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);\n const puddleMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x050811,\n roughness: 0.06,\n metalness: 0.9,\n transparent: true,\n opacity: 0.92\n });\n const puddle = new THREE.Mesh(puddleGeo, puddleMat);\n puddle.position.set(0.0, 0.015, -2.5);\n sceneGroup.add(puddle);\n\n // Heavy Rusted Security Gate Bars (Colosseum Arena Gates) at Z = -4.5\n const gate = new THREE.Group();\n gate.position.set(0, 0, -4.5);\n const barMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n color: 0x1E2430,\n metalness: 0.85,\n roughness: 0.55\n });\n for (let i = -16; i <= 16; i++) {\n const bar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.065, 0.065, 7.5, 8), barMat);\n bar.position.set(i * 0.68, 3.75, 0);\n gate.add(bar);\n\n const spike = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, 0.35, 4), barMat);\n spike.position.set(i * 0.68, 7.6, 0);\n gate.add(spike);\n }\n [1.0, 3.8, 6.6].forEach(y => {\n const beam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(23.5, 0.22, 0.18), barMat);\n beam.position.set(0, y, 0);\n gate.add(beam);\n });\n sceneGroup.add(gate);\n\n // 2. Toby pinned against the gate bars\n const toby = buildTobyCombatRig({ pose: 'gate_recoil', expression: 'shock' });\n toby.position.set(-1.0, 0.25, -4.0);\n toby.rotation.y = 0.35;\n sceneGroup.add(toby);\n\n // Broken starter club in puddle\n const brokenClub = buildSnappedClub();\n brokenClub.position.set(-0.4, 0.05, -2.8);\n brokenClub.rotation.y = 0.65;\n sceneGroup.add(brokenClub);\n\n // Frostbite crystals\n const frostCrystals = buildFrostbiteCrystals();\n frostCrystals.position.set(-1.3, 0.25, -3.9);\n sceneGroup.add(frostCrystals);\n\n // 3. Chad_Robux towering over Toby in execution pose\n const chad = buildChadCombatRig({ pose: 'execution_standoff' });\n chad.position.set(1.4, 0.05, -2.2);\n chad.rotation.y = -Math.PI * 0.65; // facing toby\n sceneGroup.add(chad);\n\n // 4. Flashing Critical [1 HP] Error HUD floating between them\n const criticalHUD = buildCriticalHealthBar();\n criticalHUD.position.set(0.1, 3.6, -3.2);\n criticalHUD.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);\n sceneGroup.add(criticalHUD);\n\n // Lighting\n const hudLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xEF4444, 4.0, 8.0);\n hudLight.position.set(0.1, 3.6, -3.0);\n sceneGroup.add(hudLight);\n\n const overheadSpot = new THREE.SpotLight(0x38BDF8, 5.0, 25.0, Math.PI / 4, 0.4);\n overheadSpot.position.set(3, 9, 2);\n overheadSpot.target = toby;\n sceneGroup.add(overheadSpot);\n\n return sceneGroup;\n}\n","Overwrite":true,"Path":"z:/Mini Projects/Nirvana/Automation reel workflow/roblox-glitch-market/src/duel_clashes.js"}},{"name":"read_file","args":{"EndLine":70,"Path":"z:/Mini
